title: Full-Stack Software Developer - TRATON Workshop Suite
description:
TRATON is a group of strong brands with a shared mission: transforming transportation together to create the future of sustainable transport solutions. Within TRATON, we include MAN, Scania, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Together, we have the power to transform transportation - Let´s make a difference together. Find out more: www.traton.com
   

  

  

  

 Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do.
   

  

**Role Summary**
*This role is part of TRATON Group R&D, located in Södertälje, Sweden.*
 As a
 **Full-Stack Software Developer** 
 , you will join Team Jaguar, one of several cross-functional development teams working together to build the
 **TRATON Workshop Suite (TWS)** 
 – the digital workshop platform supporting technicians in servicing, maintaining and updating vehicles across the TRATON Group.
   

  

 Team Jaguar is responsible for the
 **Software Update domain** 
 , developing user-facing functionality that enables workshop technicians to safely and efficiently update vehicle software. The team owns the functionality and user experience end-to-end, from the workshop application through backend and cloud services. To deliver the complete solution, we collaborate closely with other TWS teams and use shared capabilities such as product and vehicle communication services.
   

  

 In this role, you will work across the full technology stack, primarily using
 **C#/.NET, AWS and Angular** 
 in a microservice-based architecture. The solutions you develop are ultimately used by workshop technicians in their daily work, giving the role a clear connection between the technology we build and the value it creates for our users.
   

  

 You will be part of a team with shared responsibility for building, operating and continuously improving stable, secure and user-friendly solutions that support efficient workshop operations across the TRATON Group.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Develop and maintain full-stack functionality within the Software Update domain, using C#/.NET, AWS and Angular across frontend, backend, microservices and APIs;
* Build robust and user-friendly solutions that enable safe and reliable software updates of vehicles;
* Take part in the complete software lifecycle – from requirements, design and implementation to testing, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, support and maintenance;
* Collaborate closely with developers, testers, Product Owner and Scrum Master within the team, as well as with other teams across TWS;
* Troubleshoot complex technical issues across frontend, backend, cloud services and integrations;
* Continuously improve system stability, observability, maintainability, quality and user experience;
* Contribute to testing and validation in development environments, rigs and real vehicles;
* Contribute actively to the team's way of working, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.


**Who You Are**
 We believe you are a collaborative and curious full-stack software developer who enjoys solving real problems for end users and understanding the complete solution.
   

  

 You have
 **at least 3 years of relevant professional experience** 
 and a solid foundation in software development. You don't need to have worked with every technology in our stack – what matters is that you have relevant experience, enjoy learning and can contribute effectively as part of a team.
   

  

 You have experience with
 **C#/.NET, cloud development such as AWS and microservice architectures** 
 , combined with frontend development.
 **Experience with Angular is preferred** 
 , while experience with other modern frontend frameworks, such as React, is also valuable.
   

  

 You do not need to be equally strong in frontend and backend development, but you should be comfortable working across both and willing to contribute wherever the team needs you.
   

  

 For us, technical competence is only part of what makes a great developer.
 **How you collaborate, communicate and contribute to the team is equally important.** 
 We are looking for someone who enjoys working closely with others, shares knowledge, asks for help when needed and actively helps others succeed. We value shared ownership and believe that the best results are achieved together.
   

  

 You are comfortable communicating with different audiences – from discussing technical details with fellow developers to explaining complex technical topics to stakeholders with different levels of technical knowledge. You can adapt your communication to your audience, making complex topics understandable without losing what is important. You listen to different perspectives and seek to understand the needs behind what we build.
   

  

 You take initiative and ownership while staying aligned with the team. You are curious about the customer and want to understand not only
 **how** 
 something should be built, but
 **why it matters to the people using it** 
 .
   

  

 Experience within automotive software, vehicle communication, distributed systems, DevOps, observability or similar technically complex environments is considered an advantage, but not a requirement. Most importantly, you are motivated to learn the domain, contribute to the team and grow together with us.
   

  

 We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and value different experiences and perspectives.
 **If you are excited about the role but don't meet every qualification listed, we still encourage you to apply.**
**This Is Us**
**Team Jaguar** 
 is a cross-functional team of developers and testers responsible for the
 **Software Update domain within the TRATON Workshop Suite** 
 .
   

  

 Our solutions enable workshop technicians to perform software updates on vehicles, making our work both technically challenging and directly connected to the end-user experience. We develop across frontend, backend and cloud services and collaborate closely with other TWS teams whose capabilities together enable the complete workshop solution.
   

  

 Jaguar is one of several teams that together develop the TRATON Workshop Suite. We have clear ownership of our domain while depending on and contributing to the wider TWS ecosystem. Close collaboration across team boundaries is therefore a natural part of how we work.
   

  

 Within Jaguar, we work closely together and share responsibility for what we build and operate.
 **Different experiences, perspectives and strengths make the team better** 
 , and we help each other solve problems, share knowledge and learn along the way. We want an environment where people feel comfortable asking questions, contributing ideas and challenging existing solutions constructively.
   

  

 We strive to work in an
 **agile and iterative way** 
 , with close collaboration, shared ownership and continuous improvement. As a team, we plan, build, evaluate, learn and adjust together, continuously looking for ways to improve both our solutions and how we work.
   

  

 Joining Team Jaguar means becoming part of a collaborative team where you can work across the full technology stack,
 **broaden your skills across frontend, backend and cloud development** 
 , and contribute to solutions with a clear impact on workshop operations.
   

  

 As part of the wider
 **TRATON Workshop Suite development organization** 
 , you will also be exposed to different technical domains, technologies and challenges, creating opportunities to broaden your experience and continue developing over time. You will have opportunities to learn from others, share your own expertise and grow together with the team as we continue developing the TRATON Workshop Suite.
   

  

**TRATON Offers**
 We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.
   

  

 With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, TRATON Group R&D supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.
   

  

 Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. We also arrange events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.
   

  

**Application**
 We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.
   

  

 Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-10-19. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check is required for this role.
   

  

 If you have questions or would like more information, please contact: Mattias Gustafsson, Unit Head - System Development Service Products - TGROSDS, mattias.gustafsson@scania.com
   

  

**We look forward to your application!**
*This recruitment process is handled by Scania for TRATON Group* 

*R&D.*

title: Backendutvecklare .NET
description:
Är du redo för en större uppgift? Polismyndigheten är Sveriges största myndighet med ca 42 000 medarbetare över hela landet. Hos oss får du möjlighet att bidra till Polisens uppdrag – att öka tryggheten och minska brottsligheten i samhället.
   

  

**Organisation** 
 It-avdelningen
 **Kommun** 
 Stockholm
 **Län** 
 Stockholms län
 **Utlyst** 
 5 oktober 2026
 **Ansök senast** 
 12 oktober 2026
 **Referensnummer** 
 A599.839/2026
   

  

 Arbetsplatsbeskrivning
   

  

 Polisen står inför ett generationsskifte när det gäller kommunikation där vi är på väg mot nästa generations radiokommunikation. Det kommer att ge oss nya kommunikationsmöjligheter med ökad förmåga att dela information i den yttre verksamheten. Som en del av detta arbete behöver vi bygga upp ett nytt utvecklingsteam där du kommer att spela en viktig roll. Ditt arbete kommer att bestå av att tillsammans med vårt team bygga en av de centrala komponenterna för den nya lösningen. Med de nya möjligheterna så behöver vi bygga det som vår verksamhet kräver. Arbetet är innovativt och utforskande i nära samarbete med den operativa verksamheten.
   

  

 Arbetsbeskrivning
   

  

 Som backendutvecklare inom Operativa Verksamhetssystem kommer du ha en viktig roll i att skapa verksamhetskritiska och framtidsäkrade system. Du ingår i ett nytt utvecklingsteam som kommer att arbeta med styrning och hantering av Polisens radiosystem, där du bidrar till att lösa komplexa tekniska utmaningar.
   

  

 Teamet består av erfarna arkitekter och systemutvecklare. Vårt team kommer att arbeta mycket nära andra team som arbetar inom uppdraget. Inom teamet ansvarar vi tillsammans för utveckling och förvaltning av de system vi utvecklar. Systemen driftas i en komplex infrastrukturmiljö med mycket höga krav på säkerhet och tillgänglighet.
   

  

 Som systemutvecklare ansvarar du för att:
   

  

* Bygga, testa och förvalta våra egenutvecklade system.
* Bygga säkra lösningar med höga tillgänglighetskrav.
* Ingå i arbetet för att ta fram lösningar för de krav som ställs på våra system.


 Kvalifikationer
   

  

 Detta är en möjlighet för dig som har:
   

  

* Relevant utbildning inom systemutveckling alternativt att du har motsvarande förvärvad erfarenhet som Polismyndigheten bedömer som likvärdig.
* Minst 5 års aktuell och relevant erfarenhet av att ha arbetat med systemutveckling i .NET eller C++.
* Goda kunskaper i svenska.
* Svenskt medborgarskap


 Det är meriterande om du även har:
   

  

* Erfarenhet av systemutveckling i TETRA (Rakel).
* Erfarenhet av databaser, REST och Git.
* Erfarenhet av byggautomation / CI/CD / Jenkins.
* Aktuell erfarenhet av arbete med systemintegrationer.
* Erfarenhet av Linux.
* Erfarenhet av distribuerade system.


**Personliga egenskaper**
 Vi värdesätter att du som person motiveras av att stötta polisen i vårt samhällsviktiga arbete. För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har förmågan att analysera och lösa komplexa tekniska problem effektivt med verksamhetens bästa i fokus. Du har en ambition att driva utveckling som leder till hållbara lösningar.
   

  

 Då rollen innebär att ni tillsammans tar fram nya lösningar är det viktigt att du trivs med att samarbeta och bidra till gruppens gemensamma mål. Du har en god kommunikativ förmåga, både skriftligt och muntligt, och kan anpassa ditt sätt att kommunicera efter olika målgrupper och situationer.
   

  

 Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper.

title: .NET utvecklare
description:
*Vill du kombinera modern .NET-utveckling med automation, integrationer och DevSecOps?*
*Vi söker nu en .NET-utvecklare till Skandias DevSecOps-team som utvecklar interna plattformar, verktyg och integrationer som används av utvecklingsteam i hela Skandia.*
**Att jobba som .NET-utvecklare**
 Som .NET-utvecklare blir du en del av ett tvärfunktionellt DevSecOps-team med ansvar för interna plattformar och verktyg. Tillsammans utvecklar och förvaltar ni lösningar som används av utvecklare i hela Skandia. Genom ett nära samarbete med andra team bidrar ni till effektiva, säkra och moderna utvecklingsflöden.
   

  

**I Rollen Kommer Du Bland Annat Att**
* utveckla och vidareutveckla interna portaler och egenutvecklade lösningar
* bygga integrationer mellan olika system, exempelvis Azure DevOps och ServiceNow
* automatisera processer och arbetsflöden enligt principen Everything as Code
* vidareutveckla och förbättra bygg-, test- och deployprocesser i Azure DevOps och Octopus Deploy
* bidra till säkra och effektiva utvecklingsprocesser med fokus på kodkvalitet, säkerhet och automation


 Vi arbetar agilt enligt SAFe och i nära samarbete med andra utvecklingsteam, där du bidrar till den fortsatta utvecklingen och förvaltningen av plattformen.
   

  

**För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:**
* flera års erfarenhet av utveckling i C# och .NET
* erfarenhet av backendutveckling och systemintegrationer
* goda kunskaper i Git, YAML och PowerShell
* erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt, exempelvis SAFe
* goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift


 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy, CI/CD eller testautomation.
   

  

**Vem är du?**
 Vi tror att du är en nyfiken och lösningsorienterad person som trivs med att ta dig an tekniska utmaningar och hitta smarta lösningar. Du trivs med att samarbeta med andra, delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och bidrar till ett öppet och hjälpsamt teamklimat.
   

  

 Du är nyfiken på ny teknik och har en vilja att kontinuerligt utveckla både dig själv och de lösningar du arbetar med.
   

  

**Vad händer nu?**
 I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet.
   

  

 Läs mer om hela vår rekryteringsprocess här.
   

  

 Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Izabella Rolnik på izabella.rolnik@skandia.se.
   

  

 Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocess, vänligen ta kontakt med Nina Fazeli på nina.fazeli@skandia.se.
   

  

**Vi kommer att ta ett sommaruppehåll i rekryteringsprocessen och återupptar intervjuerna i augusti.**
**Varmt välkommen med din ansökan, och trevlig sommar!**
**Mer om IT**
 Vi på Skandia IT är stolta över att vara en kundorienterad enhet som levererar effektiva och säkra lösningar för våra kunder. Med cirka 600 engagerade medarbetare är vi mitt i en spännande transformationsresa, där vi utvecklas tillsammans och har kul på vägen. Framåt tillsammans är vårt motto!
   

  

 Vi arbetar agilt och har sedan 2017 använt oss av SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) ramverket, där leverans och kundvärde alltid står i centrum. Våra tågledningar och team, jobbar verksamhetsbaserat med aktiviteter som sprintplanering, daily stand-ups, team-synk, code reviews och retrospektiv.
   

  

 Var 12:e vecka samlas vi alla i vår ljusa och inspirerande Ljusgård på kontoret i Stockholm för 2 planeringsdagar. Planeringsperioden består av 6 tvåveckorssprintar, där den sista sprinten är en innovationssprint. Här får du chansen att, själv eller tillsammans med ditt team, utveckla och förfina våra system.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
**About The Company**
 A specialist in identity, secure transactions, and digital services, IN Groupe is the global leader in secure identity and trust services. Every day, our 4,000 employees across 40 countries work to ensure that everyone has access to a reliable and secure identity, both in the physical and digital worlds. With our solutions and our international network of 10 R&D centers, we support governments and businesses in more than 130 countries.
   

  

 Joining IN Groupe means helping to shape the future of the identity and secure transaction market. Become part of our international teams — driven by innovation and proud to design solutions that make life easier and protect personal data for millions of people around the world.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a
 **Senior backend engineer to join our Stockholm office** 
 with strong,
 **hands‑on expertise in modern Java,** 
 experienced in building and maintaining distributed systems and microservices. Brings solid proficiency in CI/CD and
 **Azure DevOps** 
 (or comparable platforms), along with practical knowledge of cloud environments, containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, automated testing practices, and operating services reliably in production.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
* Focus on backend development, with responsibility for services, databases, and system integrations.
* Develop, improve, and maintain services with a strong focus on reliability, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
* Select and use technologies based on problem-solving value, not trendiness.
* Ensure that deliveries are on time and secure, always balancing speed with quality.
* Collaborate closely with teammates and stakeholders, enabling fast and sustainable delivery.
* Over time, take a leading role in driving improvements in both technology and ways of working.


**Our Tech Stack (key areas for this role)**
* Java (primary language: deep expertise required)
* Spring Boot
* REST, Microservices, Databases
* Azure (cloud environment), Docker, Kubernetes


**About You**
* Highly experienced in backend Java development and proficient with Azure.
* Results-oriented: you deliver what is needed, when it is needed.
* Pragmatic: you enjoy new technology but choose what best solves the current problem while limiting technical debt.
* Humble and grounded: you listen, collaborate, and keep the team's health in mind.
* Independent yet collaborative: you take initiative but thrive in teamwork.
* User-focused: the end user's experience is always your guiding star.


**Qualifications**
* Extensive experience in Java backend development (main requirement).
* Experience with Spring Boot and modern development practices.
* Solid understanding of Microservices and integrations.
* Professional proficiency in English.


**What We Offer**
* Impactful work: Your code directly powers secure identity services used by real customers worldwide.
* A pragmatic environment: We value smart choices over shiny tools. You'll use the most adapted technologies to solve problems, reduce complexity, and limit future technical debt.
* A healthy team culture: We believe in humility, collaboration, and keeping team well-being in balance with delivery goals.
* End-to-end responsibility: You'll see the whole lifecycle, from development through deployment to customer use.
* Growth into leadership: Over time, you'll have the opportunity to take on a bigger role in driving initiatives and supporting others in the team.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work, creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.
   

  

 Our team builds Groove, a platform that helps thousands of employees plan, coordinate, and deliver work across Spotify. From initiative tracking to dependency management and collaborative planning, Groove helps teams stay aligned and execute with confidence.
   

  

 We're a small, cross-functional engineering team focused on building thoughtful tools that reduce friction and help people do their best work. We move quickly, learn from user feedback, and continuously improve the experiences we build.
   

  

 What You'll Do:
   

  

* Build and evolve Groove, a fullstack platform that supports planning, collaboration, and execution across Spotify.
* Design and deliver features including initiative tracking, planning workflows, and dependency management.
* Work across the stack using React, TypeScript, Java, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) to build end-to-end solutions.
* Partner closely with product managers and designers to understand user needs and create intuitive, effective experiences.
* Ensure reliability through testing, monitoring, and continuous improvement in production.
* Participate in an on-call rotation and help respond to production incidents when needed.
* Improve the performance, scalability, and maintainability of frontend and backend systems.
* Use AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity while maintaining ownership of quality, correctness, and outcomes.
* Lead the design and delivery of complex, high-impact features across the stack.
* Own problems end-to-end, from shaping ambiguous requirements through to production-ready solutions.
* Help define and evolve architecture across frontend, backend, and infrastructure.
* Mentor engineers and contribute to raising the technical bar across the team.


 Who You Are:
   

  

* You have 5+ years of experience building scalable fullstack applications in production environments.
* You are comfortable working across frontend and backend technologies and understand how they fit together to create reliable products.
* You have experience with APIs, distributed systems, and modern web application architecture.
* You take ownership of the software you build, from implementation through production health and ongoing improvements.
* You have experience designing systems and influencing technical direction.
* You communicate clearly and effectively through documentation and collaboration in distributed teams.
* You write clean, maintainable code that enables others to build with confidence.
* You use AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully and validate outputs with sound engineering judgment.
* You navigate ambiguity with confidence and make thoughtful trade-offs between speed, quality, and long-term maintainability.
* You enjoy mentoring others, sharing knowledge, and helping teammates grow.
* You are curious, proactive, and motivated by continuous learning and experimentation.


 Where You'll Be:
   

  

* This role is based in London or Stockholm.
* We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.


 Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
   

  

 At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice
   

  

 Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

 We’re a global leader in digital forensics, building advanced tools used worldwide to solve crimes, fight corruption, investigate fraud, and support justice. Here, your code has real-world impact.
   

  

**Possibilities**
 As a developer at MSAB, you’ll dive deep into complex and highly technical challenges - exactly the kind that motivate curious, inventive engineers.
   

  

**Your Work Might Involve**
* Extracting and decrypting data from mobile devices
* Writing decoders, parsers, and low-level implementations
* Reverse-engineering apps and making complex data structures readable
* Implementing efficient, high-performance code in C++
* Working close to hardware, embedded systems, Android, or iOS internals


 If that excites you - you’re exactly who we want to meet.
   

  

**Our Culture**
 Our culture is friendly, supportive, and built on shared learning and technical curiosity. You’ll thrive here if you enjoy autonomy, like exploring new ideas, and want to grow by stepping outside your comfort zone.
   

  

 There’s much more to tell you about our tech stack, vision, innovation and ways of working, and the opportunities ahead. But let’s save that for future conversations.
   

  

 Ready to build software that makes a real difference?
   

  

 Send your application today.
   

  

 For more information about MSAB, please visit: http://www.msab.com
   

  

 What we can offer
   

  

 Create a safer world with us!
   

  

 As one of the world’s leading digital forensics companies, MSAB leads the way in pioneering advancements that contribute to making our world safer.
   

  

 Your work at MSAB will bridge the gap between technology and justice. You will be inspired to go beyond your comfort zone, and you will deal with challenging and meaningful projects. When you join us, you become part of a global team that aspires to create a safer digital future, one breakthrough at a time.
   

  

 We can offer you an exciting work environment, where we value being innovative, acting ethically and delivering results in everything we do while our customers' needs are at the center. We are proud to be a fast-growing international company with more than 20+ nationalities and we work with things that really make a difference.
   

  

 Every day at MSAB is an opportunity to redefine the future of digital forensics.
   

  

 Are you up for the challenge?

title: Systemutvecklare inom valutahandelssystem till Handelsbanken
description:
Vill du ta en nyckelroll i utvecklingen av affärskritiska system inom investmentbank och treasury? Vi söker en senior systemutvecklare som vill driva och vidareutveckla vårt systemstöd – från förvaltning av befintliga lösningar till att skapa nya affärsmöjligheter. Här får du kombinera teknisk spets med affärsförståelse i en roll där dina idéer gör verklig skillnad.
   

  

**Ditt team**
 IT-området FX, Transaktionsrapportering och Marknadsdata är en del av Handelsbanken Markets IT‑avdelning och ansvarar för utveckling och förvaltning av bankens systemstöd för valutahandel. Teamet arbetar både med inköpta system och egenutvecklade komponenter i en komplex och affärskritisk miljö.
   

  

 Teamet består av flera erfarna och kompetenta medlemmar som arbetar agilt enligt bankens utvecklingsmodell. Vi har ett nära och kontinuerligt samarbete med affärssidan och arbetar tätt tillsammans för att säkerställa stabil och effektiv handel. Teamet leds av en team coach och APO, och prioritering och planering av det dagliga arbetet sker gemensamt.
   

  

**Din roll**
 I rollen som systemutvecklare blir du den i teamet som kommer att ansvara för och driva utvecklingen av vårt systemstöd inom investmentbanken och treasury, en lösning som är här för att stanna och som spelar en central roll i vår strategi framåt. Arbetsuppgifterna handlar så väl om att underhålla och förbättra befintliga funktioner som att vara med och skapa nya affärsmöjligheter. Du blir den brobyggare som kan identifiera, formulera och förverkliga idéer som gör skillnad – både för system och vår affär.
   

  

**Din profil**
 Vi ser att du är en senior utvecklare och har erfarenhet av utveckling av inköpta system. Då vi samarbetar med hela koncernen behöver du behärska god svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Vi ser också att du har kunskap inom:
   

  

* Linux
* Java
* SQL
* Grundläggande kunskap inom finansiella instrument


 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av TeamCity.
   

  

 Vi söker dig som kombinerar nytänkande med en strukturerad arbetsstil. Du har en naturlig förmåga att tänka utanför ramarna och se nya möjligheter, samtidigt som du arbetar metodiskt för att omsätta idéer till konkreta och genomförbara lösningar. Du trivs i en föränderlig miljö där snabba beslut ibland är en del av vardagen. Du lyckas behålla fokus och levererar med hög kvalitet, oavsett förutsättningar.
   

  

 Du har en god kommunikativ förmåga och är skicklig på att skapa förståelse, bygga relationer och bidra till ett gott samarbete i teamet.
   

  

 Låter detta som något för dig?
   

  

**Välkommen med din ansökan!**

 Hossein Johari, hossein.johari@handelsbanken.se
   

  

**Talent Acquisition Partner:** 
 Johanna Rylander Raifi, johanna.rylander.raifi@handelsbanken.se

 Ann-Christin Thorsell, ann-christin.thorsell@handelsbanken.se

title: Data Engineer
description:
We are looking for a
 **Senior Data Engineer / Data Platform Engineer** 
 with a strong programming background, particularly in
 **Python** 
 , who has experience building modern data solutions in
 **Azure** 
 .
 



  





 This is not a traditional infrastructure Platform Engineer role. In this case, "platform" means an
 **internal data engineering framework/platform used by other data delivery teams** 
 .
 



  





 The ideal candidate should understand both
 **data warehousing and software engineering** 
 . They should be capable of building reusable components and frameworks rather than only developing individual ETL pipelines. Experience from a
 **banking or similarly regulated enterprise environment** 
 is highly relevant.
 



  





**What will they do:** 




  





 The engineer will be part of an agile team responsible for enabling other data engineering/delivery teams.
 



 Their main responsibility will be to develop
 **reusable engineering components and frameworks** 
 for data acquisition and data product delivery. Instead of every data team building its own ingestion, validation, metadata handling, or delivery logic, this team provides standardized components that other engineers can reuse.
 



 They will work closely with the
 **Agile Product Owner, Solution Architect, Business Analysts, and engineers from other teams** 
 .
 



 Typical responsibilities will include developing reusable Python components, improving data ingestion and delivery frameworks, working with data pipelines and orchestration, supporting data quality and metadata management, and helping other Data Engineers adopt the platform.

title: Senior ServiceNow-utvecklare
description:
**Jobbeskrivning**
**Om oss:**
 Sopra Steria är Europas ledande konsultföretag inom ServiceNow och digital transformation. Vi hjälper företag och organisationer att effektivisera sina verksamheter genom innovativa teknologilösningar. Med fler än 4000 ServiceNow-experter besitter vi marknadens största och mest framstående ServiceNow-team där du får möjligheten att arbeta med de mest spännande projekten samt utvecklas i en dynamisk och framåtlutad arbetsmiljö. Nu tar vi nästa stora kliv och satsar ännu hårdare på vår ledande position inom ServiceNow. Hos oss får du chansen att vara med och driva utvecklingen framåt, forma framtidens lösningar och göra verklig skillnad. Vill du vara en del av vårt ledande team?
   

  

**Om rollen:**
 I rollen som Senior Utvecklare inom ServiceNow kommer du att vara en nyckelspelare i att utveckla och implementera lösningar på ServiceNow-plattformen för våra kunder. Du säkerställer att tekniska lösningar håller hög kvalitet, är hållbara och anpassade efter kundens verksamhet. Som Elite Partner för ServiceNow har vi en av Skandinaviens största och mest kvalificerade konsultgrupper med närmare 500 dedikerade experter. Vi söker nu en erfaren Senior Utvecklare som kan ta en strategisk och operativ roll i våra teamleveranser.
   

  

**Dina huvudsakliga uppgifter:**
* Utveckla och konfigurera lösningar på ServiceNow-plattformen.
* Säkerställa teknisk kvalitet och bästa praxis i lösningarna.
* Fungera som rådgivare till kunder kring tekniska lösningar och plattformsutveckling.
* Leda tekniska workshops och kravinsamling med kunder.
* Samarbeta med processledare och andra roller för att säkerställa helhetslösningar.
* Analysera och optimera befintliga lösningar samt identifiera förbättringsområden.


**För att vara framgångsrik i rollen tror vi att du har:**
* Flerårig erfarenhet av utveckling och implementation inom ServiceNow.
* Gedigen kunskap i JavaScript samt god förståelse för webbteknologier som HTML och CSS.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med moduler som ITSM, ITOM, HR eller SecOps.
* Förmåga att leda tekniska dialoger och workshops med kund.
* Relevant akademisk utbildning inom IT eller motsvarande.
* Flytande svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.


**Vi erbjuder:**
* En spännande arbetsmiljö hos Europas ledande ServiceNow-konsultbolag.
* Möjlighet att arbeta med innovativa lösningar och den senaste tekniken.
* Kompetensutveckling genom certifieringar, utbildningar och mentorskap.
* Hybrid arbetsmodell samt konkurrenskraftiga villkor och förmåner.


**Om ServiceNow-teamet på Sopra Steria:**
 Sopra Steria är Nordens ledande expert inom ServiceNow – vi har den största och mest specialiserade kompetensen på marknaden. Vårt starka och sammansvetsade team levererar omfattande och högkvalitativa lösningar, där flera av våra erfarna ServiceNow-konsulter samarbetar för att maximera värdet för våra kunder. Vi drivs av innovation, samarbete och kunskapsutbyte – tillsammans sätter vi nya standarder och skapar framtidens digitala lösningar. Vill du arbeta med de bästa? Då är Sopra Steria platsen för dig.
   

  

**Om Sopra Steria:**
 Sopra Steria är en av Europas ledande aktörer inom digital transformation, med över 60 000 medarbetare i mer än 30 länder globalt. Vi driver innovation och hjälper företag och organisationer att effektivisera, utvecklas och skapa långsiktigt värde genom banbrytande teknologilösningar.
   

  

 Hos oss arbetar de främsta experterna inom sina områden i en dynamisk och framtidsorienterad miljö där samarbete, nytänkande och teknisk spetskompetens står i centrum.
   

  

**Vill du veta mer om oss? Läs här: Om oss | Sopra Steria**
**Ansökan:**
 Om du är redo att ta nästa steg i din karriär och vara en del av en framstående arbetsplats, ansök genom att ladda upp ditt CV. Kontakta gärna ansvarig rekryterare, Teodor Nellvik (teodor.nellvik@soprasteria.com) eller Business Owner Mikael Kroglund (mikael.kroglund@soprasteria.com) för eventuella frågor om tjänsten.
   

  

 På Sopra Steria ställer vi höga krav på både kompetens och säkerhetsmedvetenhet hos våra medarbetare. Innan en eventuell anställning kommer du därför att genomgå en bakgrundskontroll, och vid intervju behöver du kunna uppvisa giltig legitimation.
   

  

**Välkommen till Sopra Steria – där din kompetens formar framtidens digitala lösningar!**

title: Utvecklare inom BI
description:
Kriminalvårdens IT-avdelning är i ett expansivt skede och inom Sektionen IT Ledning & Uppföljning behöver vi utöka kompetensen inom området för BI. Placering för denna roll är Norrköping eller Stockholm.
   

  

**Arbetsbeskrivning**
 Nu letar vi efter framtidens utvecklare inom BI där du får en möjlighet att göra skillnad i samhället samtidigt som du utvecklas i din karriär. Vi söker dig som har ett starkt driv att utvecklas och lära dig mer inom BI. Här får du arbeta i agila utvecklingsteam tillsammans med engagerade kollegor som brinner för att använda data för att göra skillnad. Du med i hela processen – från att analysera stora datamängder och identifiera viktiga trender till att bygga och förvalta system som gör informationen tillgänglig och användbar för verksamheten.
   

  

 Du kommer att skapa visualiseringar och rapporter som förvandlar komplex data till tydliga beslutsunderlag och vara med och vidareutveckla Kriminalvårdens beslutstödsplattform. Du bidrar till datadriven utveckling och att förbättra våra processer för datastyrning och datakvalitet så att vi kan lita på att informationen vi använder är både korrekt och relevant. Du ingår i ett agilt utvecklingsteam där ni ansvarar för att ta fram digitaliserade lösningar som uppfyller verksamhetens behov. I teamet kommer du ha stöd av engagerade och hjälpsamma kollegor som delar med sig av sin kompetens och erfarenhet inom området.
   

  

 Vi tror på utveckling hos våra medarbetare och det finns stora möjligheter att påverka riktningen för just din utveckling beroende på vad du brinner för. Välkommen med din ansökan! För att ansöka klickar du på denna länk: https://kriminalvarden.varbi.com/se/what:job/jobID:972072/
   

  

**Kvalifikationer**
 Vi söker dig som är självgående och tar ett stort ansvar över dina uppgifter. Du strukturerar själv ditt angreppssätt och styrs av både mål- och resultat i din planering och prioriteringar. I de fall målen ändrar riktning och du behöver strukturera om är du både anpassningsbar och flexibel. Vidare har du en hög samarbetsförmåga och du arbetar bra med andra människor. I din kommunikation är du både tydlig och lyhörd. Slutligen har du en kreativ sida, du är nytänkande och vågar lyfta nya idéer.
   

  

 För att trivas och lyckas i ditt uppdrag är det viktigt att du delar Kriminalvårdens grundläggande värderingar om en human människosyn, respekt för individen och tron på att människan är utvecklingsbar. Du är även medveten om och har förståelse för hur bakgrund, kultur och grupptillhörighet påverkar dig själv och andra. Vidare förväntas du med ditt förhållningssätt bidra till att alla blir likvärdigt bemötta. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.
   

  

**Vi Söker Dig Som Har**
* Akademisk examen inom relevant ämnesområde såsom systemvetenskap, datavetenskap eller statistik och dataanalys alternativt annan utbildning i kombination med erfarenhet som Kriminalvården bedömer relevant
* Några års erfarenhet som utvecklare inom BI
* Erfarenhet av databaser och SQL
* Erfarenhet av datadriven utveckling
* Förmåga att uttrycka dig väl i tal och skrift på svenska


**Det är även meriterande med:**
* Utbildning med inriktning mot BI/AI
* Erfarenhet inom/av AI
* Erfarenhet inom Microsoft BI-svit (SQL Server, SSIS, SSAS)
* Erfarenhet av Microsofts Azure DevOps eller motsvarande system
* Kunskaper inom datamodellering och data warehouse
* Kunskaper inom Power BI
* Kunskaper inom BIML
* Kunskaper inom systemutveckling och agil utvecklingsmetodik

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.
   

  

 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.
   

  

 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.
   

  

**The role**
 At Helsing, our engineering culture is defined by technical impact, first-principles thinking, and high-agency execution. We are looking for a hands-on Staff Software Engineer to serve as a primary technical anchor, driving architectural decisions and shipping code across our backend systems.
   

  

 Designed for a builder who thrives on complexity and wants to remain close to the metal, you will have the autonomy to own projects from zero to one prototyping through to deploying resilient software on physical hardware.
   

  

 Your impact is measured by your ability to design robust systems, write performance-optimised code, and act as a technical multiplier for our teams. You will architect solutions across highly resilient distributed systems built for network partitions, resource-constrained embedded hardware, secure networking protocols, and high-performance machine learning inference pipelines directly at the tactical edge.
   

  

**The day-to-day**
* Lead the review of complex code contributions, design proposals, and technical RFCs from colleagues. At Helsing we strongly believe that unblocking others and mentoring is the highest-leverage work you can do.
* Architect, propose, and implement major new features, capabilities, algorithms, infrastructure, or full products across our stack. We expect our engineers to look beyond their immediate team, identify systemic opportunities, and champion the solutions.
* Act as a key translator between engineering and the broader business. You will regularly interface with product managers, programme leads, and customers to translate deep technical designs and constraints into clear, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders who depend on our technologies.
* Actively mentor engineers, find mentees, and help drive and scale our technical interviewing pipeline. You will be a key driver in fostering, growing, and scaling the engineering organisation.
* Share your extensive experience and technical know-how with other Helsingers. We host tech talks, run "let’s learn together" groups, and host topical office hours (e.g., on Rust) to help the entire engineering team get better with time.
* Maintain and evolve our existing software stack, partnering with internal and external stakeholders to diagnose complex system issues, optimise operational reliability and performance, and systematically address technical debt. Our stack is a mix of Rust and Python, with Python mainly living in the ML-heavy sections.
* Design and develop robust test architectures and benchmarks, both at the micro and macro level. We operate in a domain where robustness is of the utmost importance, and building highly reliable, performance-tested systems is key to achieving that.
* Present and celebrate your work at our weekly demo sessions. We host demo sessions that allow early feedback, celebration of progress, and a better shared understanding of everything that goes on at Helsing.


**You should apply if you**
* Have a proven track record of writing highly legible, maintainable, and performance-optimised systems code.
* Are a systems-level thinker capable of designing for the long term. You can ensure that a complex collection of independent, heterogeneous systems (including those outside your direct control) successfully integrate and function reliably end-to-end.
* Communicate well in English, both verbally and in writing, with the ability to articulate complex architectural decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Thrive in a collaborative, low-ego environment, with extensive experience running pair programming and peer code reviews.
* Are highly comfortable working asynchronously (writing robust PRs, leading design RFCs, and having discussions by email).
* Have seasoned, senior-to-staff level backend development experience, with expert-level mastery in a systems language like Rust, Java, Go, or C++.
* Are a natural multiplier, striving to constantly improve yourself, your peers, and the engineering culture around you.
* Feel like ethical considerations are an inherent part of software engineering.


*Note: We operate at an intersection where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.*
**Nice to have**
* Production-grade Rust and Python specifically.
* Container-based and cloud-native application architectures (e.g., Docker, Azure, AWS).
* Metrics and observability tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
* SQL and high-throughput streaming database systems.
* Low-level routing protocols (e.g., IGP, BGP).
* Cryptographic protocols (e.g., Signal, WireGuard).
* Hardware interfaces (e.g., Arduino).
* Robotics (e.g., control systems).
* Production ML systems and model deployment.


**Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields**
* Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns.
* The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world.
* Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward.
* In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts.
* We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about.


**What We Offer**
* A focus on outcomes, not time-tracking
* Competitive compensation and VSOP options
* Relocation support
* Social and education allowances
* Regular company events and all-hands to bring together employees as one team across Europe
* A hands-on onboarding program (affectionately labelled “Infraduction”), in which you will be building tooling and applications to be used across the company. This is your opportunity to learn our tech stack, explore the company, and learn how we get things done - all whilst working with other engineering teams from day one


*Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.*
 Helsing's Candidate Privacy and Confidentiality Regime can be found here.

title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.
   

  

 We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.
   

  

 Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.
   

  

 Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 As Etraveli Group rapidly expands its agentic AI ecosystem, we are looking for a hands-on engineer to serve as the core technical muscle for our AI Optimization team. In this role, you will rapidly build, test, and evaluate agentic MVPs using Python, APIs, and LLM frameworks. You will design rigorous evaluation pipelines to prove accuracy, latency, and ROI, ensuring all agents align with company principles. Once validated, you will act as the key technical stakeholder translating prototypes into clean specifications for our core Technology team to scale.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Rapid Prototyping & MVP Engineering**
* Build functional end-to-end agents using Python, LLM frameworks, APIs, and databases.
* Spin up infrastructure (vector/relational databases, docker containers) for real-world
* testing.
* Select architectural patterns (API wrappers, lightweight RAG, function calling).
* Iterate based on business feedback and discard when concepts prove unviable.


 Data Rigor & Technical Evaluation
   

  

* Design evaluation pipelines to benchmark accuracy, hallucination rates, latency, and cost.
* Build ground-truth labeled evaluation sets with business owners to validate production
* readiness.
* Analyze discrepancies between agent outputs and human decisions during pilots.
* Support business stakeholders in taking responsibility for prompts and business logic
* Continuously test new AI models and tools against internal benchmarks.


 Feasibility & Technical Discovery
   

  

* Assess operational workflows with strategy teams to determine agentic feasibility and
* scope difficulty.
* Evaluate new agent architectures and AI tooling to recommend core platform adoption.


 Handoff & Platform Stakeholder
   

  

* Serve as the primary technical stakeholder to the core technology AI platform team.
* Translate validated MVPs into clear technical specs, architecture diagrams, and data
* flows.
* Partner with AI platform team to ensure seamless absorption of MVP logic into internal
* SDKs.


**Requirements**
 Must Have
   

  

* 3+ years software engineering experience with strong Python and rapid prototyping skills.
* Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration (tool use, RAG, structured outputs via
* LangChain, LlamaIndex, LiteLLM, or APIs).
* Proficiency in API design, SQL, and relational/vector databases.
* Experience using evaluation frameworks (Ragas, DeepEval, LangSmith) to benchmark
* performance.
* Agile, pragmatic mindset for fast experimentation outside traditional sprint cycles.


 Ability to convert complex business logic into concise specs for engineering teams.
   

  

 Nice to Have
   

  

* Background as a Forward-Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, or similar fast-delivery
* role.
* Familiarity with modern deployment stacks (FastAPI, Docker, serverless).
* Domain experience in travel tech, airline distribution, or payments.
* Basic product management understanding (ROI tracking, KPIs, user validation).


**Benefits**
 The culture at Etraveli Group embraces complexity and we like to keep the entrepreneurial spirit even as we grow into being a larger company. With us you can enjoy:
   

  

* A flexible working environment. We work on a hybrid-model where you can choose to work two days from home and you will have two weeks per year that you can choose to work from a remote location
* Modern office in the heart of the city – A bright and central location with great access to public transport, lunch spots, and parks just around the corner.
* Healthcare allowance – Each employee receives a maximum allowable amount each year according to the Swedish Tax Agency to spend on health-promoting activities such as a gym card, massage etc.
* Pension and health insurance – Through partners we offer a comprehensive pension and health insurance so that you can get help quickly in case of an accident.
* Daily breakfast – To kick the day off just right, breakfast is available at the office every morning.


***As part of this recruitment process, we will be conducting background checks. You will be able to read more information and give your consent to this process in the application form.***
 Diversity disclaimer
