title: MSc Thesis: Eye tracking in Extended Reality (XR) Training
description:
**Background**


Extended Reality (XR) enables safe, repeatable, and scalable training. In Swedish industry, employees can use XR to practice tasks, safety procedures, and work methods before applying them in live operations. Volvo Group has also begun integrating XR solutions into its training portfolio.


As eye tracking becomes standard in modern XR headsets, gaze data offers new ways to understand how trainees visually navigate a task, what information they notice or overlook, and how their attention changes with experience. Potential applications include XR training design, learner feedback, skills assessment, and usability evaluation. However, it remains unclear which use cases provide meaningful value, which metrics are sufficiently reliable for training, and how closely gaze behavior in VR reflects behavior during the same task in a live setting.


This thesis will investigate the use of eye tracking in XR training at Volvo Group. The work will explore relevant applications and use cases, establish guidance for when and how eye tracking should be implemented in XR training, as well as suggest a strategy for how the technology could be scaled across a portfolio of XR trainings targeting a global user group.

 **Description and Goal**


The goal of the thesis is to create a practical and evidence-based blueprint for the use of eye tracking in XR training at Volvo Group. The blueprint should help XR training developers, learning experience partners, and other L&D stakeholders decide when eye tracking is useful, what data should be collected, how the data should be analyzed and visualized, and how eye tracking can be integrated into their training portfolio. The findings should be tested in a developed proof-of-concept, together with users at Volvo Group.


This means that, initially, the work will encompass:

* Exploration of the state-of-the-art in eye tracking technology for XR
* Exploration of eye tracking use cases in industrial training applications
* Identification of relevant gaze metrics and analysis methods for XR training
* Selection and definition of a suitable Volvo Group training
* Development of a proof-of-concept implementation
* A user study carried out on the proof-of-concept
 **Building on this foundation, the expected outcomes include:**

* A blueprint describing how and when eye tracking should be implemented, including recommended metrics, workflow, technical requirements and decision criteria
* A developed proof-of-concept / demonstrator with eye tracking integrated into a selected VR training application
* A user study comparing eye tracking results in VR training with results from a corresponding live production task
 **Application-related information**


Education background: Computer Science, Industrial Design Engineering, Cognitive Science, Production Engineering or similar.


Subject areas: XR, Eye tracking, Education, UX, human-technology interaction, production


Contract: Paid by Volvo Group


Duration and pace: Spring 2027, full-time, 30 ECTS, starting date is flexible and to be agreed upon


Location: Volvo Group Digital Technology & Operations / Volvo Group University / Chalmers


Number of students: 2 students

Last day to apply is 30th October.


We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

 **Who we are and what we believe in**  

We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.


Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join **Volvo Group**. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.

 **Trucks Technology & Industrial Division** hire team players who are ready to create real customer impact. Our decentralized teams work close to our customers, with speed and autonomy, to build what they truly need.  

Join us to collaborate on innovative, sustainable technologies that redefine how we design, build, and deliver value. Bring your curiosity, your expertise, and your collaborative energy, and together, we’ll turn bold ideas into tangible solutions for our customers and contribute to a more sustainable tomorrow.

title: GROUP DESIGN LEADER
description:
### **Job description**


**THE ROLE**


Have you previously worked as a Group Design Leader (GDL), Lead Engineer or Component Owner in the automotive industry? Sigma Industry is now looking for new colleagues to join our team at Lindholmen and for assignments with our customers.


As a GDL or Lead Engineer at Sigma, you will have a role where you are expected to take a high level of responsibility and drive your area forward. We are looking for someone who is used to creating structure, planning and setting priorities – even when all conditions or boundaries are not fully defined. You are comfortable making decisions, bringing the right people together and making sure activities are completed.


You have a good overview and are used to balancing technology, timing and cost. At the same time, you enjoy being close to the technical topics and can easily switch between long-term planning and problems that need to be solved here and now. You do not need to have all the answers yourself, but you know how to find them and how to involve the right people along the way.


The role is varied and suits someone who is comfortable with a high level of responsibility and freedom to act. You are proactive and able to work independently, while also seeing teamwork as a natural part of getting things done. You find it easy to build relationships, communicate clearly and get people involved. You are positive, down-to-earth and willing to step in where needed to help the team move forward.


At Sigma, you will have the opportunity to continue developing within technical project management and product development. We work with several customers and assignments within the automotive industry and are continuously looking for experienced GDLs and Lead Engineers to join our team.


**CHECKLIST**


Everyone is new at some point and will learn many things along the way, but before we start working together, we would prefer that you have previous experience as a Sub-Project Leader, Group Design Leader, Lead Engineer, Design Project Leader or in a similar role.


* B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering, Product Development, Automotive Engineering or a similar field.
* At least 5 years of experience in product development.
* Experience independently driving technical topics and activities.
* Communicative, driven, positive and down-to-earth.
* Used to working with different functions and getting people involved.

Previous experience from CEVT, Lynk & Co or Zeekr is highly valued, as is experience from GDL or Lead Engineer roles at Volvo Cars. Being fluent in spoken and written Swedish is also considered an advantage.


**What can we offer?**
  

As an employee with us, you get the opportunity to work across multiple areas with our clients – essentially the best part of being a consultant – but with the security of a single employer! We deliver specialized expertise in areas such as Product Development, UX & Design, PLM, Industrial IT, Production Engineering, and Project Management. Once on assignment, you’ll either be on-site with a client or working on projects from our lovely office, located in the heart of Lindholmen Science Park.


We enjoy doing things together and strive for a good balance between work and leisure. This could include after-work gatherings, events, fitness activities, ski trips, or inspirational talks. We have shared many fun trips together, and in September 2024 we returned from South Africa(!) where we celebrated 10 years as a consulting company!


Professional development has always been important to us. In addition to opportunities for growth through your consulting assignments and various technical trainings, we offer internal programs for personal development.


We also believe that autonomy, involvement, and influence create the motivation needed for you to achieve your personal goals. Our employees choose to work with us because we share this perspective on careers, the future, and life in general. With us, who you are is just as important as what you do. Our goal is to find a structure that gives you the chance to grow and develop into something great together with our clients.


### **More information**


For more information please contact


Simon Karlsson,
  

simon.karlsson@sigma.se

Industrial Design & Ergonomics, Mechanical Engineering, Project Management

2026-10-05

title: Sr. Technical Project Manager
description:
**YOUR MISSION AT VOI**


As a Senior Technical Project Manager in the Vehicle Hardware Team at Voi, you will lead the procurement and development of next‑generation IoTs, vehicles, batteries and components. You will typically own two parallel hardware procurement projects, steering them from early requirements and supplier selection through development, industrialisation, launch and post‑launch improvements. For IoT projects it is important to have a breadth of competence being able to lead the projects across all workstreams from mechanical hardware to the electronics to the FW. Reporting to the Head of Vehicle HW, you will play a crucial role in ensuring our fleet is safe, reliable, repairable and efficient for our riders and markets.


You will:

* Lead end‑to‑end project management for typically two hardware procurement and development projects in parallel.
* Coordinate Voi teams and suppliers on timelines, milestones, risks, status and next steps to secure on‑time, high‑quality deliveries.
* Translate Voi’s needs into clear goals and technical requirements, and drive evaluation of samples across UX, repairability, reliability, energy efficiency and more.
* Support Voi engineers and suppliers on technical topics, contributing to documents such as DFMEA, PFMEA, FEA, Design for Reliability and Design for Repairability reports.
* Manage structured handling of actions, decisions, accountability and documentation to ensure smooth project progress.
* Present clear, concise project and technical status updates to the executive team, incorporating input from senior leadership (including CEO and CFO) into project plans.
* Build strong relationships and lead tough but constructive discussions and negotiations with suppliers on timelines, quality and technical issues.
* Travel regularly (e.g. quarterly, for a few weeks at a time) to China and occasionally to other supplier locations and Voi markets to work hands‑on with partners and in‑field issues.

**WHAT YOU NEED TO EMBARK**


You are a technically strong, hands‑on project manager who thrives at the intersection of engineering, suppliers, AI tools and business. You enjoy owning complex hardware projects end to end, can zoom between details and the big picture, and communicate confidently with both engineers and executives.


You have:

* A bachelor’s degree or higher in an engineering discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
* Strong experience working closely with hardware suppliers, ideally including Chinese partners.
* Proven experience collaborating with multi‑disciplinary hardware and FW teams (mechanical, electrical, FW, test & verification, certification) as well as procurement, firmware, QA and supply chain.
* Experience leading products especially electronics product through the full lifecycle – from goal setting and requirements through launch and resolving in‑field issues.
* Excellent presentation and communication skills, able to explain technical topics and business trade‑offs to senior stakeholders.
* Strong mechanical engineering understanding, including working with DFMEA, PFMEA, FEA, reliability test reports and hands‑on repairability assessments; CAD/CAE skills are a plus.
* Solid electrical engineering understanding to engage in DFMEA/PFMEA and review reliability test reports.
* Solid electronics and FW understanding to enable leading engineerings in these disciplines
* Excellent analytical and technical problem‑solving skills; being data‑driven and comfortable with SQL is a plus.
* AI‑native working style and confidence using modern AI tools in your daily work to increase speed, structure and quality.
* Fluency in English, both written and spoken; proficiency in Chinese is a strong plus.
* The ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and to work effectively in a fast‑paced, scale‑up environment, collaborating across teams and time zones and travelling when needed.


Don’t meet every requirement? If you are excited about this role and our mission, and have relevant, transferable skills, we encourage you to apply – even if you don’t check every box.

**WHY VOI?**


Working at Voi is more than just a job; our People Promise includes a personal voyage where you will grow as a professional and be a part of a team and culture that builds something meaningful for society. In addition to this you’ll have the opportunity to:

* Join Europe’s #1 micromobility operator and one of the fastest growing scale‑ups.
* Get “skin in the game” through our employee options programme.
* Enjoy unlimited free Voi rides and a dog‑friendly office.
* Work together with inspiring, motivated and fun colleagues towards a common goal.
* Join the micromobility revolution and be a part of creating sustainable cities made for living, free from noise and pollution.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
At Lendo, we are on a mission to empower people to make smart, conscious financial decisions. We are entering an exciting growth phase, expanding our offerings to launch new products and help even more people navigate their financial journeys.


We are looking for an experienced Lead Product Designer to join our Product & Tech Sweden team, reporting directly to the Head of Product & Technology Sweden and joining the Product & Tech Leadership Team. In this role, you will lead and mentor our team of 3 UX designers and establish an elevated, user-first design culture across the company. You aren't just managing UI outputs you will champion service design, facilitate cross-departmental alignment, and shape holistic digital experiences that drive both user delight and business value.

#### **About the role**


As Lead Product Designer, you set the design vision and lead the end-to-end design practice across our ecosystem. You stay close to the daily design reality without micro-managing. You understand operational context, keep track of design deliverables, and step in to help your team navigate blockers, balance priorities, and refine their execution flow.


You combine empowering leadership with high standards for design craft. Whether coaching UX designers in deep problem framing, driving service design initiatives, or actively managing performance, you raise the bar for how design decisions are made across the company. You will be an integral part of the Product & Tech Leadership Team, working within a collaborative product-tech-design triad operating model.

##### **Key Responsibilities**

**People, Leadership & Culture**

* Lead, mentor and coach a team of 3 UX designers, setting high standards for craft, feedback, and continuous learning.
* Provide direction and clear guidance through regular feedback, development talks, and career progression planning.
* Cultivate an inclusive, safe team culture with high psychological safety where innovation and craft excellence go hand in hand.
* Manage performance, individual growth plans, and seniority adjustments in line with company frameworks.

**Service Design & Cross-Functional Facilitation**

* Lead service design initiatives and facilitate cross-departmental discovery workshops to uncover root problems rather than build feature requests.
* Partner closely with key non-design stakeholders (such as call agent managers and operations) to convert complex operational friction into intuitive software solutions.
* Act as an operational bridge between teams, stakeholders, and departments to resolve friction and align user needs with business value.

**Design Strategy & System Leadership**

* Articulate the strategic value of a design system, leading its evolution, governance, and adoption to ensure consistency, speed, and quality across all digital touchpoints.
* Champion user research and structured frameworks (such as the Double Diamond), compiling research into compelling narratives that articulate the "why" to secure organizational buy-in.
* Collaborate within the Product-Tech-Design Leadership Team, partnering with Lead Product Managers and Engineering leads to align user needs with technical feasibility and business goals.
* Explore and integrate modern workflows and AI-driven tools across design, prototyping, and front-end collaboration to accelerate discovery, iteration, and delivery.

#### **About you**

* Experienced Design Leader: You bring **at least 10 years of experience in digital product design**, with **at least 3 years of direct people management** experience leading UX or Product Designers.
* Master of Design Craft & Service Design: You have deep expertise in service design methodologies, end-to-end journey mapping, usability research, and modern frameworks like the Double Diamond.
* Operational & Present: You stay close to the design flow, understand sprint dynamics, and support your team through both high performance and performance management needs.
* Systemic & Strategic Thinker: You look beyond quick feature fixes to understand the broader ecosystem, articulating the strategic value of design systems and scalable user experiences.
* Decisive & Compelling Communicator: You turn complexity into clarity, confidently navigating stakeholder discussions and inspiring teams through research-backed storytelling.
* You speak and write both in Swedish and english.

#### **Ready to join us?**


If you are a design leader who cares deeply about strategy, modern service design, and empowering high-performing teams, we would love to hear from you. Apply today with your CV or LinkedIn profile.

#### **About the recruitment process**


As part of our recruitment process, we may use psychometric testing through **HI Assessments.** We also perform a mandatory background check on all final candidates. We will always inform you as a candidate before the check is carried out.

**We look forward to your application!**

title: Projektledare Digitala applikationer
description:
Är du en projektledare med erfarenhet av att leda byggandet och lanseringen av kund- eller medarbetarvända digitala applikationer på storföretagsnivå Då har du hittat rätt. Definiera och kontinuerligt förfina omfattning, mål, krav och MVP, för att säkerställa överensstämmelse kring vad som ska levereras och varför.
  
  

Utveckla affärsplanen, inklusive förväntat affärsvärde, investeringsbehov, viktiga antaganden och framgångsmått. Etablera projektets organisation, styrning och RACI, vilket säkerställer tydlig ansvarsskyldighet och effektivt beslutsfattande. Skapa och driv leveransfärdplanen och projektplanen, inklusive milstolpar, beroenden, risker och viktiga beslut. Navigera komplexa intressentlandskap, driv beslutsfattande på ledningsnivå och bygg samordning mellan verksamhet och teknik i stora, globala organisationer.
  
  

Tekniska färdigheter Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att leda byggandet och lanseringen av kund- eller medarbetarvända digitala applikationer på storföretagsnivå. Stark förståelse för modern digital produktutveckling, från upptäckt och UX till arkitektur, teknik, integration, testning, driftsättning och implementering. Erfarenhet av att leverera produkter som integreras med flera underliggande plattformar, API: er, datakällor och affärsfunktioner, samtidigt som man skapar en enkel och sammanhängande användarupplevelse. Praktisk erfarenhet av att integrera AI i verkliga användarflöden, och gå bortom fristående chatt eller experiment till AI-aktiverade upplevelser som hjälper användare att prioritera, besluta, hämta information eller vidta åtgärder.

Kunden kan fatta beslut tidigare än sista ansökningsdatum, urval och intervjuer sker löpande. NXT Interim och NXT Rekrytering är ett nischat och innovativt företag som är verksamma inom konsult och rekryteringsbranschen. Vi är verksamma inom HR, IT, Ekonomi, Sälj och Marknad och har över 20 års erfarenhet i branschen. Vi erbjuder våra konsulter bl.a sjukförsäkring, remote-arbetsplatser och flera andra förmåner som förgyller deras vardag.
  
  

Vid anställning tillämpar vi kollektivavtal.

title: Software Engineer / AI Engineer
description:
We're growing our engineering team and looking for both Software Engineers and AI Engineers to help build the next generation of Aleido's platform. Whether your strength is solid, scalable software or applying AI to real products, you'll join a team where AI isn't a side project. It's built into what we deliver and how we build it.

**About the role**


You'll work on Aleido's modular platform for product information, used by some of the world's leading industrial companies to create, manage and deliver technical content. You'll own work from specification to deployment, contribute to technical decisions and help shape how we engineer as a team.

**You'll join us in one of two directions:**

* As a Software Engineer, you'll focus on building high-quality features across the platform: APIs, cloud services and modular architecture on Azure and .NET.
* As an AI Engineer, you'll focus on bringing AI into the platform and our products: LLM-powered features, agent integrations, automation and tooling that turns AI capabilities into measurable customer value.

Both directions share the same foundation and work closely together.

**What you'll do**

* Own development tasks from specification to deployment.
* Write high-quality, scalable and maintainable code, using AI-assisted development to work faster without compromising quality.
* Contribute to design and architecture discussions and propose technical solutions.
* Perform thorough code reviews and contrubute to overall code validation and quality practices.
* Collaborate closely with Product Owners and UX to refine requirements.
* Support platform operations, monitoring and troubleshooting.
* Improve workflows, documentation and engineering standards, including how we work with AI.
* Stay curious about new technologies and help keep our solutions ahead of the curve.
**Who you are**


We believe that you have:

* A strong understanding of software engineering, cloud services and distributed systems.
* Good experience with Azure, .NET or an equivalent modern tech stack.
* An understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and observability.
* A clear grasp of API design, modular architecture and platform patterns.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools in your development work, and genuine interest in where this technology is heading.
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, and a sense of ownership for what you deliver.
* Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Fluency in English, written and spoken.

For the AI Engineer direction, we also expect experience building with LLMs, AI services or frameworks (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI or Azure AI services), and with integrating AI capabilities into .NET applications.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Azure cloud platform.
* Familiarity of AI/ML-enabled systems, including information flow, uncertainty and error propagation, common failure modes, and approaches to troubleshooting and debugging.
* Experience with agentic workflows, MCP or other AI integration patterns.
* Understanding of business process mapping and optimization techniques.
* Familiarity with content management, technical documentation or aftermarket information.
**Who we are**


Aleido is a Swedish international company with a long heritage of driving the development of product information and learning solutions. Our customers develop complex products or systems, or seek knowledge and confidence to create lasting change, within a wide range of industries including automotive, telecom, advanced machinery, rail and medtech. We are almost a thousand colleagues in five countries. Together we bridge the gap between technology and the people who depend on it – by making the advanced simply understood.


You'll be part of a tight-knit and innovative team where your work truly makes a difference. We believe in empowering people, embracing creativity and constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible with software and AI.

title: Senior UX Designer
description:
**Senior UX Designer – AI-ready Warehouse SaaS**
================================================


Ongoing is continuing its journey of profitable growth and is now searching for a **Senior UX Designer – AI-ready Warehouse SaaS**.


Following our investment partnership with Cinven, we are scaling internationally while continuing to strengthen our product, organization, and market position. We are now looking for an experienced UX Designer to shape the software experience for the next generation of Ongoing WMS.


Warehouse management is changing rapidly. AI capabilities, dynamic automation, and software-driven workflows are creating entirely new possibilities for logistics-intensive businesses. At Ongoing, we believe the next generation of SaaS WMS must make complex AI capabilities, predictive data, and dense operational workflows feel intuitive, effortless, and fast for everyday software users.

**About Ongoing**
-----------------


Founded in 2008 and headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden, Ongoing is a leading cloud-native WMS for logistics-intensive companies, including both third-party logistics providers and businesses operating their own warehouses. The platform helps companies manage inventory, fulfilment, customer communication, and warehouse operations with precision, flexibility, and scalability.


Since July 2026, Ongoing has been a portfolio company of Cinven. This marks a new phase of international expansion, product investment, and growth, while maintaining the company culture and customer focus that have made Ongoing successful.

*Join a product organisation where user needs, business goals, and technical possibilities come together to shape the future of warehouse management software.*

**About the position**
----------------------


As Senior UX Designer, you will own and elevate the user experience across Ongoing's software suite as we evolve into an AI-ready SaaS platform. You will be responsible for turning complex operational data, backend logic, and predictive AI capabilities into clean, performant, and low-cognitive-load software interfaces.


You will work across the full design lifecycle—from user discovery and workflow mapping to UI wireframing, high-fidelity prototyping, and design system governance. You will collaborate closely with software developers and product management to ensure our software remains the easiest to use in the industry.


A major part of the role will be helping Ongoing execute its next-generation software vision:

* Designing intuitive software interfaces for an AI-ready SaaS WMS.
* Translating predictive insights, and automated suggestions into actionable UI components.
* Simplifying complex B2B workflows across desktop, web, and mobile browser interfaces.
* Minimizing friction and cognitive fatigue for power users handling high-volume order processing and data analysis.
* Building and maintaining a modern, scalable SaaS design.

**In this role, you will**
--------------------------

* Lead end-to-end UX/UI design for new SaaS features, workflows, and platform capabilities.
* Conduct user research, workflow observation, and usability testing with real warehouse software users and internal stakeholders.
* Produce user flows, wireframes, interactive Figma prototypes, and developer-ready UI specifications.
* Establish human-in-the-loop UX patterns for AI interactions—ensuring software recommendations are clear, trustworthy, and actionable.
* Own and evolve our component-based design system to ensure visual consistency and fast frontend development.
* Partner directly with software development teams to validate technical feasibility and ensure high design implementation quality.
* Work with Head of Product to align design solutions with business objectives and real operational constraints.

*Work side by side with experienced colleagues to understand complex user journeys and transform them into simple, effective solutions.*

**Who we are looking for**
--------------------------


We are looking for a designer who combines systems-level software thinking with strong UI craft skills.


You enjoy taking complex, data-heavy enterprise workflows and crafting software interfaces that feel crisp, logical, and rewarding to use. You are comfortable working alongside software engineers, asking deep questions about system logic, and iterating based on technical constraints and user feedback.


You do not need to know everything about warehousing on day one, but you should be genuinely interested in learning complex business operations and solving usability challenges for mission-critical SaaS platforms.

**Required qualifications**
---------------------------

* 5+ years of experience as a UX Designer, Product Designer, or UI/UX Designer working on enterprise B2B SaaS or complex web applications.
* Proven track record of designing data-dense, web interfaces with high usability standards.
* Proficiency with modern design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma).
* Experience creating, maintaining, or contributing to scalable UI design systems.
* Strong ability to break down complex business rules and data models into clean, structured user interfaces.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating user-centered design methodology, visual polish, and software problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

**Strong merits**
-----------------

* Experience designing UX for AI-assisted tools, predictive dashboards, or automated software workflows.
* Experience with B2B operational platforms, supply chain, logistics, ERP, WMS, or financial software.
* Practical understanding of web technologies (HTML/CSS, frontend component frameworks) and how software components function in production.
* Experience conducting qualitative user research and turning insights into validated UI solutions.
* Communication skills in Swedish or another Scandinavian language.

**Why join Ongoing?**
---------------------


Ongoing has grown by combining deep product knowledge, close customer relationships, and a strong understanding of logistics-intensive businesses.


As Senior UX Designer, you will have a direct impact on how thousands of logistics professionals interact with software every day. You will play a defining role in shaping the visual language and user experience of our platform in an exciting phase of international scaling and AI adoption.


You will join a profitable and growing software company with a strong market position, a collaborative environment, and real ownership over your domain.


Our top-floor ping-pong table is appreciated for breaking off between hard work. Many, but not all, colleagues also like using the health benefits for running, gym, padel, squash, tennis, golf, or other activities.

**Terms**
---------


The position is based at Ongoing's office in Gothenburg and is primarily office-based. We offer competitive terms and benefits, including wellness-related benefits that support an active and healthy lifestyle.

**Start:** January 2027 or by agreement

**Location:** Gothenburg

**Salary:** Fixed base salary and competitive terms

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
**About Us**
 Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
   

  

 Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
   

  

 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to
 **$200M+ in ARR** 
 , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.
   

  

 We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
   

  

 Joining Legora means three things.
   

  

* We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
* We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
* We grow together: as a team and with our customers.


 Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
   

  

 If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
   

  

**The role**
 We’re hiring a Senior Product Designer to shape the core experience of the most intuitive legal platform in the world. You’ll work end-to-end—exploring ideas, crafting clear interfaces, and refining details in close collaboration with engineers. The role is execution-first: your strength lies in turning complex workflows into simple, powerful interfaces, especially as we design new patterns for working with AI.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Design user flows, interactions, and interfaces for AI-powered tools
* Turn ambiguous problems into concrete, high-quality product experiences
* Work hands-on with engineers to bring your designs to life
* Use Figma to design, document, and iterate with speed
* Contribute to—and help scale—our design system
* Push for clarity, consistency, and quality in every corner of the product


**Who You Are**
* Strong experience designing digital products end-to-end
* A portfolio that shows clear thinking, elegant UI, and shipped product work
* Sharp visual skills and attention to detail
* Curiosity about how AI changes user behavior and interfaces
* Pragmatism and a bias toward shipping over theorizing


**Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

title: UX Designer
description:
Att välja Capgemini innebär att du får möjlighet att forma din karriär, ingå i en inspirerande global gemenskap och omdefiniera vad som är möjligt. Inom Digital Customer Experience (DCX) skapar vi smarta lösningar som förbättrar hur människor interagerar med digitala tjänster med hjälp av design, data och teknik. Tillsammans med ledande teknologipartners utvecklar vi innovativa lösningar som gör skillnad för människor och verksamheter och bidrar till en mer hållbar framtid. Bli en del av oss och skapa nästa generations digitala upplevelser!
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Vårt UX-team växer! Vi vill bli fler som gör upplevelserna vi skapar tillsammans med våra användare och kunder ännu mer smidiga, effektiva och älskade.
   

  

*I den här rollen kommer du att ha en central roll i att:*
* Arbeta tillsammans med kunder och utvecklare i tvärfunktionella agila team.
* Bidra med UX-kompetens i både konsultuppdrag och kundprojekt.
* Skapa och utveckla användarupplevelser inom olika branscher och sektorer.
* Vara en del av projekt inom exempelvis detaljhandel, offentlig sektor och fordonsindustrin.


 Vi har ett internt Community, vårt UX Guild där vi samarbetar över regionerna och anordnar lärandeaktiviteter och sociala evenemang. Vi strävar efter att lära oss av varandra samtidigt som vi har det roligt tillsammans. Med en inkluderande kultur omfamnar och stärker vi våra talanger i alla dess olika former och ursprung.
   

  

**Din profil**
* Har minst 4 års erfarenhet som UX/UI-designer eller Product Designer.
* Har god förståelse för användarcentrerade metoder och kan driva designprocessen från research och koncept till färdig lösning.
* Har erfarenhet av att leda workshops, idésessioner och designsprintar samt presentera och förankra designbeslut hos både kunder och kollegor.
* Har erfarenhet av att ta fram användarvänliga, detaljerade och tillgängliga prototyper och mockups.
* Är en kommunikativ lagspelare som inspirerar andra och samarbetar effektivt i tvärfunktionella team.
* Har god förståelse för tillgänglighet och erfarenhet av att skapa digitala lösningar som möter olika användares behov.
* Erfarenhet från fordonsindustrin är meriterande.


**Vad vi tror kommer få dig att trivas**
* En värderingsdriven kultur där Honesty, Boldness, Trust, Freedom, Team Spirit, Fun och Modesty vägleder hur vi arbetar och samarbetar.
* Föräldraförmån.
* Flexibla arbetsförhållanden & Work-from-Home Policy.
* Delaktighet i Capgeminis olika fokusområden; Diversity and Inclusion, Sustainability, Wellness club, Art club etc.
* Generöst friskvårdsbidrag, sjukvårdsförsäkring & tjänstepension.
* Komptensutveckling i form av utbildningar och certifieringar.


**Om Capgemini**
 Capgemini är en AI-driven global partner för affärs- och tekniktransformation som levererar konkret verksamhetsnytta. Vi formar framtiden för organisationer och förverkligar den med hjälp av AI, teknik och människor. Med vår starka historia på nästan 60 år är vi en ansvarsfull och mångsidig koncern med 420 000 medarbetare i över 50 länder. Genom vår expertis inom strategi, teknik, design, ingenjörstjänster och affärsverksamhet levererar vi heltäckande tjänster och lösningar, baserade på vår djupa branschkunskap och vårt omfattande partnernätverk. Koncernen rapporterade globala intäkter på 22,1 miljarder euro för 2024.
   

  

**Make it real** 
 | www.capgemini.com

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
At Lendo, we are on a mission to empower people to make smart, conscious financial decisions. We are entering an exciting growth phase, expanding our offerings to launch new products and help even more people navigate their financial journeys.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced Lead Product Designer to join our Product & Tech Sweden team, reporting directly to the Head of Product & Technology Sweden and joining the Product & Tech Leadership Team. In this role, you will lead and mentor our team of 3 UX designers and establish an elevated, user-first design culture across the company. You aren't just managing UI outputs you will champion service design, facilitate cross-departmental alignment, and shape holistic digital experiences that drive both user delight and business value.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Lead Product Designer, you set the design vision and lead the end-to-end design practice across our ecosystem. You stay close to the daily design reality without micro-managing. You understand operational context, keep track of design deliverables, and step in to help your team navigate blockers, balance priorities, and refine their execution flow.
   

  

 You combine empowering leadership with high standards for design craft. Whether coaching UX designers in deep problem framing, driving service design initiatives, or actively managing performance, you raise the bar for how design decisions are made across the company. You will be an integral part of the Product & Tech Leadership Team, working within a collaborative product-tech-design triad operating model.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
**People, Leadership & Culture**
* Lead, mentor and coach a team of 3 UX designers, setting high standards for craft, feedback, and continuous learning.
* Provide direction and clear guidance through regular feedback, development talks, and career progression planning.
* Cultivate an inclusive, safe team culture with high psychological safety where innovation and craft excellence go hand in hand.
* Manage performance, individual growth plans, and seniority adjustments in line with company frameworks.


**Service Design & Cross-Functional Facilitation**
* Lead service design initiatives and facilitate cross-departmental discovery workshops to uncover root problems rather than build feature requests.
* Partner closely with key non-design stakeholders (such as call agent managers and operations) to convert complex operational friction into intuitive software solutions.
* Act as an operational bridge between teams, stakeholders, and departments to resolve friction and align user needs with business value.


**Design Strategy & System Leadership**
* Articulate the strategic value of a design system, leading its evolution, governance, and adoption to ensure consistency, speed, and quality across all digital touchpoints.
* Champion user research and structured frameworks (such as the Double Diamond), compiling research into compelling narratives that articulate the "why" to secure organizational buy-in.
* Collaborate within the Product-Tech-Design Leadership Team, partnering with Lead Product Managers and Engineering leads to align user needs with technical feasibility and business goals.
* Explore and integrate modern workflows and AI-driven tools across design, prototyping, and front-end collaboration to accelerate discovery, iteration, and delivery.


**About You**
* Experienced Design Leader: You bring at least 10 years of experience in digital product design, with at least 3 years of direct people management experience leading UX or Product Designers.
* Master of Design Craft & Service Design: You have deep expertise in service design methodologies, end-to-end journey mapping, usability research, and modern frameworks like the Double Diamond.
* Operational & Present: You stay close to the design flow, understand sprint dynamics, and support your team through both high performance and performance management needs.
* Systemic & Strategic Thinker: You look beyond quick feature fixes to understand the broader ecosystem, articulating the strategic value of design systems and scalable user experiences.
* Decisive & Compelling Communicator: You turn complexity into clarity, confidently navigating stakeholder discussions and inspiring teams through research-backed storytelling.


****Ready to join us?****
 If you are a design leader who cares deeply about strategy, modern service design, and empowering high-performing teams, we would love to hear from you. Apply today with your CV or LinkedIn profile.
   

  

**About The Recruitment Process**
 As part of our recruitment process, we may use psychometric testing through
 **HI Assessments.** 
 We also perform a mandatory background check on all final candidates. We will always inform you as a candidate before the check is carried out.
   

  

**We look forward to your application!**

title: Head of Design
description:
**Design it. Lead it. Make it the reason customers choose us.** 




 Every day, HR professionals across the Nordics use Simployer One to sort contracts, documents and all the admin tasks that keep a company running. When that work feels easy, their whole week gets better. We want to be the product they'd pick again without thinking twice.
 



  





 At Simployer, we make work-life simpler for both employees and employers. We're building an AI-first company, and design sits right at the centre of that. A new design system is rolling out across the product right now, so there's a lot to shape from day one.
 



  





 Now we're looking for someone who gets excited by questions like:
 


* What would it take for customers to choose us because of how the product feels to use?
* How should a design team work when AI can build a first version in minutes?
* Which five tasks, if we made them twice as fast, would change an HR admin's day the most?



  





 As Head of Design, you'll own design for two of our products. Simployer One, our HR platform. HR admins across the Nordics use it every day to get their work done. And Knowledge which is where they go when they need HR guidance and answers from our experts.
 



  





**Your mission** 




 This is a player-coach role, and it comes in three parts.
 



  





**Design.** 
 You'll own end-to-end design for Simployer One and Knowledge. You'll be hands-on with the highest-impact problems: the heavy admin tasks HR teams handle every week, and the flows full of roles and permissions. The goal is to cut customer effort, so tasks get done faster and with fewer clicks.
 



  





**Design ops.** 
 You'll set how the team works day to day, through research cadence, critique, handoff and quality gates. You'll raise the bar for what a designer at Simployer is expected to do. We've already started rolling out new ways of working, and you'll be the one to make them stick.
 



  





**AI.** 
 You'll lead the team into agent-first design. We've set up a prototype lab, and every designer builds in code on the problem they've chosen to tackle. What we don't have yet are proper design workflows for AI. You'll decide what good looks like, how we evaluate AI output, and where the line sits between what designers own and what agents do.
 



  





  





**You'll thrive here if..** 



* You've spent years designing complex B2B products, the kind with lots of users, roles and moving parts
* Leading a team hasn't stopped you from doing the design work yourself, and you still love it
* Helping designers grow is one of the best parts of the job for you
* Building and prototyping with AI tools is part of how you work every day
* You've designed AI-driven experiences and seen how real users respond to them
* Success to you means what changed for customers and the business
* Design systems are something you've rolled out across teams, and you got people to actually use them
* Time with customers energises you



  





**What you bring:** 




 We're not big on long checklists. There are just a few things you'll need: a portfolio that shows your own recent work, fluent English, and a base in Stockholm or Oslo.
 



  





 If this sounds like your kind of job but you don't tick every box, apply anyway. Strong recent design work matters more to us than a perfect CV.
 



  





**Message from the hiring manager:** 




 Hi, I'm Nima, CPO at Simployer. I've been an entrepreneur most of my career, so I like it when things move. Right now we're figuring out how to design HR software where AI agents actually do work for our customers. Nobody really knows how to do that well yet, which is what makes it fun. I'm looking for a design leader who still designs, not just reviews other people's work, and brings the team along. If you like questioning how things are done and love seeing stuff ship, ping me!
 



  





 —
 *Nima Samimi, Chief Product Officer* 




  





**We can't wait to meet you!**

title: Brand Designer, Web
description:
**TL;DR** 
 — We're seeking an exceptional Brand Designer to own the visual direction and craft of our website. You'll shape how Lovable looks, feels and communicates online - working closely with design engineering and marketing to turn ideas into world-class web experiences.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* 7+ years of experience, with a portfolio of shipped websites that demonstrate strong visual craft and brand thinking
* Portfolio showing landing pages, brand systems, or marketing sites where design decisions clearly serve the story (if your portfolio is mostly product/UI work - check out our other roles)
* A sharp eye for typography, layout, color, and motion, with the taste to know what's on-brand and what isn't
* Comfort designing directly for the web - you think in real breakpoints, real type scales, and real constraints, not just static comps
* Ability to systematise creative choices in design systems - contributing to a shared design system across both product and brand
* Experience partnering closely with design engineers to get explorations into production without losing the soul of the idea
* You’re no stranger to shipping your own designs directly to production - perhaps with a little help from AI
* Ideally - you've got a point of view on where web design is headed and aren't afraid to push for something unexpected
* We’re prioritising candidates based in our new office in New York, to span collaboration hours across both the US and Europe - however we’ll consider exceptional candidates based in London and Stockholm


**What You'll Do**
 In one sentence: Own the visual and brand craft of Lovable's website, making sure every page feels unmistakably Lovable.
   

  

* Design landing pages, campaign sites, and web experiences that make people stop scrolling
* Set and evolve the visual language for lovable.dev - typography, layout systems, imagery, motion principles
* Pair closely with design engineering to translate explorations into scalable, web-native implementations, staying involved through to shipped pixels
* Collaborate with marketing and brand to make sure the website tells the right story at the right moment - launches, campaigns, positioning shifts
* Build and maintain a visual system that keeps the site consistent while leaving room for creative surprises
* Bring a strong opinion on craft and hold the line on quality, even under deadline pressure
* Help define what "world-class" looks like for marketing sites


**How We Hire**
* Fill in a short form then jump on an intro call with a recruiter.
* Show us some of your work you're really proud of.
* Walk us through your process and craft across several design interviews.
* In some cases, we may opt to do paid, trial work.


**About Your Application**
* Please submit your application in English — it's our company language so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join
* We treat all candidates equally — if you're interested please apply through our careers portal

title: Creative Strategist
description:

 SCRL is a mobile-first design platform built for social media and used by millions of creators worldwide.
   

  

 We're a team based in central Stockholm, working closely across functions with a shared commitment to quality, clarity, and craft.

title: Growth Marketing Manager, New Games
description:
**Craft:**
**Job Description:**
 Growth Marketing Manager, New Games
   

  

**Location:** 
 Stockholm, Sweden (On-site)
   

  

**Craft:** 
 Marketing
   

  

**Employment type:** 
 Full time
   

  

**Build the growth engine for King’s next hit**
 New Games is where King explores what is next: new game ideas, new player experiences and new ways to grow. We are looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to sit at the heart of one of our New Games teams and help turn early concepts into games players want to discover, try and keep playing.
   

  

 This is not a traditional, campaign-led marketing role. You will be an embedded, hands-on growth partner from the earliest stages of development - working alongside Product, Design, Engineering, Analytics and Creative to make smarter bets, test them quickly and learn faster.
   

  

 You will bring a growth-hacker mindset: spot an opportunity, form a sharp hypothesis, build the test, read the signals and decide what happens next. Some experiments will not work. That is part of the job. What matters is the quality and speed of the learning, and how you turn it into a better game and a stronger route to market.
   

  

 This is a high-autonomy individual-contributor role for someone who enjoys doing, not delegating. You will be broad across marketing, comfortable picking up work wherever it is needed, and excited to use AI tools to increase the pace and quality of your output. One week you might shape a player proposition, the next launch a creative test, interrogate funnel data or streamline how the team learns from experiments.
   

  

 If you want to help build a game from concept - and get meaningful marketing tests into market within weeks - this could be your next move.
   

  

**Your role within the Kingdom**
 As Growth Marketing Manager, New Games, you will:
   

  

* Embed in a cross-functional game team and influence product, player and growth decisions from concept through launch.
* Identify the biggest growth questions early, turn them into focused hypotheses and run rapid tests to answer them.
* Design and execute marketing experiments across propositions, audiences, channels, creative, store presence and early-player journeys.
* Bring performance marketing thinking into product development, connecting acquisition, conversion, retention and player value to product choices.
* Use player research, market signals, competitor analysis and data to uncover opportunities - and make clear recommendations.
* Partner closely with Product, Analytics, Creative, Development and central King teams to align on priorities, unlock expertise and move work forward.
* Build practical test-and-learn processes that make the team faster, clearer and more effective over time.
* Roll up your sleeves across the marketing mix: briefing creative developing positioning, analysing results, writing test plans and communicating the story behind the data.
* Use AI tools thoughtfully and responsibly to accelerate research, ideation, analysis, production and operational work.
* Communicate decisions and learning clearly to a wide range of stakeholders, creating alignment without slowing momentum.


****What You Will Bring****
**Experience and mindset**
* Experience in growth, performance, product, brand or consumer marketing within games, entertainment, apps or another digital consumer business.
* A demonstrable bias for action: you can take an ambiguous problem, create a plan and deliver a useful first version quickly.
* A test-and-learn mentality. You are comfortable taking smart risks, learning from setbacks and changing course when the evidence says to.
* Strong commercial and analytical instincts, with the ability to turn data into practical next steps.
* Comfort working in a fast-moving, start-up-like environment where priorities evolve and there is no large support team behind every task.
* Confidence collaborating across disciplines and influencing stakeholders with different perspectives.
* Hands-on experience with AI tools, or strong curiosity and evidence that you actively use them to improve how you work.


**Games and player understanding**
* Genuine curiosity about casual games and the people who play them.
* A clear point of view on casual games marketing: what is working, what is broken and what you would test differently.
* If you have not worked extensively in casual games, you can show that you understand the category, its players and the distinct challenges of marketing it.
* Curiosity about culture, entertainment and emerging player behavior - not just established marketing playbooks.


****Who You Are****
 You are likely someone who:
   

  

* Loves the blank page and the momentum of building something new.
* Moves quickly without losing sight of the player or the commercial objective.
* Enjoys wearing many hats and does not wait for a specialist team to make progress.
* Can be strategic and highly practical in the same day.
* Challenges assumptions constructively and brings others with you.
* Sees process improvement as a growth lever, not an administrative exercise.
* Gets energy from close, on-site collaboration with a game team.


**Why New Games at King?**
 You will have the freedom and proximity of a small, ambitious game team, paired with the reach, craft and player understanding of King. Your work will shape real product decisions early when insight, creativity and a great experiment can have an outsized impact.
   

  

 Come help us make the next generation of King games impossible to ignore.
   

  

****About King****
 With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world. For more than 20 years, we have created iconic games including Candy Crush and Farm Heroes Saga. King is part of Microsoft, with Kingsters based in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta.
   

  

****About King****
 With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

title: Projektledare / Produktägare för AI-accelererade team
description:
**Du är en erfaren konsult och ledare av digitala team. Nu vill du vara med på resan till att AI är en självklar del av både lösningen, arbetsflödet och teamet.**
 På B3 Business Transformation driver du projekt- eller produktteam hos välkända kunder – och är samtidigt med och formar nästa generation teamarbete där människor och AI-agenter jobbar sida vid sida. Vi är ca 45 seniora ledarkonsulter i en utvecklande och prestigelös kultur på en prisbelönt arbetsplats.
   

  

 Rollen
   

  

 Du leder team i utvecklingen av digitala produkter och tjänster i komplexa miljöer där digitalisering, data och AI är centrala delar. Teamen kan vara B3s, kundens, underleverantörers eller en kombination och fokus ligger på att skapa mätbar verksamhetsnytta – inte bara leverera funktion – genom att kombinera agil utveckling, användarcentrering och AI-drivna arbetssätt.
   

  

**Om dig**
**För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du**
* Har minst 5 års erfarenhet som projektledare, produktägare eller liknande roll inom digital utveckling
* Har erfarenhet av att arbeta som konsult
* Är van att arbeta agilt, användarcentrerat med god förståelse för det digitala kundmötet och kan leda team i komplexa miljöer
* Använder AI-verktyg enligt nedan
* Trygg kommunikatör som rör dig obehindrat mellan ledning, verksamhet och utveckling
* Flytande svenska och engelska


**Meriterande**
* Relevant akademisk utbildning
* Certifieringar inom AI, SAFe, Scrum, Prosci, PPS etc
* Erfarenhet från våra fokusbranscher: bank/finans, energi, offentlig sektor, medlemsorganisationer eller försvar
* Erfarenhet av roller/uppdrag där generativ AI varit en del av den utvecklade produkten/tjänsten


 AI i din vardag
   

  

* Du gillar att hänga med i den snabba AI-utvecklingen och är hands on i användningen för att effektivisera ditt personliga arbete i rollen
* Du driver och stöttar teamet i att etablera arbetssätt där de använder AI-assistenter smart och säkert, samt med tydlig koppling till nytta och ansvar för etik och påverkan på människor
* Du kan även hjälpa kundens olika stakeholders att interagera effektivt med AI-accelererade utvecklingsteam


 Exempel på uppdrag
   

  

* Vara produktägare för en digital självservicetjänst hos ett finansbolag där uppdraget är både att vidareutveckla tjänsten och att öka kvalitet och effektivitet med AI-baserade verktyg och arbetssätt
* Driva ett förändringsinitiativ för en större myndighet som ska gå från pilot till att skala upp användningen av agenter i Microsoft/CoPilot-miljö


 Varför B3 Business Transformation?
   

  

* Ett prisbelönt konsultbolag: Ambitiöst och prestigelöst med en kultur av samarbete och frihet för seniora konsulter.
* Erfarna kollegor: Du blir del av ett team med seniora projektledare, produktägare och managementkonsulter som delar kunskap och uppdrag och utforskar framtidens teknik, arbetssätt och konsultaffär tillsammans.
* Effektiv och transparent säljprocess: En AI-driven säljprocess inklusive matchning mellan uppdrag och konsulterna, som har full insyn och inflytande.
* B3:s AI-ekosystem: Hos oss får du både uppdrag i framkant och kollegor som vill utforska vad AI betyder för framtidens projektledning, produktutveckling – och konsultrollen i stort.

* Ability to lift, move, and install IT equipment
* Ability to work independently while collaborating with the wider IT team
* A proactive attitude and willingness to learn
  

  

**Bonus points for...**
-----------------------

* Previous experience in an IT support, help desk, or customer service role
* Familiarity with macOS
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, or Intune
* Experience with ticketing systems (e.g., Jira Service Management or ServiceNow)

  

Not sure you meet all the qualifications? Let us decide! Research shows that women and members of other under-represented groups tend to not apply to jobs when they think they may not meet every qualification, when, in fact, they often do! At Activision, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and strongly encourage you to apply.

  

  

**Our World**

  

  

At Activision, we strive to create the most iconic brands in gaming and entertainment. We’re driven by our mission to deliver unrivaled gaming experiences for the world to enjoy, together. We are home to some of the most beloved entertainment franchises including Call of Duty®, Crash Bandicoot™, Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™, and Guitar Hero®. As a leading worldwide developer, publisher and distributor of interactive entertainment and products, our “press start” is simple: delight hundreds of millions of players around the world with innovative, fun, thrilling, and engaging entertainment experiences.

  

  

We’re not just looking back at our decades-long legacy; we’re forging ahead to keep advancing gameplay with some of the most popular titles and sophisticated technology in the world. We have bold ambitions to create the most inclusive company as we know our success comes from the passionate, creative, and diverse teams within our organization.

  

  

We’re in the business of delivering fun and unforgettable entertainment for our player community to enjoy. And our future opportunities have never been greater — this could be your opportunity to level up.

  

  

Ready to Activate Your Future?

title: Service Owner Electronic Lock
description:
Vi är Strawberry. Ett växande universum med hundratals hotell, restauranger, spa och upplevelser i hela Norden, Litauen och på Färöarna. Här ryms urbana Comfort Hotel™, varma Quality Hotel™, stilfulla Clarion Hotel®, hemtrevliga Home Hotel och vägnära Stopover – tillsammans med en stor samling unika och fristående hotell. På sina hotellvistelser samlar våra gäster dessutom Spenn – flexibla poäng att använda till nya upplevelser. Bakom allt står tiotusentals människor från hela världen, med energi, mod och entusiasm.
At Strawberry, we're not just a hotel company - we're building a universe of experiences. We're transforming the hospitality landscape through innovation and technology.


Are you an experienced technical specialist passionate about creating a seamless and secure technology experience?


We are seeking a **Service Owner Electronic Lock** to drive, oversee, and govern the organization's utilization of our electronic lock systems and access control technologies. In this high-responsibility individual contributor role, you will ensure the service is optimized, secure, and aligned with future business needs. You will have full ownership over Strawberry’s electronic locking solutions, acting as the central expert and internal consultant for all access control systems and integrated hardware.

 **What You'll Do:**

**Strategic Innovation & Digital Guest Journey:**

* Align access technology and electronic lock solutions (e.g. mobile keys integration) with our digital guest journey and long-term cloud-first strategy.
* Stay on top of hospitality technology trends and market developments to identify new opportunities and recommend continuous service enhancements.

**System Lifecycle & Optimization:**

* Own, lead, and prioritize technical initiatives to replace aging systems based on lifecycle management, inventory, and end-of-life status.
* Analyze system usage and drive optimization initiatives to ensure hardware and software deliver maximum efficiency and value to hotel operations.

**Vendor Governance & Financial Alignment:**

* Drive vendor management, contract negotiations, and service level agreement (SLA) monitoring to ensure performance matches contractual commitments.
* Align technical initiatives with finance budgets and ensure optimal ROI on technology investments across all hotel properties.

**Service Delivery & Operational Support:**

* Coordinate IT business support to ensure systems meet operational needs and exceed hotel expectations.
* Serve as an advisor on major enterprise projects and act as the 3rd line escalation support for key operational systems (e.g., SOS).

**Collaboration & Process Governance:**

* Work closely with hotels, internal technology teams, and external partners to ensure business requirements are clearly understood, implemented, and validated.
* Establish and maintain standard processes and training programs for hotel staff and IT support to enable seamless adoption and operation.

 **Who You Are:**


We're looking for an expert individual contributor who can bridge the gap between technology and the business.


Subject Matter Expert: You have the ability to independently govern the organization's electronic lock infrastructure and vendor ecosystem with full ownership and accountability.


Collaborative Communicator: You are skilled at maintaining excellent communication with all colleagues, effectively conveying information both up to management and down throughout the organization.

**What You Bring:**

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or equivalent professional experience.

**Technical Expertise:** Deep technical knowledge of electronic lock platforms, mobile access technologies, and integrated hardware solutions.

**Vendor management** expertise

**Advisory Skills:** You are comfortable acting as a central expert and internal advisor .

**Security Mindset:** You are proactive about security, working closely with IT security teams

 **What We Offer:**

**Real Impact:** Be a part of a dynamic transformation and contribute directly to our success story.

**Empowerment:** Work in a flat organization with trust, autonomy, and the opportunity to make a real difference.

**Growth & Development:** Access professional development opportunities to enhance your skills and advance your career.

**Fun & Community:** Enjoy a vibrant work environment with plenty of social events and team-building activities.

**Fantastic Perks:** Benefit from great employee discounts, including staff and friends & family rates at our hotels.

**Flexible Work:** Enjoy the best of both worlds with our hybrid model, with three days of in-person collaboration at our Oslo or Stockholm HQ.

  

We do not offer **remote positions**; candidates must be located in or willing to relocate to Oslo or Stockholm.

title: Testare till Transportstyrelsen
description:
Vi får samhället att fungera för människor på väg, på spår, i luften och på sjön. Därför behöver vi den bästa kompetensen. Vårt uppdrag är viktigt och har betydelse i vardagen – både för privatpersoner och företag. Hos oss tar vi ansvar, behandlar alla på ett bra sätt och har respekt för olikheter. Som medarbetare bidrar du till en hållbar framtid.

**Om jobbet**
-------------


Vill du bidra till samhällsnytta på en arbetsplats med engagerade och stöttande kollegor? Nu har du chansen att få jobba med unika system som verkligen har betydelse för framtiden.


Nu söker vi en testare med placering på enheten Verksamhetsnära it-lösningar 2 och sektion Fordonsuppgifter. Enheten ansvarar för att stötta våra kärnverksamheter inom produktområdena Väg och järnväg och Äga fordon. Även placering i andra produktområden kan vara aktuell för denna roll.


Som testare på Transportstyrelsen är du med i utvecklingen av effektiva, smarta och hållbara lösningar för det svenska samhället. Hos oss kan du förvänta dig samarbete, kunskap och glädje samt goda möjligheter till kompetensutveckling och flera interna karriärmöjligheter. Här finner du gemenskap och nybyggaranda. Du blir en värdefull kollega i ett skickligt agilt utvecklingsteam bestående av erfarna kollegor som arbetar brett med alltifrån kravförståelse, design och implementation till testautomatisering och automatiserade driftsättningar.


Våra team är uppdelade i produktområden och har en egen produktägare som styr backlogen medan teamen tillsammans med övriga roller ansvarar för hur lösningen skall utformas och implementeras. Beredskap ingår i arbetsuppgifterna.

**Hos oss är du viktig**
------------------------


Gillar du att jobba tillsammans med andra och vill du utvecklas i din yrkesroll? Hos oss kan du förvänta dig karriärsutveckling, ett förtroendefullt chefs- och medarbetarskap och ett hållbart arbetsliv. Vi är en trygg arbetsgivare som månar om din hälsa med tid för friskvård på arbetstid, flexibla arbetstider, väl tilltaget antal semesterdagar och lediga klämdagar.


Läs mer om hur det är att jobba på Transportstyrelsen

**Du kommer att**
-----------------

* under eget ansvar ta fram, genomföra och analysera utfall av tester, utvärdera och rapportera testresultat
* skapa, underhålla och exekvera automatiserade testskript med hjälp av verktyg för testautomatisering, exempelvis jMeter, ReadyAPI, SoapUI eller Playwright
* vara med i workshopar och ge support kring lösningar
* stötta och utbilda de agila teamen med testkompetens
* stötta och utbilda användare i våra system
* driva förbättringar och automatisering.

**Du måste ha**
---------------

* en akademisk examen inom it-området eller motsvarande kunskap förvärvad på annat sätt
* flerårig aktuell arbetslivserfarenhet av test
* flerårig aktuell arbetslivserfarenhet från it-området
* kunskaper inom testfallsdesign och testmetodik
* god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska, i tal och skrift.

**Det är meriterande om du också har**
--------------------------------------

* erfarenhet av testautomatisering
* programmeringserfarenhet inom .NET-plattformen
* erfarenhet av agila metoder
* erfarenhet av säkerhets– och prestandatestning.

**Vi vill att du**
------------------

* har ett engagemang och en vilja att utvecklas
* har god analytisk förmåga
* är öppen, har lätt för att ta kontakter, skapa och behålla goda relationer
* är kommunikativ och lyhörd.


Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet.

**Mer information**
-------------------


Anställningen är tillsvidare med placering i Örebro eller Borlänge. Om du blir placerad i Borlänge behöver du vara inställd på att resor förekommer till framför allt Örebro då stora delar av teamen är placerade där.


Tillsättning enligt överenskommelse. Vi tillämpar normalt provanställning. Möjlighet till distansarbete finns utifrån verksamhetens behov. En anställning hos oss kan innebära placering i säkerhetsklass. En säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) kan därför komma att genomföras. För en del av våra arbetsuppgifter i säkerhetsklass krävs svenskt medborgarskap.


Vid frågor är du välkommen att kontakta sektionschefer Emir Dizdarevic, 010-495 6574, emir.dizdarevic@transportstyrelsen.se. ST, Mikaela Schmidt och Saco-S, Benedicte Johansson nås via vår växel på 0771-503 503.


Vi vill inte att annonsörer och bemanningsföretag kontaktar oss.

**Ansök**
---------


Ansök via vår webbplats och bifoga ett komplett CV samt ett personligt brev märkt med referensnummer TSG 2026-9012. Vi behöver din ansökan senast den 23 oktober 2026. Har du skyddade personuppgifter, kontakta rekryterande chef för information om hur du går tillväga. I dina ansökningshandlingar behöver du beskriva på vilket sätt du uppfyller efterfrågade kvalifikationer och meriter kopplat till aktuell rekrytering. Om du går vidare i anställningsprocessen ska alltid utbildnings-/examensbevis samt tjänstgöringsintyg som styrker de kunskaper och erfarenheter som är relevanta för tjänsten uppvisas.


Tryck på följande länk för att ta dig vidare till att söka jobbet Länk I nästa steg kan du sedan trycka på knappen *sök jobbet* till höger


Välkommen att bli vår nya kollega!

**Kort om Transportstyrelsen**  

  

Transportstyrelsen arbetar för att uppnå god tillgänglighet, hög kvalitet, säkra och miljöanpassade transporter inom järnväg, luftfart, sjöfart och väg. Vi tar fram regler, ger tillstånd och följer upp hur de efterlevs. Med hjälp av våra register arbetar vi bland annat med avgifter, tillstånd och ägarbyten.  

  

Läs mer om Transportstyrelsen
