title: Senior System Administrator
description:
**About Univrses**
 Univrses is a Stockholm-based 3D Computer Vision and AI company. We provide the perception and spatial awareness necessary for an increasingly autonomous world. While our roots are in the automotive sector, we have pioneered a new category: Infrastructure Intelligence. Our 3DAI™ system transforms ordinary vehicles into sophisticated mobile sensors, providing road authorities across Europe (Sweden, UK, Italy, and beyond) with real-time, actionable insights. We are shifting city management from reactive repairs to proactive, data-driven maintenance—saving costs, reducing CO2 emissions, and improving public safety.
   

  

**The Role**
 As a Senior Sysadmin at Univrses, you will be the backbone of our technical operations, ensuring that our entire engineering organization has the stable, secure, and scalable infrastructure it needs to thrive.
   

  

 In this role, you will work closely with the CTO to design and maintain a company-wide infrastructure that is both resilient and secure
 **.** 
 You will oversee the cross-functional systems that support all our research, development, and production environments. We are looking for a proactive professional to manage our cloud footprint and on-premise resources, ensuring our team of world-class engineers can work without friction.
   

  

 This is a on-site position since you will be responsible of our on premise infrastructure.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Strategic Infrastructure Support: implement long-term infrastructure roadmaps that prioritize company-wide stability and data security.
* Core Systems Oversight: Design, deploy, and maintain robust server environments (both AWS and on-premise) that support multiple project teams.
* System Reliability & Uptime: Proactively monitor system health and performance across the organization to ensure high availability for all internal and external services.
* Resource Governance: Manage global resource allocation (databases, storage, compute).
* Security & Access Control: Implement and enforce company-wide security.
* Disaster Recovery: Develop and maintain rigorous backup strategies and recovery procedures to protect company data and intellectual property.


**Who You Are**
* Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Experience: 5+ years of experience in Systems Administration, Infrastructure Engineering, or SRE.
* Maintenance Pro: Proven track record in patch management, software distribution, and maintaining system integrity across a fleet of machines.
* Linux Expertise: Deep proficiency in Linux/Unix administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python).
* Networking Specialist: Strong understanding of networking architecture.
* Cloud & Containers: Proven experience managing AWS environments and containerized applications using Docker.
* Reliability Mindset: A "security-first" and "stability-first" approach to managing infrastructure, with the communication skills to report directly to technical leadership.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Familiarity with Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation.
* Monitoring Stacks: Experience setting up company-wide monitoring using Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK.
* Storage Solutions: Experience managing large-scale data storage (S3, NAS, Artifactory).


**What’s in it for You?**
 We provide the environment and the tools for you to do the best work of your career.
   

  

* Responsibility: Become a true stakeholder in a small team where your work actually matters.
* Professional Evolution: You will be working on exciting projects involving game-changing technology with an opportunity to improve the world through autonomy and intelligence
* The "Work-Life" Blend: Enjoy flexible work hours and a culture that values output over "desk time".
* Upsides: A secure Pension Plan and Wellness activities for up to 5 000 SEK per year paid by the company.
* The Univrses Culture:
+ Monday Momentum: Kick off the week with team breakfast.
+ Thursday Knowledge: Weekly Lunch & Learns where internal or external speakers present interesting topics, while the company pays for and caters the lunch to keep your technical and commercial skills sharp.
+ Friday Wind-down: Celebrate the week’s wins with our Friday After Work sessions (free beer from our well-curated beer fridge!)
+ The Workspace: A bright, collaborative office in Stockholm equipped with the essentials (yes, including the mandatory startup ping-pong table).


**Next Steps**
 If you are a systems-oriented thinker who enjoys building stable environments and working at a strategic level to support a high-performing engineering culture, please submit your resume and a cover letter in English!

title: Systemutvecklare
description:
**Var med och utveckla framtidens SaaS för ekonomifunktioner** 




 Vill du arbeta med nyutveckling i ett mindre produktbolag där dina idéer, erfarenheter och tekniska beslut gör verklig skillnad?
 



  





 På Pricka utvecklar vi en växande SaaS-plattform som hjälper ekonomi- och redovisningsteam att effektivisera kontoavstämningar och månadsbokslut. Vi är ett litet och engagerat team där utveckling sker nära produkt, kunder och verksamhet – och där det finns stort utrymme att påverka både tekniken och hur vi bygger vår produkt framåt.
 



 Vi söker nu en engagerad och nyfiken Systemutvecklare som vill vara med och utveckla Pricka vidare.
 



  





**Om rollen** 




 Du arbetar med hela utvecklingskedjan – från idé till implementation, test och release – i ett team som bygger en stabil, användarvänlig och skalbar produkt.
 



 Du kommer bland annat att:
 


* Utveckla ny funktionalitet i vår SaaS‑plattform
* Arbeta med Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Vaadin och Azure
* Utveckla API:er och integrationer
* Delta i test, kvalitetssäkring och automatisering
* Bidra till tekniska vägval och arkitektur
* Utforska AI‑verktyg och nya tekniker för effektivare utveckling



  





 Eftersom vi är ett mindre team får du möjlighet att påverka mer än bara din egen kod. Du är med och diskuterar hur vi bygger produkten, vilka tekniska lösningar vi väljer och hur vi kan arbeta smartare tillsammans.
 



  





**Vem är du?** 




 Du har minst tre års erfarenhet av systemutveckling och trivs med att arbeta över flera delar av stacken. Du gillar att förstå helheten, lösa problem och bygga saker som används på riktigt. Nyfikenhet och vilja att lära är minst lika viktigt som exakt vilka tekniker du behärskar.
 



  





 Vi tror att du har:
 


* Erfarenhet av Java‑backend
* Vana att utveckla och underhålla mjukvaruprodukter
* Förmåga att dela kunskap och samarbeta i mindre team
* Förmåga att arbeta självgående och under eget ansvar
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska
* Erfarenhet av infrastruktur i molnmiljö (t.ex Azure) och förståelse för molnbaserad SaaS‑utveckling



  





**Meriterande:** 



* Erfarenhet av ERP‑, ekonomi‑ eller redovisningssystem
* API‑utveckling och integrationer
* CI/CD, Git, Terraform, Infrastructure as Code
* Intresse för AI‑assisterad utveckling



  





**Varför Pricka?** 




 Vi är ett mindre produktbolag med korta beslutsvägar, nära samarbete och stora möjligheter att påverka. Hos oss blir du en central del av utvecklingen – det du bygger syns, används och gör verklig skillnad för våra kunder. Du arbetar nära produkt och kunder, får förstå problemen vi löser och ser resultatet av det du utvecklar.
 



  





 Hos oss får du:
 


* Påverka arkitekturen – dina erfarenheter och idéer formar våra tekniska vägval.
* Jobba nära produkt och kund – du ser direkt hur din kod skapar värde.
* Stort eget ansvar – kort väg från idé till produktion.
* Bygga en växande SaaS‑plattform – mycket kvar att utveckla, både tekniskt och produktmässigt.



  





 Vi kombinerar hög teknisk kvalitet med pragmatism och vill skapa en produkt som både är omtyckt av användarna och hållbar över tid. Vi utforskar aktivt hur AI kan förbättra både utvecklingsarbetet och funktionerna i produkten – här finns utrymme att testa och omsätta nya idéer i praktiken.
 



  





 Om du gillar nyutveckling, problemlösning, teknik och att arbeta nära både kollegor och produkt tror vi att du kommer trivas hos oss.
 



  





*I denna rekrytering samarbetar Pricka AB med Active Search. För att du som kandidat skall få bästa möjliga kandidatupplevelse, ber vi dig ödmjukt att söka tjänsten i ett första steg så kommer ansvarig rekryterare ta kontakt med dig om du har en matchande profil för tjänsten. Alla ansökningar och kontakter behandlas konfidentiellt. Active Search får inte längre ta emot eller hantera ansökningar som inkommer via mejl då detta strider mot direktiven i GDPR.* 




  





*För att din ansökan ska behandlas måste du skicka in din ansökan via Ansök här i annonsen. Om du har frågor eller funderingar om tjänsten, tveka inte att kontakta rekryteringskonsult Cecilia Jorman på telefon: 073 300 22 72 eller via mail: cecilia@active-search.se*

title: Engineering Manager (AI)
description:
**Lead the team that builds the AI behind largest Nordic Tenant Experience Platform** 




  





 Avy is building the AI operating system for the property industry. The
 **Avy Agent OS** 
 runs AI agents that do real operational work for the Nordics' largest property companies. They follow procedures, use tools and resolve cases from start to finish. Our first agent,
 **Davy** 
 , handles customer support. At one customer, inbound email fell 70%, phone calls 50% and case volume 33%.
 



 We're looking for an
 **Engineering Manager** 
 to lead the
 **AI Platform team** 
 that builds the Agent OS and to scale it to more agents and more customers.
 



  





**The Avy Agent OS** 




 The Agent OS is the shared foundation all our agents run on. It's a layered stack built on each customer's own property hierarchy, residents and contracts. We built the core in-house and use off-the-shelf components where they make sense. Today it runs Davy for tenants and administrators, and AI Insights for property owners. Next come agents for move-outs, repair follow-up and other high-volume processes.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* **Lead and grow** 
 a team of 5–10 engineers working on Avy's core AI platform.
* **Own the AI technical strategy** 
 for the team: agent orchestration, LLM integration, retrieval, evals, observability, and cost and latency trade-offs.
* **Generate code yourself.** 
 You'll contribute hands-on to our Go platform, not only review PRs.
* **Ship AI to production.** 
 Turn prototypes into reliable, measurable features used by hundreds of thousands of people.
* **Partner with Product and Design** 
 to find where AI creates real value for tenants and landlords.
* **Raise the bar.** 
 Improve how we build, test and ship so the team scales without slowing down.



  





**What you bring** 



* 8+ years in software engineering, including 5+ in Go or Java
* 3+ years managing people, plus a track record of technical leadership
* Strong system design skills in cloud-native, integration-heavy architectures
* Hands-on experience building with LLMs: agents, tool use, RAG, prompt and eval pipelines, or similar
* You use AI tools in your own daily work, and you have opinions about them
* Clear communication with engineers, product and business stakeholders
* A degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
* The right to work in Sweden



  





**Nice to have:** 
 an MSc or PhD in CS/ML, frontend experience (Flutter/Dart, React), Terraform, or experience in a matrixed scale-up.
 



  





**Why Avy** 



* Your work reaches
 **500,000+ households** 
 , so the impact is real
* You'll shape the
 **AI direction** 
 of a fast-growing proptech scale-up
* Competitive salary, benefits and room to develop
* An office in central Stockholm



  





*Avy recruits internally for this role. We don't work with external agencies.*

title: Chefsarkitekt - Enterprise Solutions
description:
*Vill du vara med och utveckla gemensamma IT-lösningar som gör verklig skillnad för Länsförsäkringars verksamhet? Som Chefsarkitekt Enterprise Solutions får du en nyckelroll i en verksamhetskritisk domän där du sätter arkitekturell riktning, driver utveckling och omsätter verksamhetsbehov till hållbara lösningar. Rollen kombinerar ett strategiskt ansvar som chefsarkitekt med ett mer operativt uppdrag som lösningsarkitekt, där du arbetar nära både verksamhet och utvecklingsteam.*
**Om jobbet**
 Enterprise Solutions ansvarar för gemensamma IT-lösningar som stödjer LFAB:s interna processer och verksamhetsförmågor. Här ingår bland annat digital arbetsplats och support, dokumenthantering, automation, HR-stöd och systemstöd för mäklarverksamheten.
   

  

 Som Chefsarkitekt Enterprise Solutions ansvarar du för den övergripande arkitekturen inom området och säkerställer att lösningar och plattformar utvecklas i linje med Länsförsäkringars mål och enterprisearkitektur. Samtidigt har du en tydlig lösningsarkitektroll där du arbetar nära team och verksamhet för att omsätta behov till konkreta, värdeskapande lösningar.
   

  

 Du verkar i gränslandet mellan verksamhet, teknik och genomförande, identifierar förbättringsmöjligheter och driver arkitekturella vägval som stärker effektivitet, kvalitet och användbarhet. Du samarbetar tätt med verksamheten, utvecklingsteam, andra arkitekter och centrala funktioner för att skapa samsyn och långsiktigt hållbara lösningar.
   

  

 Rollen ingår i ledningsgruppen för Enterprise Solutions och rapporterar till avdelningschefen.
   

  

**Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter**
* Ansvara för och vidareutveckla den övergripande arkitekturen inom Enterprise Solutions.
* Definiera målbild och riktning för domänens systemstöd och plattformar.
* Kombinera chefsarkitektansvaret med lösningsarkitektuppdrag i initiativ och projekt.
* Omsätta verksamhetsbehov till hållbara, användarvänliga och värdeskapande lösningar.
* Identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter, beroenden och arkitekturella vägval.
* Stödja team och intressenter i arkitektur- och designfrågor.
* Bidra till ökad återanvändbarhet, kvalitet och långsiktig hållbarhet.
* Samarbeta med övriga arkitekter och delar av Digital & IT för att säkerställa en sammanhållen utveckling.


 Vi ser att du har erfarenhet från arkitektroller, exempelvis som chefsarkitekt, enterprisearkitekt eller lösningsarkitekt, och är van att balansera verksamhetsnytta, teknik och långsiktig hållbarhet. Du trivs i komplexa miljöer med många intressenter och har förmåga att skapa tydlighet, samsyn och framdrift.
   

  

 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:
   

  

* digital arbetsplats
* dokumenthantering
* automation
* HR-stöd eller andra verksamhetsnära system
* finans- eller försäkringsbranschen
* molnbaserade plattformar
* större transformationsinitiativ


 Som person är du nyfiken, engagerad och lösningsorienterad. Du bygger förtroende genom ett pragmatiskt arbetssätt och trivs i en roll där du påverkar genom samarbete. För dig handlar arkitektur om att skapa framdrift, bättre beslut och konkret verksamhetsnytta.
   

  

 Vidare ser vi att du är trygg med att kommunicera på både svenska och engelska, såväl i tal som skrift.
   

  

**Om oss**
 Digital & IT inom Länsförsäkringar AB ansvarar för att leverera moderna IT-lösningar och digitala tjänster till de lokala länsförsäkringsbolagen. Inom Enterprise Solutions utvecklar vi gemensamma lösningar som stödjer viktiga delar av verksamheten och bidrar till en effektiv, hållbar och användarvänlig vardag för våra medarbetare.
   

  

 Hos oss får du möjlighet att kombinera strategiskt arkitekturarbete med praktiskt lösningsansvar och vara med och forma framtidens gemensamma IT-lösningar för hela federationen. Välkommen!
   

  

**Kontaktpersoner**
 Rekryterande chef: johan.svardstrom2@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

 Facklig representant Forena: jessica.loow@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

 Facklig representant Akademikerföreningen: lisa-maria.carensjo@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

*Låter det spännande? Då vill vi veta mer om dig! Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag. Vi arbetar löpande med denna rekrytering och kan komma att tillsätta tjänsten innan sista ansökningsdag.*
 Länsförsäkringar AB är en inkluderande arbetsplats där mod, möjligheter och engagemang står i centrum. Vi erbjuder ett hållbart arbetsliv med flexibla villkor och satsar på att alla medarbetare ska kunna växa och trivas, oavsett bakgrund.
   

  

 Digital & IT är hjärtat i Länsförsäkringsgruppens digitala utveckling. Vi driver den gemensamma digitala transformationen och levererar förstklassiga IT-lösningar, datadrivna insikter och innovativa digitala tjänster som skapar värde för hela verksamheten. Vårt uppdrag är att bygga en robust och framtidssäker IT-miljö – både på plats och i molnet – som möjliggör kundnära och effektiva affärer i hela gruppen.
   

  

 Hos oss möts teknik, affär och innovation. Vi arbetar tvärfunktionellt ute i verksamheten i agila team där utveckling, drift och strategi går hand i hand. Vi ansvarar för allt från IT-styrning, enterprisearkitektur och leverantörshantering till applikationsutveckling, cybersäkerhet och verksamhetsberedskap.

title: Senior Solution Architect for ICCF Institutional Global Custody | SEB, Solna
description:
SEB is more than a bank. We are a technology-driven financial institution where everything starts from our customer needs and business outcomes. AI, data and modern engineering are natural parts of how we work, build and deliver value. From core banking platforms to agentic AI, automation, cybersecurity and cloud, we offer a broad tech landscape and many paths to grow. Together, we are shaping secure, responsible and future- proof solutions for our customers and society.
   

  

 Are you passionate about shaping the future of cutting-edge solutions in the financial sector? Do you thrive in an environment where innovation meets real-world challenges? If yes, then we've got an exciting opportunity for you!
   

  

**About Us**
 We are at the forefront of transformation within the ICCF Institutional Global Custody ART, driving the evolution of both new and existing solutions towards our visionary target architecture. Our goal is to deliver unparalleled digital experiences that meet the ever-changing demands of our clients and leverage the latest technological advancements.
   

  

 Our Execution and Post Trade Services (EPTS) domain delivers post-trade products and services to a variety of client types and segments for example, Large Corporates, Financial Institutions, Retail Customers, Private Wealth Management and Family Office.
   

  

**What will you be doing?**
**Lead the way:** 
 As a Solution Architect, you'll be instrumental in guiding our teams towards adopting and implementing our defined architecture in their daily development activities. Your expertise will serve as the compass that ensures we're always moving in the right direction.
   

  

**Build bridges** 
 : You'll act as a trusted advisor, fostering strong partnerships with stakeholders across Business, Business Operations, and Technology. Your insights and recommendations will be crucial in aligning our architecture with the evolving needs of our Custody services.
   

  

**Drive innovation** 
 : Join a tribe that values automation, efficiency, and regulatory compliance. You'll play a pivotal role in developing flexible, modern, and sustainable solutions that empower our customers to achieve their goals.
   

  

**Your responsibility will be to:**
* Work as a solution architect in the ART Institutional Global Custody
* Be part of the architect team in the Custody area
* Be part of the SEB architect community and interact with other architects in relevant parts of SEB to be able to align and materialize your architecture roadmaps.


**To succeed in this role, we believe that you:**
* At least five years of experience from working as an Architect and are passionate about creating business value by establishing robust and flexible architecture that involves different technologies and platforms,
* Experience from working at a bank, a financial institution or similar,
* Enjoy working with both strategic- and operational architecture,
* Have a bachelor’s or master´s degree in a relevant field,
* Are pragmatic in your solution ideas when you need to be and can visualize and clearly articulate consequences of various technologies and platforms (both verbally and in written form),
* Possess excellent networking and communication skills both within business and IT,
* Have a strong interest in keeping updated on the trends in industry and technology
* Understanding of Responsible AI and practical experience with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot,
* Familiarity with generative AI, agentic AI and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and the ability to identify relevant business use cases.
* Experience of working with APIs, GCP, Data, application development and procured IT systems.
* Are fluent in English,
* Have a strong developer background.


**It is an advantage if you have:**
* Have an AI portfolio to show, showcasing your experience in designing or integrating AI-enabled capabilities into secure and scalable enterprise solutions.
* Have an interest in and experience from working with Custody
* Experience from working with securities, equities and/or derivatives


**Do you want to be part of SEB?**
 It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial to our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.
   

  

 Since we select candidates continuously, feel free to send in your application today via the link in this ad, but no later than 2026-10-19. If you have questions about the position, please contact Hiring Manager Lena Dahlgren, by email lena.dahlgren@seb.se, but we will not process applications via email.
   

  

 Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes, for example, identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and criminal records checks. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks.
   

  

 SEB Sweden has a redeployment responsibility, why this position might be covered by internal redeployment
   

  

**Learn more about working at SEB** 
 on our Career website or through our Career podcasts.
   

  

 https://sebgroup.com/career

title: AI Ops Engineer (Marketing)
description:
**TL;DR:** 
 We are looking for a senior engineer with deep marketing knowledge to join Applied AI, the team that rebuilds how Lovable operates as a company. You will work embedded with Marketing and build the AI systems, data, and agents that its teams run on. You will ship production software yourself, on Lovable, with the Applied AI engineers.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* 6+ years building and shipping production software or data systems that people depend on. Recent hands-on work in TypeScript, Python, or SQL.
* Deep marketing knowledge from a marketing organization, a MarTech company, or a product or data role serving marketing teams. You know how paid and social channels, attribution, CRM, content, and positioning work in practice and where they break.
* Experience integrating marketing systems: ad platforms, analytics, CRM or CDP, and content tools. You know their APIs and data well enough to build on them.
* Experience building with LLMs: agents, evaluation, and the judgment to know where a rule-based system does the job better. You can test the quality of model output and make it reliable enough for daily use.
* Strong product judgment. You start from the problem, choose priorities with the people affected, and improve a system through use and feedback.
* Senior stakeholder skills. You work directly with the CMO and Marketing leads, form your own view, and disagree in writing with a better path attached.
* Care for permissions and data handling. Marketing systems touch customer data and spend. You treat access control as a design requirement from day one.
* Comfort building on a high-level platform. We build our internal systems on Lovable itself. Bespoke infrastructure needs a written reason.


**What You'll Do**
* Run a listening tour with Marketing. Map current work, systems, data sources, owners, and the places where expert judgment lives. Propose builds only after that.
* Agree each project with Marketing leadership up front: the problem, the metric, the owner, and the definition of done.
* Connect the context a launch depends on: Linear tickets, internal docs, Slack threads, competitive intel, and usage data. When the scope changes, the change propagates to every asset that mentions it.
* Build agents and workflows for Performance and Social: creative variants, campaign setup, and quality checks against brand guidance, with human review where spend or brand is at stake.
* Encode Brand and Product Marketing judgment into systems: positioning, messaging, and voice guidance that other teams and agents apply without a meeting.
* Connect Marketing's systems to the shared company data layer so agents and workflows can act on trusted data.
* Build on the shared Applied AI foundation and contribute back. Reuse company data contracts, permissions, and agent patterns. Extract what Marketing needs into reusable pieces.
* Launch every system with a named owner, a runbook, access rules, and a review cadence. Teach the Marketing team to operate it without you.
* Measure results with Marketing and use them to decide what to improve, extend, or retire.
* Bring concrete product gaps from internal use to Lovable's product teams.


**How The Role Fits**
 You report into Applied AI and spend most of your time with Marketing. Marketing leadership sets the priorities and owns the results. You agree with them on what to build, how to measure it, and who owns each system once it runs. Applied AI owns the shared foundations you build on: company data contracts, permissions, the information architecture and reusable agent patterns.
   

  

 You work day to day with the Applied AI engineers and with colleagues embedded in Sales, Finance, People, and Support. A capability you build for Marketing often becomes a building block for another function, and the reverse is true too.
   

  

**Our tech stack**
 We build with tools that both humans and AI love.
   

  

* Platform: Lovable itself, Supabase (PostgreSQL), Cloudflare
* Languages: TypeScript, Python, SQL, Go
* AI: Anthropic, OpenAI, MCP, AI agents
* Data: BigQuery
* Marketing systems: the ad platforms, analytics, and CRM tools Marketing already uses


**About Your Application**
 Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join.
   

  

 We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
A hands-on engineering role building and optimising scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and Lakehouse architectures across a modern multi-cloud platform using Python, Spark, Airflow, and dbt.
 



  





 Requires 5+ years of data engineering experience with strong expertise in SQL, CI/CD, data quality frameworks, and cloud technologies (S3, Athena, Redshift), with a plus for streaming and AI tooling experience.
 



  





**Overview** 




 A Senior Data Engineer position within an agile team, focused on building scalable data pipelines and modernizing a multi-cloud data platform. The role involves working with streaming technologies, Lakehouse architectures, and leveraging automation/AI to improve efficiency.
 



  





**What you will do** 




  




* **Pipeline Development:** 
 Build ETL/ELT pipelines (Python, SQL), optimize Spark/PySpark jobs, manage Airflow DAGs, and implement dbt transformations.
* **Lakehouse Architecture:** 
 Design medallion-style architectures using S3 and modern table formats (Iceberg, Delta Lake) with optimized layouts.
* **Platform Infrastructure:** 
 Create reusable frameworks, enforce data contracts, build CI/CD pipelines, and establish observability practices.
* **Data Quality:** 
 Implement validation frameworks, data contracts, and SLIs/SLOs for critical pipelines.



  





**Your experience** 




**Required** 



* **5+ years** 
 in data engineering
* Strong Python, advanced SQL, Airflow, Spark/PySpark, dbt, and CI/CD proficiency
* Experience with Lakehouse architectures, dimensional modeling, and cloud data warehouses (S3, Athena, Redshift)
* Data quality frameworks, monitoring, and schema evolution expertise



**Nice-to-Haves** 



* Streaming platforms (Kafka, Kinesis)
* AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot)
* Terraform, Kubernetes/Docker
* Data catalog/metadata management experience

title: Migration Discovery & Assessment Lead
description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
   

  

**Make it real with Cloud Infrastructure Services (CIS) at Capgemini.**
 At CIS, we enable organizations to transform and thrive in a digital-first world. Our teams deliver end-to-end solutions across cloud, cybersecurity, automation, and user experience – helping clients modernize their infrastructure and unlock innovation at scale.
   

  

**Your role**
 We are looking for an experienced
 **Migration Discovery & Assessment Lead** 
 who will play a key role in large-scale enterprise transformation and cloud migration initiatives. This role is critical in shaping successful migration programs by creating clarity, structure, and direction at the very start of the journey.
   

  

 As Migration Discovery & Assessment Lead, you will be responsible for understanding complex enterprise IT landscapes, translating data into insights, and turning those insights into clear, executable migration roadmaps that align technology with business goals.
   

  

**You will:**
* Lead discovery and assessment activities for large enterprise environments, covering applications, infrastructure, platforms, and dependencies
* Collect, structure, and analyze large volumes of data from multiple sources such as CMDBs, discovery tools, workshops, and interviews
* Assess on premises and cloud environments and define target-state migration strategies
* Design and present migration roadmaps, including migration waves, dependencies, risks, recommended migration approaches, and associated cost and TCO considerations
* Translate technical findings into clear, decision-ready proposals, including TCO analysis and migration business cases, for architects, IT leadership, and business stakeholders
* Act as a trusted advisor to clients, helping them understand what to migrate, how to migrate, and in which order
* Collaborate with architects, engineers, and business representatives to ensure alignment between technical feasibility, financial viability, and business priorities


**Your profile**
 We are looking for someone who combines strong analytical skills, broad technical knowledge, and excellent communication abilities.
   

  

**You also have:**
* Proven experience leading discovery and assessment phases in enterprise migration projects
* Strong background in on premises infrastructure (data centers, servers, networks, storage, virtualization, operating systems)
* Solid experience with public cloud platforms (Azure, AWS and/or GCP) and cloud migration concepts
* Hands-on experience with one or more migration and discovery tools, such as Azure Migrate, AWS Application Discovery Service, AWS Application Migration Service (MGN), Cast Highlight, Cast Imaging, Cloudamize, and Txture
* Ability to work with complex data sets and transform them into structured insights and actionable recommendations
* Full working proficiency in both Swedish and English


**What We Believe You Will Enjoy About Working Here**
* A challenging career in a vibrant environment with access to extensive training, a global network of experts, and an innovative culture that promotes learning, growth, and shared success
* Work on large, business-critical transformation programs, helping organizations modernize their IT landscapes and move confidently toward the future
* A company culture driven by core values: Honesty, Trust, Freedom, Team Spirit, Modesty, Fun, and Boldness
* A strong commitment to inclusion, diversity, and supporting the whole person

title: Senior Engineering Manager - Warehouse Technology
description:
**Job Description**

**ABOUT THE ROLE**
  

 At H&M Group, we believe technology plays a key role in enabling creativity, sustainability, and scale across our brands. Our logistics technology landscape is central to that journey, enabling reliable, efficient, and increasingly automated warehouse operations across our global network.
   

  





 We are now looking for a Senior Engineering Manager for Warehouse Technology, a new role within the Gray Box product area that supports technology in highly automated, omnichannel warehouses. This is an opportunity to lead engineering delivery across complex warehouse environments and help ensure that systems, automation, infrastructure, and partner solutions work effectively from end to end.
   

  

  

  

 Please note, that this is a Senior Individual contributor role and will have the opportunity to lead through influence rather than formal staff responsibility.
   

  





**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  

 As Senior Engineering Manager, you will take on a senior individual contributor role focused on leading engineering delivery rather than formal people management. You will drive the day-to-day technical execution of a large, distributed team during a major warehouse implementation phase and be accountable for delivery outcomes, while line management and direct people responsibilities remain with our competence managers.
   

  





 Your mission is to create clarity across a complex technology landscape, align internal teams and external partners, and ensure that the solutions delivered meet our standards for security, reliability, supportability, and operational performance. You will work closely with the Product Manager and influence technical priorities through expertise, structure, and delivery leadership rather than through formal reporting lines.
   

  





 The team currently includes more than 30 engineers distributed across Sweden, India, and Eastern Europe. Periodic travel and presence at warehouse locations, particularly in Eastern Europe, will be an important part of building context, supporting delivery, and enabling strong collaboration across teams and partners.
   

  





**WHAT YOU WILL DO**




 • Lead the daily engineering delivery of a large, distributed team across complex warehouse technology initiatives
   

  





 • Own end-to-end technical coherence across warehouse management, execution, automation, network, infrastructure, and partner-provided services
   

  





 • Partner with the Product Manager to align engineering priorities, product direction, and business outcomes
   

  





 • Ensure solutions align with H&M Group standards, security guidelines, and infrastructure guardrails
   

  





 • Guide technical decisions involving SAP Extended Warehouse Management, warehouse execution technologies, automation, and systems integration
   

  





 • Work directly with vendors and technology partners, creating transparency, clear expectations, and shared accountability for delivery
   

  





 • Build strong relationships with internal core technology teams that provide enabling services, including network and infrastructure capabilities
   

  





 • Collaborate with warehouse leaders, business experts, and operational stakeholders to connect technology performance with business needs
   

  





 • Establish robust processes for KPI tracking, issue resolution, operational follow-up, and continuous improvement after go-live
   

  





 • Provide visible and proactive leadership at warehouse sites when needed, helping the team move from learning and understanding into strong execution and delivery
   

  





**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**
  

 You will be a part of the Warehouse Area under the Supply Chain Tech and work in close partnership with the Product Manager and collaborate with engineers, competence managers, internal core technology teams, warehouse leaders, business experts, vendors, and implementation partners.
   

  





**WHO YOU ARE**
  

 We believe you are a senior engineering leader with hands-on experience delivering technology solutions in complex warehouses, logistics, or supply chain environments. You understand how warehouse operations, business processes, software systems, automation platforms, and infrastructure come together to create reliable end-to-end solutions at scale.
   

  





 You likely bring experience in several of the following areas:
   

  





*Warehouse & Supply Chain Technology*



* Deep understanding of Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), preferably SAP Extended Warehouse Management (SAP EWM)


* Experience integrating SAP EWM with surrounding enterprise systems, automation platforms, and warehouse execution technologies


* Knowledge of logistics, fulfillment, distribution center, or warehouse operations and the technology supporting them


* Experience supporting large-scale warehouse implementations, go-lives, or operational transformations


* Understanding of warehouse execution processes


* Experience from warehouse automation technology including robotics, ASRS, and sortation systems



*Systems Integration & Enterprise Architecture*



* Strong experience in designing or governing integrations across multiple technology domains


* Ability to understand and manage dependencies between business applications, automation systems, networks, infrastructure, and partner-provided solutions


* Experience working with APIs, middleware, event-driven architectures, or enterprise integration platforms


* Understanding of technical governance, security requirements, infrastructure standards, and operational support models



*Engineering Delivery Leadership*



* Proven experience leading large, distributed engineering teams through complex delivery programs


* Experience coordinating engineers, consultants, vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders across multiple locations and time zones


* Ability to drive engineering execution, technical decision-making, prioritization, risk management, and delivery outcomes


* Experience leading through influence in environments where formal people management responsibilities are separate from delivery leadership



*Stakeholder & Partner Management*



* Experience collaborating with Product Managers, business stakeholders, operations leaders, technology teams, and external partners


* Ability to translate technical complexity into business impact and operational outcomes


* Strong vendor management skills with experience holding implementation partners accountable for delivery and service quality



**WHO WE ARE**
  

 H&M is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.
   

  





 We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.
   

  





 Help us re-imagine fashion and together we will re-shape our industry. Learn more about H&M here.
   

  





**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE**



* At H&M Group, we’re proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company where people can grow and make an impact.


* All our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program (HIP)


* Staff discount usable across all H&M Group brands, in stores and online


* Work-life balance, 30 days’ vacation, and wellness allowance of 4000 SEK/year


* Access to Benify for discounts on gym memberships, travel, hotels, and more


* Compensation boost during parental leave



**JOIN US**
  

 Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it is our people who make us who we are.
   

  





 This is a full-time, permanent position, starting as soon as possible according to the agreement. This is a hybrid position and based in Stockholm, Sweden where close collaboration with stakeholders is an important part of the role. We cannot provide relocation support or visa assistance for this role now and focusing on talents currently based in Sweden.
   

  





 Apply by submitting your CV in English as soon as possible.
   

  





*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter.*




 Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. We are eager to meet with you.

title: Advisory AI Data Specialist
description:
Within the Forward Deployment Engineering (FDE) Unit, the Advisory AI Data Specialist is the data expert who makes customer data ready for AI and GenAI workloads. You focus on removing data bottlenecks so FDE Units can move quickly from concept to live, value-generating AI workloads on Dell infrastructure. We will prioritise passionate individuals who share our excitement to drive human progress through technology.
   

  

 Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as an
 **Advisory AI Data Specialist** 
 on our
 **Forward Deployment Engineering (FDE)** 
 Team in
 **Solna, Sweden/Oslo, Norway/Copenhagen, Demark/Helsinki, Finland.**
**What You'll Achieve**
 You will work with customer teams to map data landscapes, build integrations and pipelines, and configure governance and access controls so that data used in proofs of value is secure, compliant, and scalable to production.
   

  

**You Will:**
* Lead data readiness assessments for FDE engagements, including cataloging data assets, ownership, quality, accessibility, and AI suitability
* Perform hands-on data integration and transformation work to prepare AI-ready datasets for PoV and production solutions
* Design and configure data governance and compliance controls (e.g., access control, sensitive data handling, retention, auditability) in line with regulatory and organizational needs
* Define integration patterns and pipelines that deliver AI-ready data with appropriate security, risk, and privacy controls
* Ensure PoV pipelines are production-aware from the start, including patterns for monitoring, reliability, performance, and maintainability
* Collaborate closely with AI Architects to align data flows with the AI software stack and avoid data-related blockers
* Work with AI Strategists and customer stakeholders to align data work with AI governance frameworks, operating models, and stewardship processes
* Contribute to documentation such as data flow diagrams, data catalogs, governance artifacts, and runbooks for AI data operations
* Coach customer data engineers and platform teams on building and maintaining AI-ready data pipelines and governance practices


**Take the first step towards your dream career**
 Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here's what we are looking for with this role:
   

  

**Essential Requirements**
* 4-8 or more years in data engineering, analytics platforms, or AI data roles within large or complex organizations
* Experience running data readiness assessments and preparing data for analytics or AI use cases
* Hands-on skills in building data integrations and ETL/ELT processes and transforming raw data into AI-ready formats
* Experience configuring data governance and compliance controls for secure and compliant use of data, including sensitive data
* Proven ability to scale data pipelines from pilot to production while maintaining performance, reliability, and compliance
* Clear written and verbal communication skills to explain data flows, governance decisions, and operational requirements to technical and non-technical audiences
* Ability to interact with senior business leaders within large Enterprise organisations and companies
* Ability to travel to customer sites and Dell locations as needed, in line with business requirements and applicable laws and Dell policies. Potential sites may include Nordics, Europe, Middle East, Africa, USA & United Kingdom, therefore the applicant must have the ability to attend business meetings in these locations
* Finnish / Nordics language skills
* Proficient in English


**Desirable Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data/Information Management, Engineering, or a related field
* Experience delivering production data pipelines and integrations for analytics or AI/ML use cases
* Familiarity with modern data platforms, ETL/ELT tooling, and AI/ML-related data patterns (e.g., feature stores, vectorization, RAG-related data flows)
* Experience collaborating with security, compliance, architecture, and business stakeholders on data and AI initiatives

title: Product owner - Tieto Caretech (m/f/d)
description:
Skellefteå, Sweden


* Full-time
* Delivery, Project and Product Management
* Hybrid
* Tieto Caretech

  
Job Description **At Tieto Caretech you’ll get a chance to provide patients and end users with product offerings that help them in their life, reinventing the world for good. If that sounds interesting, please keep on reading.**

  

**About us Tieto**


Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency - have more time to care.


We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from intensive care to laboratory and social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need.

  

**About the role**


Do you want to work with a modern product portfolio for the next generation of offering to our welfare industry and society? Do you have deep domain knowledge about the municipality’s welfare and social care? Do you have experience of working as an economist in a municipality or have been working in Lifecare or a similar system?


As part of our growth strategy, we are seeking a skilled Product owner that help us to continue to build the best solutions for the Swedish municipal Health & Care market.


As part of our Lifecare product team, you will primarily be responsible for the portfolio's solution towards the Swedish municipal Health & Care market in the area of Compensation Welfare technology (Lifecare Ersättning). You will help build our product portfolio from existing ideas, develop new ideas / offers based on your experiences, our customers' needs and wishes as well as changes and requirements from the market. We are today the market leader in the area, and this is a position we intend to maintain in the future.  



**We are looking for someone with**

* Knowledge of how municipalities pay reimbursements/compensations to both municipal and private service providers. If you also have knowledge of municipal elderly care fees is a plus.
* Experience of working as an economist, controller or similar in a municipality or have been working in Lifecare or a similar system
* Pedagogic skills so our customer business demands can be explained for our more technical skilled employees working with the product development
* Deep domain knowledge primarily of the Swedish welfare and social care landscape, knowledge about the Nordic and European market is a plus.
* Good knowledge of current legislation and the National Board of Health and Welfare's processes.
* Knowledge of how personal data should be handled, and guidelines linked to GDPR.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to express yourself clearly in writing and in meetings; excellent command of English and fluency in spoken and written Swedish

 **It would be beneficial if you also**

* Have a degree in economics or equivalent with broad experience of municipal health and social care.
* Are analytical and at the same time have an eye to see the big picture.
* Have experience from and knowledge of the municipality's welfare services, work processes and legislation experience from product development such as backlog, prioritization and description of the solution.
* Have experience in product management, project management or similar.

 **As a person you are**

* A committed team player with a business mindset, who loves to drive things forward and provide high service to our customers. Working as a product owner means being a leader without being a manager.
* Always eager to learn more and enjoy sharing and increasing your knowledge while working with others collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment. You get motivated by achieving results and like to work together with others as well as independently with the ability to work under pressure.
* Driven, self-motivated and can make strategic decisions.

A good communicator with a positive attitude and a sense of teamwork.  
* 

**AI knowledge requirement**


AI literacy is expected for this role. You will be comfortable using approved AI tools to improve quality and productivity in everyday work (e.g., drafting, summarising, analysing, and automating routine tasks). You can write clear prompts/instructions, critically evaluate and validate AI outputs, and apply sound judgement when results are incomplete, biased, or incorrect. You understand and follow company policies and applicable legal/regulatory requirements for confidentiality, privacy, security, and responsible AI use (including not sharing sensitive data in unapproved tools).

 **What’s in it for you?**


With us you will be part of the important and meaningful work of developing healthcare for all of us. You have an important mission to make a difference that really matters. In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, open and friendly culture, and an outstanding work-life balance! We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.


Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in. For example, we host an annual ‘Keep Learning Week’, a week where everyone at Tieto has the possibility to join different training courses in a truly global setting.

 **Could you be our new colleague?**

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring manager Åsa Olsson [asa.l.olsson@tieto.com]

 *We perform background checks on all final candidates.*

*Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.*

  

Additional Information  

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.  

Diversity, equity and inclusion | Sustainability | Tieto

**Stay alert to recruitment scams:**  

* Tieto only communicates via **@tieto.com** email addresses.
* We never ask candidates to pay fees or share financial details during recruitment.
* If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Tieto, don't respond — verify it via our official careers site.
* For more information visit Important Advisory Regarding Recruitment Fraud | Tieto Blog

Our around 14 000 talented vertical software, design, cloud and AI experts are dedicated to empowering our customers to succeed and innovate with latest technology.


Tieto’s annual revenue is approximately EUR 2 billion. The company’s shares are listed on the NASDAQ exchange in Helsinki and Stockholm, as well as on Oslo Børs.

title: Receptionist Scandic Örebro Central, extra vid behov
description:
Ansök nu
* Ansök senast: 25 oktober 2026
* Örebro
* Arbete på plats
**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------


Bredvid Resecentrum växer Örebros nya entré fram och upp mot himlen. Här huserar nya Scandic Örebro Central, beläget mitt i den vibrerande stadsdelen som växer fram och där hotellet blir knutpunkten. Hotellet har 160 rum och öppnade i mars 2022. Ett par stenkast från hotellentrén anländer tåg från alla väderstreck och länkar ihop den gamla skostaden med Stockholm, Oslo och Göteborg. Genomgående för det nya kvarteret är hållbart byggande, vilket letar sig in i Scandic Örebro Central i allt från konstruktion och hotellrum till mat och dryck. Hotellet är ett intimt, flexibelt och levande hotell med ett hjärta som bultar för personlig service. Lobbyn är utformad som ett vardagsrum, avdelat med gröna gardiner av växtlighet och strösslat med mjuka fåtöljer och bekväma stolar för att bjuda in till lika delar arbete och fritid.


Här kan våra gäster koppla av med en bit mat, dricka något gott eller ta ett digitalt möte. I den varma, öppna lobbyn samsas hållbara material med tidlösa värden och nytänkande designlösningar.


**Nu söker vi en Receptionist till Scandic Örebro Central.**


Oavsett varför gästen kommer till oss är det få saker som är så uppskattade som ett vänligt ansikte som hälsar välkommen. Du agerar värd tillsammans med övriga teamet på hotellet och skapar en gästupplevelse i världsklass.


Hos oss får du ta ett stort eget ansvar för att ta de beslut som krävs för att göra gästen nöjd och teamen utvecklar och förbättrar arbetssätt och service i takt med att omvärlden förändras. Vi är nämligen övertygade om att det är när du får utvecklas och bidra med all din kompetens och erfarenhet som vi överträffar gästens förväntningar. På köpet får vi kul på jobbet!


Så ta med dig dina erfarenheter, ditt engagemang och ditt sätt att tänka till oss – och bidra till en kultur där vi bryr oss på riktigt: om varandra, våra gäster och vår planet. Välkommen till Scandic!


**Vad är innebär rollen?**


Du som arbetar i receptionen är ansvarig för att våra gäster får service i världsklass. Du är spindeln i nätet som ser till att gästen alltid är i fokus. Du är den som går igenom ankomstlistan och lägger tid på detaljerna. Ser till att gästens önskemål uppfylls. Du har alltid ett leende på läpparna och en kreativ lösning i bakfickan. Du löser det mesta och är en stjärna på att vända en missnöjd gäst till en nöjd gäst. Din arbetsplats är vår lobby. För det är där du möter flest gäster. I ansvarsområdet ingår även administrativt arbete, säkerhetsarbete och arbete med försäljning.


Arbetet i receptionen innebär att checka in och ut hotellets gäster, hälsa välkommen och ge gästen den information den behöver om sin vistelse. Du hanterar bokningar i systemet Opera Cloud och hanterar administrativa uppgifter runt gäster och säkerhet. Allt arbete sker med gästnöjdhet och försäljning i fokus.


Hotellet har öppet dygnet runt och det är därför viktigt att du trivs med att arbeta i skift (förmiddagar, eftermiddagar och helger).


**Vem är du?**


För att passa i rollen tror vi att du har en väl utvecklad social förmåga och är kapabel att hantera att det händer många olika saker samtidigt. Det är mycket viktigt att du kan förmedla ett gott värdskap till hotellets gäster.


Du har också vana och kunskap i att arbeta med dator som arbetsredskap.


Eftersom arbetet till stor del består av att kommunicera med gäster är goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska en förutsättning. Talar du ytterligare ett språk är det meriterande.


Allra viktigast är dock dina personliga egenskaper och din inställning. För att passa i rollen behöver du vara en lyhörd och prestigelös lagspelare som tar ett stort ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och helhetsresultatet.


**Information om tjänsten**


Tjänsten är en anställning för enstaka dagar på extra vid behov.


Vi tillämpar provanställning och din närmsta chef kommer att vara Front Office Manager. Arbetet omfattar både dag- ,kväll - och nattskift under både vardagar och helger.


Vi ser att du som söker har fyllt 20 år.


Vi tar enbart emot ansökningar via vår hemsida. Alla ansökningar kommer att behandlas löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, varför vi ber dig att ansöka så snart som möjligt. I denna rekrytering använder vi oss av ett enklare test om service vid urvalet.


Vi ser fram emot att välkomna dig till oss på Scandic!


Ps. på vår hemsida kan du läsa mer om vår kultur, vad tjänsten innebär och om våra förmåner!

title: Product Engineer
description:
Modern data platforms are built on events - well-defined, trustworthy signals that describe how users interact with products and systems over time. As a Data Engineer you will help build and improve the data platform that powers analytics, growth, personalization and decision-making across the company. This role is part of the Data Platform team, where we design and maintain the core data infrastructure that serves Product, Marketing, Growth, and Analytics. You will focus on the systems and infrastructure that supports transforming batch and streaming data into high-quality datasets that downstream systems - from warehouses to activation tools - can rely on.
  
  

We are currently in the early stages of building out a new event-driven architecture, and this role will be part of shaping it. That means owning parts of the streaming infrastructure, contributing to foundational decisions about how events are structured and evolved, and having real influence over how data flows across the company for years to come. This is a hybrid/onsite role located in Stockholm, our guideline is to spend 3 days a week at our office. What you’ll do Design and operate data infrastructure (streaming and batch) and the systems that move data reliably at scale.
  
  

Contribute to how events are defined, structured, and evolved across the platform. Ensure data quality, consistency, and observability across event pipelines. Ensure GDPR and PII compliance across data flows at scale. Contribute to data and architecture best practices that may span across the whole organisation.
  
  

Who you are A few years of experience as a Data Engineer or data-heavy backend engineer. Solid programming and data skills (e.g. SQL, Python, and/or JVM-based languages). Experience building and maintaining data pipelines in a modern cloud data stack.
  
  

Experience managing infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform or similar). A good understanding of data quality, observability, and reliability. Clear written communication skills in English and comfort working cross-functionally.
  
  

Experience with streaming systems or near real-time data infrastructure (e.g. Kafka, Flink, or similar). Location: This is a hybrid/on-site role at Mentimeter HQ in Stockholm, where we expect you to be in the office at least 3 days/week. Please note that we do not offer relocation sponsorship for the position.
  
  

**Not Required:** You don’t have to know Swedish (daily work is carried out in English and the Mentimeter team currently boasts over 50 nationalities!)

title: AI Engineer
description:
Som AI Engineer på CGI blir du en del av team som utvecklar och implementerar moderna AI lösningar för våra kunder. Du arbetar genom hela den tekniska livscykeln, från prototyp och experimentering till integration, produktionssättning, utvärdering och vidareutveckling.  

  

Rollen har ett tydligt engineering fokus. Du kommer att skriva kod, bygga AI komponenter, integrera modeller och datakällor samt säkerställa att lösningarna fungerar stabilt och säkert i kundernas IT miljöer.

**Dina framtida arbetsuppgifter**


Du kommer bland annat att:  

  

. Designa, utveckla och produktionssätta lösningar baserade på generativ AI och Large Language Models (LLM).  

. Bygga AI applikationer och AI agenter som kan använda data, API och externa verktyg.  

. Utveckla Retrieval Augmented Generation lösningar (RAG) för att kombinera språkmodeller med verksamhetsspecifik information.  

. Integrera AI lösningar med befintliga applikationer, dataplattformar och enterprise system.  

. Arbeta med prompt engineering, context engineering, embeddings och vector search.  

. Utvärdera modeller och AI lösningar utifrån kvalitet, precision, prestanda, kostnad och säkerhet.  

. Bygga mekanismer för logging, monitoring, tracing och observability av AI lösningar.  

. Utveckla API och backend komponenter för AI baserade tjänster.  

. Automatisera deployment och bidra till CI/CD och MLOps/LLMOps flöden.  

. Samarbeta med andra utvecklare, data engineers, architects och AI specialister för att ta lösningar från idé till produktion.

**Kvalifikationer för att bli framgångsrik denna roll**


Vi söker dig som framför allt gillar att bygga. Du är nyfiken på den snabba utvecklingen inom AI, men har samtidigt ett starkt software engineering perspektiv och förstår att en fungerande demo bara är början.  

  

Du tycker om att experimentera med nya modeller och tekniker, samtidigt som du värdesätter strukturerad kod, testbarhet, säkerhet, skalbarhet och långsiktig förvaltning.  

  

Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av flera av följande områden:  

  

. Python och modern software engineering  

. Generativ AI och Large Language Models  

. Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry eller motsvarande plattformar  

. RAG, embeddings och vector databases  

. Prompt engineering och context engineering  

. AI agents och agentic workflows  

. Frameworks som Semantic Kernel, LangChain/LangGraph eller motsvarande  

. REST API och integrationer  

. Git, CI/CD och containerteknik  

. Cloudplattformar, gärna Microsoft Azure  

. Databaser och databehandling  

. Evaluation, monitoring och observability för AI system  

  

Erfarenhet av exempelvis Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, PyTorch, Hugging Face, Databricks eller MLOps/LLMOps är meriterande.  

  

För rollen behöver du kunna kommunicera obehindrat på svenska, både i tal och skrift.  

  

Vi värdesätter engineering. För oss handlar AI Engineering inte bara om att välja rätt modell eller skriva en bra prompt. Det handlar om att bygga hela lösningen runt modellen. Vi söker därför dig som funderar på frågor som:  

  

Hur får vi modellen att använda rätt data? Hur utvärderar vi kvaliteten? Hur integrerar vi lösningen med befintliga system? Hur hanterar vi latency och kostnad? Hur monitorerar vi lösningen i produktion? Och hur bygger vi den på ett säkert och skalbart sätt? Det är där du kommer in.  

  

Varför CGI?  

Hos CGI får du möjlighet att arbeta med AI i komplexa och verksamhetskritiska miljöer hos kunder inom både privat och offentlig sektor. Du arbetar tillsammans med kompetenser inom bland annat AI, data, cloud, cybersecurity, arkitektur och systemutveckling. Det innebär att du får möjlighet att bygga AI lösningar som inte stannar vid proof of concept, utan blir en del av kundernas faktiska verksamhet och IT landskap.  

  

Samtidigt får du möjlighet att utvecklas inom ett område som förändras snabbt och bidra till hur CGI bygger framtidens kompetens och lösningar inom AI. Vill du gå från AI experiment till AI i produktion? Välkommen till CGI.

**Låt oss som ägare omvandla verklig insikt till handling – tillsammans.**  

  

Livet på CGI bygger på ägande, lagarbete, respekt och tillhörighet. Tillsammans med oss kommer du att kunna nå din fulla potential.

description:

Under “Degree Status,” select “Now attending” to upload a transcript.

Google welcomes people with disabilities.

  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Zürich, Switzerland; Berlin, Germany; Munich, Germany; Grenoble, France; Paris, France; Accra, Ghana; Amsterdam, Netherlands; Stockholm, Sweden; London, UK**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in Computer Science, Linguistics, Statistics, Biostatistics, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, Economics, or Natural Sciences, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience in one area of computer science (e.g., Natural Language Understanding, Human Computer Interactions, Generative Media, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Algorithmic Foundations of Optimization, Quantum Information Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or similar areas).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Currently enrolled in a full-time degree program in EMEA and returning to the program after completion of the internship.
* Experience as a researcher, including internships, full-time, or at a lab.
* Experience contributing to research communities or efforts, including publishing papers in major conferences or journals.
* Experience with one or more general purpose programming languages (e.g., C/C++, Java, MATLAB, Go, Python, etc.).

**About the job**
-----------------


The Student Researcher Program fosters academic collaborations by hiring students onto research projects aligned to company priorities in scientific advancement. The program offers placements on teams across Google, for research, engineering, and science roles. As a Student Researcher, you will have the opportunity to participate in research projects focused on developing solutions for real-world, large-scale problems.


Student Researcher projects are exploratory and direct experiences that drive scientific advancement across a multitude of research areas. Students will work collaboratively on projects that explore innovative research challenges and support the creation of breakthrough technologies.


The program is open to students enrolled in a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD program. Projects vary in duration and location based on team and student requirements. It is required that you are located in one of the specific country locations identified for this role for the full duration of the engagement. When you apply, you will be considered for Student Researcher positions across all of Google's research teams - including DeepMind, Google Research, Google Cloud and more. This allows us to find the right project match for your skills and interests.


Researchers across Google are working to advance the state of the art in computing and build the next generation of intelligent systems for all Google products. To achieve this, we invest in foundational research and work on projects that utilize the latest computer science techniques developed by skilled software developers and research scientists. Whether we're shaping the future of sustainability, optimizing algorithms, or pioneering AI systems, our teams strive to continuously progress science, advance society, and improve the lives of billions of people.


Google Research is building the next generation of intelligent systems for all Google products. description:

**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------

Vi på Tre fortsätter vår satsning på riktad digital kommunikation och kundupplevelse. Vi har en tydlig ambition om att bli nummer ett bland svenska operatörer på lojalitet och kundbearbetning. För att fortsätta utveckla vår förmåga inom CRM och Marketing Automation söker vi nu en **Marketing Automation Specialist** till vårt team.

Som Marketing Automation Specialist hos oss blir du en viktig del av vårt CRM- och Marketing Automation-team. Vi arbetar datadrivet med riktad kundkommunikation och använder Salesforce Marketing Cloud för att skapa relevanta och träffsäkra kundupplevelser.


Du ansvarar för produktion, uppsättning och genomförande av kampanjer och automatiserade kundflöden. Rollen passar dig som gillar att arbeta nära verktygen och som får energi av att skapa, testa och förbättra kommunikation baserat på data och kundinsikter.  

  



**I rollen kommer du bland annat att:**

* Skapa och genomföra mail- och SMS-kampanjer i Salesforce Marketing Cloud
* Bygga, underhålla och optimera kundresor i Journey Builder
* Arbeta med målgruppsurval, segmentering och datahantering
* Skapa dynamiskt innehåll med hjälp av AMPscript och Cloud Pages
* Testa och kvalitetssäkra kampanjer före utskick
* Samarbeta med CRM, analys, affär och IT för att säkerställa relevanta och träffsäkra kundupplevelser

Du arbetar nära kollegor inom CRM, analys och affären samtidigt som du har stort eget ansvar för dina leveranser. Här får du möjlighet att fördjupa dig inom Marketing Automation i ett område som Tre fortsätter att investera i och utveckla.  

  



Det här är en projektanställning på 12 månader med **start enligt överenskommelse, men som tidigast i januari 2027** kopplad till vår fortsatta satsning inom CRM och kundkommunikation.  

  

**Du kan se fram emot att:**


* Arbeta hands-on med Salesforce Marketing Cloud, kundresor och automatiserade kampanjer
* Vara en del av Tre's fortsatta satsning på CRM, kundlojalitet och riktad kundkommunikation
* Arbeta datadrivet nära både affär, analys och marknadsföring

* Vara en del av en av Sveriges bästa arbetsplatser enligt Great Place to Work samt en stolt samarbetspartner till Women in Tech och Tjejer Kodar

"Jag tror på att ge människor stort eget ansvar och friheten att driva sitt arbete framåt. Samtidigt vill jag vara en chef som finns nära till hands när det behövs stöd, vägledning eller någon att bolla idéer med.


Jag uppskattar personer som tar initiativ, är nyfikna och gillar att samarbeta med andra. För mig är det viktigt att skapa ett team där vi hjälper varandra, delar kunskap och har roligt tillsammans samtidigt som vi levererar med hög kvalitet."

Julia Maxén
Gruppchef
*"Jag vill att mitt team ska få de bästa förutsättningarna för att göra sitt jobb på bästa sätt. Det är så vi utvecklar oss som team, men även utvecklar Tre framåt."*
Henrik Sundvall
Digital projektledare
*"Det absolut bästa med att vara projektledare på Tre är jag får jobba brett med kollegor från alla delar av organisationen och få lära mig nya saker varje dag. Jag har friheten att vara mig själv – och bli uppskattad för det!"*
Jayasri Battola
Utvecklare
*"The great work culture and the technology made me choose Tre. Working alongside great people in mixed team setups, with both experienced and new talents, along with the latest and greatest tools and technologies like Cloud and Azure."*
**Kvalifikationer**
-------------------

**Mer om dig**  

Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av Marketing Automation, CRM eller digital kundkommunikation och som trivs i en operativ specialistroll.
  

  

Du har gärna erfarenhet av Salesforce Marketing Cloud och känner dig trygg i att arbeta med kundresor, segmentering och kampanjer. Med kunskaper i SQL och AMPscript, eller annat skriptspråk med vilja att lära dig Salesforces ekosystem, är du van att bygga och optimera kommunikationsflöden.

* God förståelse för segmentering, målgruppsurval och datadriven kommunikation

**Det är meriterande om du också har erfarenhet av:**

* SQL
* AMPscript
* Journey Builder
* Cloud Pages

Som person är du självgående, noggrann och samarbetsinriktad. Du tar ansvar för ditt arbete, driver dina uppgifter framåt och levererar med hög kvalitet även när förutsättningarna förändras. Vi tror att du får energi av att skapa välfungerande kundkommunikation, gillar att arbeta datadrivet och vill vara med och utveckla vårt CRM-arbete framåt.

title: Penetrationstestare
description:
Vi söker en penetrationstestare som tänker som en angripare, men jobbar på rätt sida av lagen.

Du vet känslan när du ser en ny applikation och första tanken inte är ”vad gör den?” utan ”hur tar jag mig in?”.

Då kanske du passar hos oss.

På Certezza hjälper vi organisationer att hitta sina svagheter innan någon annan gör det. Vi söker nu en penetrationstestare eller red team-specialist som älskar tekniska utmaningar, gillar att gräva där andra ger upp och som ser säkerhetsbrister där andra ser funktioner.

Vad kommer du göra?

Kort sagt: försöka ta dig in där du inte borde kunna.  
Mer konkret innebär det att du:

* Genomför penetrationstester och säkerhetsgranskningar
* Simulerar verkliga angreppsscenarier
* Identifierar sårbarheter och risker
* Dokumenterar resultat och rekommenderar åtgärder
* Presenterar dina slutsatser för både tekniker och beslutsfattare

Du kommer att arbeta med allt från webbapplikationer och interna nätverk till molnmiljöer och andra komplexa system.

Vem är du?

Vi tror att du:

* Har några års erfarenhet av penetrationstester
* Trivs i Linux lika bra som i Windows
* Förstår nätverk, webbteknik och moderna IT-miljöer
* Är nyfiken, analytisk och kreativ
* Tycker att lärandet aldrig tar slut

Bonuspoäng om du har erfarenhet av bug bounty, reverse engineering, cloud security, mobilsäkerhet, exploit-utveckling, OSINT eller forensik.  
Och om förkortningar som OWASP, CVE, MITRE och NIS inte kräver någon googling är det ett gott tecken.

Varför Certezza?

För att du får:

* Arbeta med några av Sveriges mest spännande säkerhetsuppdrag
* Kollegor som gärna delar kunskap istället för att vakta den
* Tid och möjlighet att utvecklas och certifiera dig
* Stor frihet under ansvar
* En kultur där människor är lika viktiga som tekniken

Vi har över 20 års erfarenhet inom cybersäkerhet och fortsätter att växa. Nu vill vi gärna göra det tillsammans med dig.

Omfattning: Heltid, tillsvidare  
Placering: Stockholm

Vi intervjuar löpande och ser fram emot din ansökan.

Har du frågor om rollen är du välkommen att kontakta, Mona Faghihi, rekryteringsspecialist, på +46-70 771 66 26 eller mona.faghihi@certezza.net. Skicka in din ansökan med CV och personligt brev så snart som möjligt då vi gör ett löpande urval och intervjuar kontinuerligt. En djupintervju samt bakgrunds- och registerkontroll kommer utföras innan beslut om anställning fattas.
