title: Videoredigerare för Gaming-videor
description:
**Om oss**

**Perik E-Handel AB** producerar underhållande YouTube-videor för en internationell publik med miljontals tittare. Vårt innehåll riktar sig främst till en yngre målgrupp och består framför allt av gaming-content inom Minecraft och Roblox, samt IRL-content.

Vi söker nu en pålitlig videoredigerare som vill bli en del av vårt team och hjälpa oss att klippa våra gaming-videor.

**Om rollen**

Som videoredigerare hos oss kommer du att redigera long-form YouTube-videor för våra kanaler. Redigeringen varierar mellan mer renodlad klippning, där pacing, dialog och flow står i fokus, och mer bearbetade videos med exempelvis musik, ljudeffekter och videoeffekter.

Vi arbetar i Adobe Premiere Pro, vilket därför är ett krav för rollen.

Arbetet sker på distans och till stor del självständigt. Vi söker därför någon som kan ta ansvar för sitt arbete, hålla deadlines och kommunicera proaktivt med resten av teamet.

**Vem vi söker**

Vi lägger stor vikt vid hur du arbetar som person. Framför allt söker vi dig som:

* Är självgående och tar ansvar för ditt arbete.
* Kommunicerar proaktivt och själv hör av dig när frågor eller problem uppstår.
* Är driven och vill utvecklas.
* Är pålitlig och håller överenskomna deadlines.
* Är mottaglig för feedback och kan omsätta den i ditt arbete.
* Har tidigare erfarenhet av Adobe Premiere Pro.
* Har egen dator och en stabil internetuppkoppling som lämpar sig för videoredigering.
* Är baserad i Stockholm eller Stockholmsområdet.
* Behärskar svenska mycket väl.

Tidigare professionell erfarenhet som videoredigerare är inget krav. Har du redigerat egna projekt, YouTube-videor eller annat content är det också relevant erfarenhet.

Erfarenhet av YouTube-content samt förståelse för gaming och YouTube-kultur är starkt meriterande.

**Omfattning**

Det här är ett deltidsuppdrag på ungefär 15–20 timmar per vecka, med viss variation över tid.

Arbetet sker på distans med flexibla arbetstider. Det går bra att kombinera uppdraget med exempelvis studier, andra uppdrag eller eget arbete.

**Ersättning**

250 kr/timme exkl. moms, faktureras som konsult.

**Ansökan**

Ansökan sker via Indeed. Där får du svara på ett antal korta frågor om bland annat din erfarenhet, tillgänglighet och tekniska setup.

Har du tidigare arbeten som du vill visa oss får du gärna inkludera dem i din ansökan, men det är inget krav.

Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande.

Jobbtyp: Tillsvidare

Lön: Från 190,00kr per timme

Förväntad arbetstid: 15.0–20.0 per vecka

Förmåner:

* Jobba hemifrån

Ansökningsfrågor:

* Var i Stockholm eller Stockholmsområdet är du baserad?
* Vilken erfarenhet har du av Adobe Premiere Pro och andra program inom Adobe Creative Cloud?

Beskriv kort vilka program du har arbetat i och hur du har använt dem.

* Berätta kort om din tidigare erfarenhet av videoredigering.
* Vilken dator/setup använder du för videoredigering?

Ange gärna datormodell, processor/chip, RAM, grafikkort (om relevant) och lagring.

Exempel: MacBook Pro, M3 Pro, 18 GB RAM, 1 TB SSD.

* Hur snabb internetuppkoppling har du?
* Ungefär hur många timmar per vecka skulle du kunna och vilja arbeta med oss?
* Hur ser din nuvarande situation ut?

Berätta gärna kort om exempelvis arbete, studier, andra uppdrag eller egna projekt som du har vid sidan av.

Det här är ett deltidsuppdrag och det är helt okej att ha andra åtaganden. Vi vill framför allt förstå hur uppdraget skulle passa in i din nuvarande vardag.

title: Sr Procurement Partner
description:
Sinch is a global leader in cloud communications, helping businesses connect with their customers through messaging, voice, and email. Our platform powers billions of interactions every year — from transactional alerts and marketing campaigns to rich, AI-driven conversations.


We're at an inflection point. As enterprise communication shifts from one-way messaging to intelligent, multi-turn conversations, Sinch is building the products and infrastructure that will define this next chapter. That means investing in agentic AI, conversational intelligence, and the orchestration layer that ties it all together.


**About the role**

This isn't just another Procurement position; it's a unique opportunity to be a key driver in Sinch's - one of Sweden’s most exciting tech companies, global procurement transformation. We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Procurement Partner to lead the critical Data & Analytics Category. This category includes handling Sinch´s Hyperscaler agreements as well as Data Management & Governance and Data Subscriptions & Content.
You will step into a pivotal role, taking ownership of a key spend category and moving it from a decentralized, ad-hoc state to a centralized model built on best-in-class frameworks. If you are a change agent who excels at creating order from complexity and wants to leave a tangible legacy, this role is for you.  

This position is based at our Stockholm office (Kungsholmen) and offers a hybrid model, with an expectation of 2-3 days in the office per week. You will be part of a Global Team with team members in New Delhi (Noida), Sao Paulo and Stockholm. This role reports to the Director of Procurement, also based in the Stockholm office.
**Key responsibilities**

Your primary mission will be to accelerate the transformation of our Data & Analytics Category. While you will also manage other categories, your success will be measured by your ability to build, implement, and drive adoption of a new strategic sourcing framework.
* Lead the Data & Analytics Category: Take full ownership of structuring the Hyperscaler agreements in close collaboration with the Cloud Governance Team. You will design and implement the strategy to align and drive Sinch Global Cloud Governance Strategy as a proactive, centralized procurement model.
* Drive Strategic Sourcing & Negotiation: Lead end-to-end sourcing projects, from RFPs and contract renewals to complex renegotiations. Your focus will be on establishing global framework agreements that deliver value, mitigate risk, and create efficiency.
* Be a Trusted Partner to the Business: Act as a strategic advisor to senior stakeholders. A crucial part of your role is to guide and influence business leaders, helping them navigate and embrace new procurement processes in a rapidly evolving organization.
* Manage Key Categories: Beyond the Hyperscalers, you will oversee the Data Management & Governance as well as Data Subscriptions as needed within our collaborative team and your stakeholders across the Sinch business.
* Champion Process Excellence: Go beyond just managing projects—actively identify, design, and implement process improvements that bring lasting structure and efficiency to the procurement lifecycle.

**About you**We are looking for a seasoned procurement professional who is energized by ambiguity and has a proven track record of building functions from the ground up. You are a pragmatic, results-oriented change agent who knows how to bring people along on a transformation journey.
To thrive in this role, you should bring:


* **Strategic Procurement Background:** Approximately 5-10 years of strategic procurement experience , with a proven track record in a transformation-focused role where you have successfully built and implemented new procurement frameworks.
* **A Builder & Change Agent Mindset:** Demonstrable experience taking complex or decentralized spend categories and transforming them into structured, centralized functions.
* **Category Expertise:** Expertise in the Data & Analytics category (including Hyperscalers, Data Governance, or Data Subscriptions) is highly desirable. Broad IT procurement experience is also a strong plus, though the right strategic mindset can compensate for specific category gaps.
* **Exceptional Negotiation & Influence:** Powerful negotiation skills combined with a history of managing and advising senior stakeholders, balancing necessary processes with strong, collaborative business relationships.
* **Resilience & Autonomy:** The ability to thrive independently in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. You don't wait for instructions, you see the goal, create the plan, and execute.
* **Systems & Tools Savvy:** Practical experience with common ERP/P2P systems is beneficial, as is familiarity with leveraging AI tools to drive efficiency.

Our corporate language is English, please submit your application in English.  



At Sinch, we value learning, embrace change, and offer opportunities for personal and professional growth. Unfortunately, we are not supporting relocation at this time.  



**Applicants must:**

* Hold a Swedish or EU/EEA citizenship.
* Have a valid Swedish work permit.

**About our hiring process**

We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel.


We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: https://www.sinch.com/careers/ . No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!
 

The monthly salary for this position is between 55k to 70k Swedish kronor per month. Factors which may affect pay within this range may include skills, education, experience, and other qualifications.

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
About the role The Analytics Engineer designs, builds and owns Kisi's trusted, AI-ready data and insights layer. Rather than fielding individual data requests, the role makes sure that people and AI tools across the company get correct, authorized and context-aware answers on their own, and measures how accurate and impactful those answers are. Responsibilities Data activation in operational tools. Deliver relevant, trusted data into the tools each team already uses (e.g.
  
  

enriching HubSpot with data from Stripe, Chargebee, the Kisi API and other sources) so teams can act without requesting reports. Trusted insights layer. Build and maintain a documented, semantically modeled layer that humans and AI can query for accurate answers. Encode business context (such as the Stripe to Chargebee migration) and surface known data-quality limitations alongside results.
  
  

Consolidation of reporting assets. Migrate existing dashboards, reports and connected Sheets onto the insights layer to create a single source of truth. Self-serve audiences and ad-hoc requests. Enable teams to build targeted audiences and one-off data pulls themselves, including through AI tools, and handle remaining business requests as they arise.
  
  

Source coverage. Integrate the business data sources needed for complete insights, such as Google Analytics, Facebook Ads and other marketing platforms. Data governance and access control. Ensure every consumer, human or AI, can only access data they are authorized to see, with role-based access across the insights layer, dashboards and AI integrations.
  
  

Quality and impact measurement. Maintain an accuracy benchmark of known-correct figures and track adoption, time saved and decisions supported. Success looks like: Team members get the insights they need, right when they need them, and trust them. Qualifications Strong SQL and data modeling skills, including dimensional or semantic modeling in a cloud warehouse (BigQuery or similar) Experience building and maintaining data pipelines and integrations with SaaS tools such as HubSpot, Stripe and Chargebee Experience making data usable by AI tools and LLMs, including documentation, semantic layers and guardrails Working knowledge of data governance and role-based access control Ability to translate business questions into durable data products and to explain data limitations clearly to non-technical stakeholders

title: Grafisk formgivare till Dormy Golf
description:
Grafisk formgivare Gillar du golf? Bra. Är du en duktig formgivare, med sinne för hur man både fångar kundens uppmärksamhet i de digitala kanalerna och i det fysiska mötet? Då har vi på Dormy drömjobbet för dig!
  
  

Eftersom en av våra formgivare går på föräldraledighet i vinter söker vi nu hennes ersättare i ett vikariat på 13 månader med start 18 januari. Den digitala miljön får en allt större roll i vår kommunikation, e-handeln ökar snabbt och mycket av det material vi skapar är därför anpassat för dessa kanaler. Men det är fortfarande våra tolv varuhus som är hjärtat i Dormys verksamhet och därför är det av stor vikt att skapa en inspirerande miljö för våra kunder. För att möta de behoven söker vi nu en formgivare som kan röra sig vant mellan den digitala och den fysiska världen.
  
  

Du kommer framför allt att skapa skylt- och displaymaterial för våra varuhus, både digitalt och i tryck, men även hjälpa till med innehåll för mejl och hemsida. En stor del av jobbet handlar om våra digitala skärmar och därför ser vi gärna att du är van att jobba i After Effects och kan skapa animeringar och andra grepp som får innehållet att lyfta. Vi tror också att du är en idérik, stilsäker och passionerad kreatör, som tycker att nyckeln till framgång är strukturerat arbete men också är så pass flexibel att du klarar att fånga alla bollar som kommer på uppstuds på en dynamisk marknadsavdelning. Är det värdeord du känner igen dig i?
  
  

Det är en god början. Utöver detta vill vi att du har hög energinivå, sinne för detaljer och förstår värdet av att göra det lilla extra för att resultatet ska bli riktigt bra. Du kommer att ingå i ett innehållsteam med fem kreatörer och tillsammans hjälps ni åt att producera huvuddelen av Dormys innehåll och grafiska material. Eftersom arbetstempot stundtals är högt och intensivt kommer ni regelbundet att avlasta varandra i olika projekt, vilket innebär att vi vill att du är en bred formgivare och kan skapa material för alla våra kanaler vid behov.
  
  

Är det här du? I så fall är möjligheterna goda att det är dig vi anställer som ny formgivare på Dormy och att du får vara med på ett framgångsrikt företags roliga resa. Om tjänsten Tjänsten som formgivare är ett vikariat på 100% med placering på Dormys huvudkontor i Örebro. Du kommer att tillhöra Dormys Marknadsavdelning och blir en central del av vårt kreativa team som dagligen arbetar med att marknadsföra Dormy i olika sammanhang.
  
  

I den här rollen får du ansvar för skylt- och displaymaterial och kommer att ha möjlighet att utveckla vår kommunikation i våra varuhus i tät dialog med våra varuhuschefer samt Dormys visuellt ansvariga. Utöver detta medverkar du till att skapa material anpassat för våra digitala kanaler, men också externa annonser och samarbetsprojekt. Du kommer också att involveras i många roliga och stimulerande projekt kring våra marknads- och kommunikationsfrågor och jobba i tätt samarbete med Dormys övriga formgivare. Kvalifikationer Eftersom huvuduppgifterna är att producera olika typer av grafiskt innehåll tror vi att du har arbetat med liknande uppgifter i ett par år.
  
  

Utöver det vill vi att du har dokumenterad utbildning inom form och design, allra helst med digitala förtecken. Vi förutsätter också att du behärskar Adobe Creative Cloud, framför allt Photoshop, After Effects och InDesign. Kunskap inom övriga program är meriterande. Formella krav - Minst två års arbetslivserfarenhet - Relevant högskoleutbildning (eller motsvarande) - Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.
  
  

Ansökan Välkommen in med din ansökan senast 15 oktober. Tillträde för tjänsten är 18 januari. Frågor besvaras av Carl Klefbom, Innehållschef, på carl.klefbom@dormy.se eller 070-276 15 90 Om Dormy Golf Dormy Golf grundades 1994 och är idag den ledande detaljhandelskedjan i golfbranschen i Sverige. Försäljning sker via elva golfvaruhus i Sverige, e-handel och en Outlet.
  
  

Vi har nyligen inlett en spännande expansionsresa och finns nu representerade via e-handelssajter i Danmark, Finland, Norge, UK, Irland, Tyskland, Nederländerna, Frankrike, Österrike och Spanien. Huvudkontoret finns i moderna lokaler i Örebro och vi har även ett kontor i Stockholm i anslutning till vårt varuhus i Arninge.

title: Account Manager Public Sector & Higher Education
description:
**Company Description**  

Meet Unit4. With over 40 years of heritage, we’re an agile, fast growing, Cloud company that is on a mission to redefine Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) for mid-market people-centric organisations.


With our innovative, self-driving, adaptive and intuitive software, our customers can spend more time on meaningful high-value work.


At the heart of what we do lies a simple yet profound purpose: **Improve how people work by focusing on what truly matters**. — A powerful statement that enables different priorities for different people.


We’re shaping **how work should feel**, and we empower our people by providing them with the right tools to achieve the autonomy they need - it's what makes us unique.

 **Job Description**  

At Unit4, we empower people in service organizations with innovative ERP solutions that simplify work and help people focus on what matters most.


We are looking for an Existing Business Account Manager to join our Public Sector team in Sweden. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and growing relationships within a portfolio of existing customers across local government, public agencies, higher education, and other public sector organizations.


You will act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, helping customers maximize the value of their Unit4 investment while identifying opportunities for expansion through additional solutions, services, and cloud transformation initiatives.


Working closely with Customer Success, Solution Consulting, Professional Services, and Product teams, you will play a critical role in driving customer retention, growth, and long-term partnership success.

**What you will do**

* Own and develop a portfolio of existing Public Sector customers across Sweden.
* Drive customer retention, renewals, upsell, and cross-sell opportunities.
* Build and execute strategic account plans aligned to customer objectives and Unit4's growth strategy.
* Build trusted relationships with C-level executives, business leaders, finance, HR, and IT stakeholders.
* Lead commercial negotiations and manage opportunities through successful closure.
* Conduct regular business reviews and executive stakeholder engagements.
* Collaborate closely with Customer Success, Solution Consulting, Professional Services, Marketing, and Partners.
* Act as the voice of the customer internally and contribute to continuous improvement of the customer experience.
* Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline management using MEDDPICC and best-practice sales methodologies.

  

**Qualifications**  

* **2+ years** working as an Account manager
* Experience managing and growing existing customer relationships.
* **Public Sector** experience
* Ability to engage and influence stakeholders at executive level.
* Fluent in **Swedish and English.**

  

**Additional Information** **Who we are**


We are a people-first community that nurtures all the areas that surround your working experience. With us, you’ll be surrounded by a high-performance team that supports your authentic self and celebrates your uniqueness.


We believe that ‘How work should feel’ is an evolving statement. Work goes beyond tasks and everyday responsibilities it’s about feeling valued, empowered, promoted, impactful, seen, and appreciated.


We are reimagining how work makes people feel.

**What we offer**


a culture built on trust and accountability - giving you the freedom and autonomy to be successful and make an impact


balance - with our Flexible Leave Paid Time Off policy, remote working opportunities, Global Wellbeing Days, and other great benefits


growth opportunities - we provide the tools and guidance required so that you can focus on what really matters to you and so, ultimately, you can achieve your best work


 talented colleagues, role models and mentors - work, learn and be inspired by some of the best talent in the software industry


a commitment to sustainability - with initiatives such as our Environmental, Social, and Governance strategy and Act4Good programme


 a safe and inclusive working environment – supported by our Employee Resource Groups, which are open to all.

**Our commitment to equity**


Unit4 is committed to ensuring equal opportunity for everyone. We make our hiring decisions solely based on skills, qualifications, and our current business needs. We know that diversity brings fresh perspectives, ideas, and solutions to our company. This is the essence of our culture. We also welcome and encourage people who are pregnant and/or parents-to-be to apply. If you would like to know more about our commitment to diversity, visit our blogs:

* Our focus to DEI remains central to who we are
* Inclusive hiring at Unit4: Building equal opportunities for all

**Background check**


This role may require security clearance required for customer projects and access to sensitive (customer) data. That means that after you have accepted our offer, we could ask for background checks. Subject to applicable local laws, such security checks may require disclosure of personal information including criminal record declaration, right to work, personal identification and work history. No worries – we'll handle it according to local privacy laws and keep your information safe. Questions? Feel free to reach out!

* Salary range is base salary

title: Outcome Customer Engineer, Google Cloud Platform Delivery
description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing or support role.
* Experience in deployment planning, orchestration, or change management.
* Experience in programming languages, debugging, or systems design.
* Experience engaging with, presenting to, or influencing technical stakeholders or executive leaders.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience selling technical solutions in one or more of the following areas: Infrastructure Modernization, Application Modernization, Data Management, Data Analytics, AI, Networking, Migrations or Security.
* Experience with Google Cloud products and differentiation from competition.
* Experience working with product and capacity teams to resolve technical and capacity blockers.
* Experience with object-oriented programming languages (i.e. Python, Java), and using technical proficiencies to remove blockers and accelerate customer deployment.
* Experience with keyboard operations.

**About the job**
-----------------


When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.



As a Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Outcome Customer Engineer (OCE), you will drive initial and ongoing business ramp for our customers, clearing blockers and ensuring they get the maximum benefit from their investment faster. You will manage and execute the deployment plan, transitioning scoped workloads into production by providing technical leadership to customers and partners. You will have a direct impact on the velocity and incremental consumption of customer workloads, leading to accelerated value realization, higher adoption, and future expansion opportunities.  

  

You will blend business expertise, market knowledge, direct technical engagement, and technical project management to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.


Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

Sweden: kr1040000 - kr1060000 (SEK) + 42.86% bonus target + equity + benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop and orchestrate a structured deployment plan across customer, professional services, and partner teams, onboarding the implementation team, clearing blockers, managing timelines and progress, and ensuring readiness (e.g., capacity, training).
* Employ coding, debugging, or systems design to resolve technical blockers and accelerate deployment.
* Drive and track progress of the initial and ongoing ramp of workloads, moving customers from agreement to consumption.
* Identify expansion opportunities for new workloads within the account during project execution.
* Drive sustainable product usage to help customers realize value on an ongoing basis and secure future agreement renewals.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

title: Frontend Lead - React, TypeScript & Applied AI
description:
Playground Dev is the software engineering company in Playground Group. We're a tight-knit team in central Stockholm, and we're growing across backend, fullstack and AI engineering.


Right now we're in a big build phase on our in-house platforms: group-wide initiatives that several companies in Playground Group rely on. It's complex territory, with many systems, many stakeholders and real data moving through it, and it matters. That's why we've built a large team around it, with leads in place for most areas. The frontend is where you come in.

##### **What you'll do**


You'll be the person who decides how the frontend gets built, and you'll still be building it. In practice:

* Own the frontend architecture: how it's structured, how it scales, and how it holds up long after launch.
* Set the frontend strategy and the standards around it, including component quality, performance, testing, and what "done" actually means.
* Take features from design to production yourself, treating craft, speed and usability as non-negotiable.
* Move down the stack when the problem calls for it, into the APIs, services and data flows behind the UI.
* Work side by side with the other leads, and an awesome team. You'll bring the frontend perspective into technical and product decisions so the platform grows without piling up debt.
* Lift the team around you through pairing, reviews and sharing what you know.

##### **Who we're looking for**


You're a frontend-leaning fullstack engineer who has designed frontend architecture that had to scale: more features, more teams, more users. You've made the big calls and lived with the consequences, and you can explain the trade-offs to engineers and non-engineers alike.


We work a lot with TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js and Python in multi-cloud environments. You're deep on the frontend side and comfortable enough in the backend to own a feature all the way through.


You've also genuinely changed how you work over the last couple of years. AI tools and agents are a natural part of how you build, and you have opinions on how they change the way teams work. If you've built AI-powered features into a product, even better.


Leadership here starts with technical direction. If you've led people before, great. If not, it's something you can grow into.


It's a big plus if you have:

* Experience with design systems or large-scale frontend platforms
* Hands-on work with LLM-powered interfaces, streaming or agents


Side projects, open source, weird experiments with agents? Tell us about it!

##### **Why on-site**


This role is on-site five days a week at our office on Gamla Brogatan in central Stockholm. The whole project team sits together, and we're in a fast build phase where the big decisions happen at a whiteboard, not in a thread. Architecture gets settled a lot faster when the backend lead is ten metres away. We think that's worth it, and we think you will too.

##### **How we work**


AI is part of our daily workflow, from how we deliver to how we learn and solve problems. We spend real time exploring new tools and learning from each other, and the bar is high.


All our work is done in teams. The distance from idea to production is short, and you won't sit in a narrow box.

##### **Practical details**

* On-site at our office in central Stockholm
* Fluency in Swedish is a strong plus, and English is required.
* Some assignments require extended background vetting.
* No visa sponsorship or relocation support. You need an existing, independent and permanent right to work in Sweden.
* The final stage of recruitment includes a background check by a third party.

title: Office and HR Coordinator
description:
**Ongoing is continuing its journey of profitable growth and is now searching for an Office & HR Coordinator.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Do you enjoy creating structure, providing great service and making sure both people processes and everyday office operations run smoothly? Ongoing is growing, and we are looking for an Office & HR Coordinator who will take ownership of a broad range of responsibilities across our office, payroll coordination and HR operations.

*Great workplaces are built through collaboration. Leaders from different teams working together to support each other and drive Ongoing forward.*

**About Ongoing**
-----------------


Headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden, Ongoing is a leading cloud-native WMS for logistics-intensive companies, including both third-party logistics (3PL) providers and businesses that operate their own warehouses. Our Software-as-a-Service solution helps customers integrate, automate and optimise complex warehouse flows.


Since July 2026, Ongoing has been a portfolio company of Cinven, a leading pan-European private-equity firm. This represents a new phase for the company, with strong ambitions to continue growing internationally and develop more structured and scalable ways of working.

*Knowledge sharing is part of everyday life at Ongoing. Our developers collaborate closely to solve problems and learn from one another.*

**About the position**
----------------------


As Office & HR Coordinator, you will have a central role in ensuring that our office and administrative processes work reliably and efficiently. You will coordinate practical office matters, support recurring HR administration and act as the main contact towards our external payroll provider.


The role combines ownership of established routines with the opportunity to improve and document processes as Ongoing continues to grow. You will work closely with the Head of Talent and collaborate with colleagues and external partners across a wide range of matters.

### ***In this role, you will***

* Coordinate monthly payroll administration by collecting and reviewing payroll input, meeting deadlines and owning communication with our external payroll provider.
* Maintain employee information and support recurring HR administration, including documentation connected to onboarding and offboarding.
* Support the implementation of a future HR system.
* Document and improve administrative processes and routines so that they remain clear, efficient and scalable as the company grows.
* Coordinate company off-sites, celebrations, parties and other internal events.
* Help create a welcoming and well-organised office environment by taking ownership of the small but important details that keep the office running smoothly, from shared spaces and meeting rooms to everyday practical needs.
* Coordinate with the office landlord, contractors and suppliers, and follow up on practical matters concerning the office.
* Order food, office supplies and other items needed for a well-functioning workplace.
* Handle varied day-to-day administrative requests and take initiative when practical issues arise.

**Who we are looking for**
--------------------------


We are looking for a structured and dependable person who enjoys a varied role and takes pride in getting the details right. You are comfortable coordinating several activities at once, communicate clearly with different stakeholders and follow tasks through to completion. You are also proactive in identifying what needs to be done and improving routines when something can work better.

*Cross-functional collaboration helps us grow while maintaining the culture and values that make Ongoing a great place to work.*

#### ***Required qualifications***

* Previous experience in a coordinating or administrative role within office management, HR administration, payroll administration or a similar area.
* Experience handling recurring administrative processes with deadlines and confidential information.
* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently, prioritise effectively and take ownership of both planned and ad hoc tasks.
* Clear and professional communication skills in Swedish and English.
* Good digital skills and the ability to learn new administrative systems.

#### ***Strong merits***
* Experience coordinating payroll together with an external payroll provider.
* Experience administering HR, payroll or time reporting systems.
* Experience with onboarding, offboarding or employee documentation.
* Experience coordinating offices, suppliers, internal events or company assets.
* Experience documenting and improving administrative processes in a growing company.

**Why join Ongoing?**
---------------------


You will join a profitable, fast-growing tech company with a strong product, close customer relationships and knowledgeable colleagues. This is a visible role with broad internal contact and clear ownership. Your work will have a direct impact on employees’ day-to-day experience and on how well our internal operations support the company as it grows.


The role offers a varied working day and the opportunity to shape practical routines, strengthen our administrative foundation and contribute to a well-organised and welcoming workplace.


At Ongoing, you will be part of a down-to-earth and collaborative culture where knowledgeable colleagues share ideas, help one another and value individual responsibility. We combine the energy of a growing company with an informal, social workplace where people have the opportunity to influence how we work and develop together.


We offer a flexible work environment where you can take responsibility for planning your working day, together with regular opportunities to connect through after-work activities, company conferences and workouts. Our modern office next to Chalmers also provides access to practical amenities such as a gym, changing rooms, and bicycle facilities.

*Our top-floor ping-pong table is appreciated for breaking off between hard work. Many, but not all, colleagues also like using the health benefits for running, gym, padel, squash, tennis, golf, or other activities.*

**Terms**
---------


The position is based at Ongoing’s office in Gothenburg and is primarily office-based. We offer competitive terms and benefits, including wellness-related benefits that support an active and healthy lifestyle.

* **Start:** By agreement
* **Location:** Gothenburg

title: Solution Architect, Google Cloud – Cloud Foundations | SEB, Solna
description:
Join Cloud Foundations and set the direction for the cloud platform the rest of the bank builds on. We deliver landing zones, guardrails and platform capabilities in Google Cloud, so SEB's developers can move fast without compromising security or compliance.
   

  

 Hundreds of application teams at SEB need managed, vetted solutions for standard patterns. As Solution Architect you own the target architecture for our GCP platform and the way we work with architecture. You work as a pair with our Tech Lead for GCP, who owns how it gets built, and you know the platform and its codebase well. You report to the Head of Department and are a member of the department's management team, together with our team managers and the other Solution Architects.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Create, maintain, and drive the target architecture for our GCP platform, in line with the bank's domain architecture and business objectives.
* Define managed, vetted solutions for standard patterns that application teams across the bank can reuse, together with the Solution Architects in the domain.
* Establish and maintain structured architecture practices, including documentation.
* Define ADRs that the Tech Lead and the team take into implementation and test your designs against what the team learns from building.
* Drive architectural decisions through the bank's architecture governance.
* Support larger initiatives that start from a use case, where application teams need architecture support to land on the platform. You do this jointly with the other Solution Architects.
* Proactively identify improvements and take the lead when the direction is unclear.
* Advise development teams and architects and coordinate with the other Solution Architects to keep GCP, Azure and AWS coherent.
* Contribute to the department's direction and ways of working as part of the management team.


**Who You Are**
 You are a driven, proactive, and collaborative architect who takes ownership and enjoys solving complex problems. You make complicated things simple and can explain a design to a developer, a security specialist, and a manager in the same week. You share what you know and contribute to an open and transparent team.
   

  

**Skills And Experience**
* Cloud architect certification, primarily Google Cloud (e.g. Professional Cloud Architect). A comparable certification in another cloud is accepted.
* University degree and 6–10 years of relevant experience, including several years of architecture or senior engineering in public cloud, with GCP as your main platform.
* Experience of owning architecture that is used broadly by many teams in a large organization.
* Strong knowledge of cloud platform architecture: landing zones, IAM, networking, security, observability, and resilience.
* Experience from establishing structured architecture work (decision records, models, documentation) and driving decisions through formal architecture governance.
* Solid understanding of Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD, e.g. Terraform and GitHub Actions, and the ability to work in the codebase.
* Ability to turn business needs into solutions, and to collaborate across domains and managerial levels, both business and IT.
* Experience from leading architecture work without formal line management.
* Fluent English, spoken and written.


**Nice to have**
* Experience of Azure or AWS.
* Financial services or another regulated industry.
* Driving larger technical shifts across several teams.
* Kubernetes/GKE, policy-as-code or self-service platforms.


**What We Offer**
* Real influence over a platform the whole bank builds on, reaching hundreds of application teams.
* A seat in the department's management team.
* A technical team of around fifteen people, with a Tech Lead next to you rather than below you.
* GCP as your home ground, with room to broaden into Azure and AWS.
* A hybrid workplace, SEB staff banking and our wider benefits package.
* An office next door to Mall of Scandinavia in Solna.


**Do you want to be part of SEB?**
 It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.
   

  

 We encourage you to submit your application no later than the 19th of October via the link in this advertisement. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Mikaela Ahlstrand at mikaela.ahlstrand@seb.se. Kindly note that we do not accept applications via email.
   

  

 Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and history of crime. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks. During employment, employees within SEB can also expect to undergo recurring background checks.
   

  

 SEB Sweden has a redeployment responsibility, which means that this position might be covered by internal redeployment.
   

  

 Learn more about working at SEB on our Career website or through our Career podcasts.
   

  

 sebgroup.com/career
   

  

 bit.ly/SEBcareer

title: AI-Utvecklare
description:
Vill du utveckla AI- och ML-tjänster som faktiskt går i produktion och gör verklig skillnad för människor och djur? Hos oss får du kombinera modern fullstackutveckling med avancerad AI, från NLP och chatbotar till bildigenkänning, i en miljö där du är med och formar både arkitektur och lösning.
   

  

 Om rollen
   

  

 Du blir en central del i ett team som bygger intelligenta tjänster ovanpå en modern Azure-plattform. Här jobbar du både med klassisk systemutveckling och hands-on AI-utveckling. Du rör dig obehindrat mellan backend i .NET, frontend i React och AI-komponenter i Python, och du är med hela vägen från idé och prototyp till produktion och vidare optimering.
   

  

 IT och affären jobbar nära tillsammans, vilket betyder att du snabbt ser effekten av det du bygger. Du samarbetar tätt med andra utvecklingsteam för att säkerställa att våra lösningar hänger ihop från frontend till backend – och att AI-funktionaliteten faktiskt används och skapar värde.
   

  

 Du kommer bland annat att:
   

  

* Bygga moderna frontend-lösningar med React, TypeScript och microfrontend-arkitektur
* Jobba testdrivet och bidra till hög kvalitet i koden
* Designa och implementera integrationer med både synkrona och asynkrona mönster
* Vara delaktig i mjukvaruarkitektur och tekniska vägval
* Bygga och optimera CI/CD-pipelines med Azure och Azure DevOps
* Automatisera miljöer och infrastruktur med Bicep
* Utveckla och implementera avancerade AI-lösningar med fokus på NLP, intelligenta system och bildigenkänning
* Bygga, integrera och optimera chatbotar och språkmodeller (inklusive generativ AI)


 För att lyckas i tjänsten tror vi att du har:
   

  

* Erfarenhet av generativ AI och av att ha deployat applikationer i produktion
* God kunskap av fullstack-utveckling med .NET och React
* Vana av testdriven eller testfokuserad utveckling
* Erfarenhet av integration mot synkrona och asynkrona gränssnitt/mönster
* Förståelse för mjukvaruarkitektur och hur man bygger skalbara lösningar
* Erfarenhet av att bygga CI/CD-pipelines med Azure som målplattform
* Kunskaper i Bicep
* Flytande i både svenska och engelska


 Som person är du drivande och resultatfokuserad, med en stark nyfikenhet på ny teknik. Du kan växla mellan att arbeta självständigt och i team, och du har ett gott självledarskap. Du håller ordning och reda, dokumenterar på en lagom nivå och bidrar till en kultur där man delar kunskap, utmanar gamla sanningar och tillsammans bygger smartare lösningar.
   

  

**Kontaktuppgifter:**
 Rekryterande chef: Poja Daroui, poja.daroui@agria.se
   

  

 Facklig representant Forena: Mirek Swartz, mirek.swartz@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

 Facklig representant Akademikerföreningen: Ellinor Jatéus, ellinor.jateus@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

*Låter det spännande? Då vill vi veta mer om dig! Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag. Vi arbetar löpande med denna rekrytering och kan komma att tillsätta tjänsten innan sista ansökningsdag.*
 Agria är ett helägt dotterbolag till Länsförsäkringar och finns idag i Sverige, Norge, Finland, Danmark, Storbritannien, Tyskland, Frankrike och Irland. Vårt svenska kontor ligger på Gärdet i Stockholm, men vårt hjärta och verksamhet sträcker sig långt utanför Sveriges gränser. Med en tydlig tillväxt agenda fortsätter vi att expandera internationellt, driva innovation och utveckla digitala lösningar som gör verklig skillnad för djurägare. Ett exempel är vårt dotterbolag Agria Vet Guide, som erbjuder digital rådgivning och gör det enklare att hjälpa fler djur snabbare.
   

  

 Vi är marknadsledande i Norden inom djur- och husdjursförsäkringar, med en tydlig vision: att bli Europas mest omtyckta och pålitliga partner för djurägare. Vårt ledarskap handlar inte bara om marknadsandelar; det handlar om att skapa trygghet för både djur och människor, och att göra livet med djur enklare och roligare.

title: Strategic Account Executive, Splunk
description:
**Regional Sales Manager, Strategic Accounts**
 Splunk, a Cisco company, is building a safer and more resilient digital world with an end-to-end full stack platform made for a hybrid, multi-cloud world. Leading enterprises use our unified security and observability platform to keep their digital systems secure and reliable. Our customers love our technology, but it's our caring employees that make Splunk stand out as an amazing career destination. No matter where in the world or what level of the organization, we approach our work with kindness. So, bring your work experience, problem-solving skills and talent, of course, but also bring your joy, your passion and all the things that make you, you. Come help organizations be their best, while you reach new heights with a team that has your back.
   

  

**Position Overview:**
 We are seeking a passionate and highly skilled
 **Account Executive - Splunk** 
 to join our dynamic Strategic sales teams in Sweden with a success track record of consistently delivering outstanding sales performance.
   

  

 The customer portfolio will be within Financial Services but also cover some larger Manufacturing customers. The candidate will be responsible for a customer portfolio for some of our largest and most strategic customers in Sweden
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be responsible for maintaining and expanding relationships with those top brands out of the Private Sector while developing tailored sales strategies and driving sustainable revenue growth across the
 **Enterprise portfolio** 
 .
   

  

 You will play a pivotal role in understanding the specific needs, identifying strategic business opportunities, and positioning Splunk as a trusted partner.
   

  

 If you are ready for your next challenge and seeking an opportunity to grow within a company where you can truly thrive alongside a high-performing, results-driven team within the Cisco/Splunk family, please continue reading.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key stakeholders within the largest organizations in the Private Sector in Sweden
* Account Development: Identify and capitalize on new business opportunities within existing accounts, driving sales of products and services across the full portfolio.
* Negotiation & Closing: Lead contract negotiations and sales presentations with C-level stakeholders, ensuring mutually beneficial agreements that align with company goals.
* Sales Strategy & Execution: Develop and implement targeted sales strategies to achieve revenue growth, penetration, and market share expansion for your patch.
* Strategic Partnerships: Collaborate with internal teams (product development, engineering, marketing, legal) to develop tailored solutions that address the specific needs of the largest Private Sector Customers in Sweden.
* Market Intelligence: Stay ahead of industry trends, competitor activities, and technological advancements within the Swedish Enterprise Sector market to ensure the company’s offerings remain competitive and relevant. Know the regulations that govern this particular market.
* Sales Forecasting & Reporting: Regularly report on account performance, pipeline status, and sales forecasts, providing insights and recommendations for improvement
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, operations, and customer support, to ensure the successful delivery and satisfaction of customer projects


**Requirements**
* 7+ years of Enterprise Software sales experience with a demonstrated history of consistent quota overachievement, preferably with large, complex, global enterprises
* Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree; MBA or equivalent advanced degree strongly preferred
* Proven track record of scaling revenue organizations and driving strategic growth across regions or verticals
* Mastery of MEDDPICC methodology, with a history of mentoring and leading teams in its execution
* Demonstrated ability to build, scale, and manage high-value pipelines aligned to strategic business goals
* Boardroom-ready executive presence with a proven ability to influence and close multi-million-dollar enterprise software deals
* Demonstrated success operating at the CxO level and navigating complex enterprise buying cycles
* Accurate forecasting and commitment delivery across large portfolios and extended sales cycles
* Exceptional leadership, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills
* Experience in high-growth SaaS, cybersecurity and observability environments with rapid organizational scaling
* Deep understanding of enterprise IT ecosystems including cloud infrastructure, security, and digital transformation initiatives
* Power user of enterprise CRM platforms (Salesforce), with strong operational discipline and reporting fluency
* Experience in mentoring and developing junior sales talent and contributing to overall GTM strategy
* Ability to travel up to 25% within Sweden and internationally
* Native Swedish and fluent in English (both written & spoken)


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Technical Sales Engineer
description:
Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us.
   

  

 The world's biggest resource challenge isn't producing more energy, but using energy more intelligently.
   

  

 We're looking for a Technical Sales Engineer passionate about helping utilities build the intelligent electric grid that powers a sustainable future.
   

  

 Join us at the forefront of digital transformation in energy, where edge intelligence, AI, and grid modernization enable utilities to integrate renewables, electrify transportation, and create a more resilient world. Your work will directly influence how energy is generated, managed, and consumed—reducing all energy waste, improving efficiency, and helping communities achieve their climate goals.
   

  

**Duties And Responsibilities**
* Develop a strong understanding of the company’s offerings and electricity utility business models to maximize revenue opportunities.
* Match customer requirements to effective technical solutions.
* Lead the technical aspects of RFP/RFI responses and support proposal development. Support proposal and RFP development by contributing clear technical narratives, solution architectures, and partner storylines where deeper technical input is required.
* Maintain strong knowledge of metering (electricity/heat/water/gas), HES, MDMS, and AMI system integration in cloud and on-premise environments.
* Maintain working knowledge of relevant communication protocols (Cellular, RF mesh, NB-IoT, LTE CATM/M1, LoRa, PLC, etc) and metering standards (DLMS/COSEM, Mbus, SCADA, etc).
* Work closely with Solution Architects to develop competitive offerings and present them effectively, while also acting as a Solution Architect when required.
* Coordinate cross-functional input to support the sales process.
* Monitor market trends and share relevant insights with Product Management.
* Monitor the competitor and partner landscape to identify threats and opportunities.
* Identify new sales opportunities within existing accounts.
* Act as the primary customer liaison for technical engagements. Respond to customer enquiries, resolve technical issues within agreed SLAs and timescales, and log actions on the appropriate corporate systems.
* Maintain regular customer contact and visits to provide technical support and training.
* Engage subject matter experts as needed to support complex cases.
* Share customer feedback, complaints, and recurring issues with relevant teams to support continuous improvement.
* Support the development and maintenance of knowledge base and customer support materials.
* Design, deliver, and continuously improve inclusive, high-impact product demonstrations across Itron’s solution portfolio, clearly linking technical capabilities to customer outcomes and business value.
* Lead customer-focused, lab-based evaluations that validate integrated solutions, build trust, and support complex, high-priority sales pursuits in regulated utility environments.
* Document and maintain demo workflows, lab configurations, and partner integration blueprints to enable consistent, scalable execution across field and partner teams.
* Build, manage, and improve virtual lab and evaluation environments to support agile experimentation, solution validation, and rapid response to customer needs.
* Drive technical integration with partner technologies, creating reusable, validated solution environments that strengthen the “Itron Inside” ecosystem.
* Collaborate closely with Product Management and Services to ensure demonstrations reflect product roadmaps, deployment realities, and customer priorities.
* Create internal tools, scripts, videos, and enablement assets that improve access to consistent, high-quality demonstration materials.
* Maintain and improve a centralised Itron Demo Channel to support knowledge sharing and continuous improvement across internal and partner communities.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* Prior experience in technical sales engineering, solution engineering, product management, or a similar customer-facing technical role with a strong commercial mindset and the ability to identify customer needs, position technical solutions, and support revenue growth.
* Demonstrated experience with Grid, Distribution Service operator, Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI), utility enterprise platforms, and enterprise-scale system integration.
* Strong technical storytelling, presentation, and demonstration skills, with the ability to translate complex concepts into clear, customer-focused value propositions.
* Hands-on experience building and managing virtual lab environments and leading structured solution evaluations.
* Proven ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams and with external technology partners to define customer requirements and develop effective solutions.
* Experience contributing to regulated utility RFPs, technical proposals, and solution evaluations.
* Experience working within or alongside utility, energy, or infrastructure organisations, with a strong focus on safety, compliance, and innovation.
* Detailed knowledge of smart grid concepts, utility industry products and services, and electricity industry trends.
* Experience with meter data collection, meter data management systems, advanced metering infrastructure, network architecture, devices, and operations.
* Experience with utility communication technologies such as cellular, LTE, IoT (LoRaWAN and NB-IoT), and RF Mesh.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, interpersonal, and negotiation skills.
* Project and case management experience, with the ability to learn and adapt to new developments and technologies.
* Experience using corporate systems such as Salesforce, Oracle, and Windows applications.
* Experience with enterprise and utility system integration mechanisms, including REST APIs, Web Services, IEC/CIM interfaces, message-based architectures, and modern interoperability standards
* Fluent in Swedish and English.
* Comfortable utilising AI tools.
* Ability to travel up to 50% to support customer engagements, demonstrations, and evaluations.


**Nice to have**
* Familiarity with Itron’s technology portfolio, including IntelliFLEX, Grid Edge Intelligence, and MDMS solutions.
* Experience using demo orchestration platforms, video creation tools, and digital enablement technologies.
* Exposure to utility standards and regulations, renewable energy markets, and smart city applications.
* Experience of consultative selling in the utility or telecommunications sector, including complex enterprise software solutions.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Norwegian language skills.


**What We Offer**
* The opportunity to play an active role in transforming cities and utilities through smarter resource management
* A competitive package including fixed salary, variable compensation, car lease, occupational pension, life assurance, long-term disability benefit, and AD&D cover.
* An international, multicultural working environment with opportunities to improve customer support through collaboration with colleagues and partners worldwide.


 The expected annual salary range for this role is
 **700,000 SE** 
 K to
 **850,000 SEK** 
 , depending on relevant skills and experience. The role is also eligible to participate in a Sales Incentive Plan (SIP). We review compensation regularly to stay competitive in the market.
   

  

 Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for!
   

  

 The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience.
   

  

 Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1-800-635-5461 or email Accessibility@itron.com.
   

  

 Itron is transforming how the world manages energy, water and city services. Our trusted intelligent infrastructure solutions help utilities and cities improve efficiency, build resilience and deliver safe, reliable and affordable service. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. Join us as we create a more resourceful world: www.itron.com

title: Teknikområdesansvarig IT-säkerhet – med fokus på cybersäkerhet
description:
Statens institutionsstyrelse, SiS, är en myndighet som ansvarar för individuellt anpassad tvångsvård för ungdomar med komplex psykosocial problematik och för vuxna med missbruk. SiS verkställer även sluten ungdomsvård. Det gör vi på ungdomshem och hem för vuxna med missbruk, över hela landet. Hos oss på SiS blir ditt arbetsliv en spännande utmaning. Oavsett var i vår organisation du arbetar, eller vilken tjänst du har, hjälper du till att skapa livsviktig förändring.
 



  
 



 På huvudkontoret i Solna Business Park är vi ca 500 medarbetare och tillsammans arbetar vi för att stötta och utveckla myndigheten med ca 5000 medarbetare.
 



  
 



  
 



****Om arbetsplatsen****




 På SiS (Statens institutionsstyrelse) är digitaliseringen en kritisk del av vår förmåga att leverera säker och effektiv vård och behandling. Vår IT- och digitaliseringsavdelning består av cirka 80 engagerade medarbetare som dagligen arbetar för att stärka myndighetens verksamhet genom robusta, säkra och innovativa lösningar.
 



 Nu står vi inför en spännande utvecklingsfas med ett utökat uppdrag för hela myndigheten. Som teknikområdesansvarig med fokus på cybersäkerhet blir du en viktig del av ett sammansvetsat team som driver den digitala transformationen – med fokus på att bygga en säker, resilient och framtidssäker IT-miljö som skyddar både medarbetare, ungdomar och klienter.
 



 Här arbetar du i en miljö där det är högt i tak, prestigelöst samarbete och stort förtroende mellan kollegor. Tillsammans ansvarar ni för myndighetens rikstäckande nätverk och cybersäkerhet – ett dynamiskt och utmanande uppdrag som spänner över hela verksamheten.
 



**Arbetsbeskrivning** 




 Som teknikområdesansvarig med inriktning mot cybersäkerhet på SiS kommer du att spela en central roll i att skydda, övervaka och stärka vår digitala infrastruktur. Din vardag kommer att präglas av ett proaktivt arbete med hotövervakning och incidenthantering, där du identifierar, analyserar och mitigerar säkerhetshot i realtid för att säkerställa att våra system är robusta och motståndskraftiga.
 



 Du ansvarar för konfigurering och löpande underhåll av vår säkerhetsinfrastruktur, inklusive brandväggar, VPN, webbfilter, WLAN samt routing och switching. Med hjälp av din kunskap inom Splunk, SIEM-lösningar och EDR/XDR kommer du att genomföra logganalyser och hotjakt för att upptäcka och utreda säkerhetsincidenter innan de eskalerar.
 



 En viktig del av ditt arbete är att säkerställa att våra system följer aktuella regelverk och riktlinjer, såsom MCF:s rekommendationer, NIS2 och GDPR. Du kommer att arbeta med säkerhetsarkitektur och compliance för att garantera att vi uppfyller höga standarder, samtidigt som du identifierar och åtgärdar sårbarheter i våra system och nätverk.
 



 Utöver det tekniska arbetet bidrar du till att höja säkerhetsmedvetenheten bland medarbetare genom utbildningar, workshops och tydliga riktlinjer. Vi söker en tekniskt skicklig och säkerhetsmedveten specialist som är nyfiken, självgående och brinner för att skydda kritisk infrastruktur. Om du gillar att lösa komplexa problem, optimera säkerhetslösningar och bidra till en stabil och pålitlig IT-miljö, är detta rollen för dig.
 



**Kvalifikationer** 




**Krav:** 



* En för verksamheten relevant utbildning inom IT-säkerhet, cybersäkerhet, nätverksteknik eller motsvarande erfarenhet.
* Några års erfarenhet av:
* Nätverkssäkerhet och SOC/SIEM.
* Incidenthantering, WLAN, routing, switching, brandväggar, VPN och webbfilter.
* Att läsa och förstå säkerhetsloggar i system som Splunk, SIEM eller liknande.
* God förmåga i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska.
* B-körkort.



  
 



**Meriterande:** 



* Infrastruktursäkerhet: Erfarenhet av lastbalansering (Citrix ADC), PKI, hårdvarukrypto (Thales HSM) och federerad inloggning/2FA, ADFS.
* Teknisk säkerhet: Linux-härdning, penetrationstestning (Kali Linux, Metasploit, Burp Suite eller liknande), EDR/XDR.
* Automatisering & compliance: Scriptning (Python/PowerShell) och kunskap om regelverk (ISO 27001, NIS2, GDPR).
* Certifieringar: CISSP, OSCP, CEH eller liknande.
* Tidigare erfarenhet av offentlig verksamhet.



  
 



 Vi tror att en god säkerhetsmedvetenhet genomsyrar ditt arbete och att du är noggrann, strukturerad och har ett väl utvecklat ordningssinne. Vidare tror vi att du är initiativtagande och självständig, med förmåga att driva och slutföra arbetsuppgifter på egen hand. Det är viktigt att du är serviceinriktad, uppmärksam och tillmötesgående i ditt bemötande, samt har intresse och vilja att hjälpa andra för att leverera säkra och effektiva lösningar.

title: Network Project Manager
description:
Network Project Manager (Network PM)
 



  





 📍
 **Location:** 
 Stockholm, Sweden (Primarily Remote)
 



 🏠
 **Work Model:** 
 Remote with occasional travel
 



 ⏳
 **Contract Duration:** 
 Approx. 1,216 hours
 



 🕒
 **Hours:** 
 40 hours per week
 



 🌐
 **Language:** 
 English
 



 👥
 **Freelancers:** 
 Welcome to apply
 



 ✅
 **Background Check:** 
 Required
 



  





 About the Role
 



 We are looking for an experienced
 **Network Project Manager** 
 with a strong background in networking and telecommunications to lead large-scale network and infrastructure transformation programmes within a complex enterprise environment.
 



 This opportunity is ideal for a professional who began their career as a
 **Network Engineer** 
 and successfully transitioned into Project or Programme Management. You will combine deep technical understanding with strong leadership, stakeholder engagement, and delivery management skills to drive strategic technology initiatives from inception through to completion.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Lead and deliver network and telecommunications transformation programmes.
* Manage large-scale infrastructure and enterprise technology projects.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams, vendors, and business stakeholders.
* Own project planning, execution, governance, risk, and issue management.
* Drive successful delivery using Agile, Hybrid, or traditional project methodologies.
* Ensure technical solutions align with business objectives.
* Manage project budgets, resources, timelines, and dependencies.
* Provide regular reporting and status updates to senior leadership.
* Support organisational change management and adoption initiatives.
* Ensure solutions meet operational, quality, and security requirements.



  





 Required Experience
 



 Project & Programme Management
 


* 8+ years of IT and/or Telecommunications Project Management experience.
* Proven track record delivering network transformation programmes.
* Strong experience managing large-scale infrastructure projects.
* Experience working within complex enterprise environments.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders across business and technology teams.



  





 Technical Knowledge
 



 Candidates should possess strong understanding and experience across:
 



 Telecommunications Networks
 


* Core Networks
* Access Networks
* Transport Networks



  





 Networking
 


* IP Networking
* WAN Technologies



  





 Cloud Platforms
 


* Microsoft Azure
* Amazon Web Services (AWS)



  





 Security
 


* Network Security



  





 Infrastructure & Operations
 


* Data Centres
* Infrastructure Services
* Service Assurance
* IT Operations



 Key Competencies
 


* Programme & Project Management
* Agile Delivery
* Hybrid Delivery Methodologies
* Vendor Management
* Resource Management
* Change Management
* Executive Stakeholder Management
* Risk & Issue Management
* Strategic Planning & Delivery



  





 Preferred Certifications
 



 One or more of the following certifications would be advantageous:
 


* PMP (Project Management Professional)
* PRINCE2 Practitioner
* SAFe Agilist
* ITIL Foundation
* ITIL Managing Professional
* Agile/Scrum Certifications



  





 Ideal Candidate
 



 We're particularly interested in professionals who:
 


* Have transitioned from a Network Engineering background into Project Management.
* Possess excellent leadership and communication skills.
* Are comfortable engaging senior business and technical stakeholders.
* Thrive in complex enterprise environments.
* Understand networking technologies while maintaining a strategic delivery perspective.
* Have experience coordinating vendors and cross-functional delivery teams.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Nordnet is redefining the landscape of savings and investments, guiding over 2.5 million customers in their financial lives. We have spent the last years building a modern data platform and fostering a culture where actionable insights and rapid product refinement are part of our DNA. In our fast-paced environment, this remains a competitive edge - allowing us to ship, learn, and iterate faster than the market.
   

  

 Now we are seeking to engage a passionate Data Analyst to join our team.
   

  

 The role
   

  

 As a Data Analyst at Nordnet, you will be a part of Data & Insights, where you have the opportunity to work alongside Data analysts, Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers and Data Engineers.
   

  

 You will be embedded in our Product development teams, where you will be an integral component, working with designers, product leads and developers. You will deep-dive into our users and our products, and turn data into actionable insights.
   

  

 We would love it if you feel excited about at least some of these statements.
   

  

* Going beyond simple questions, defining a problem and understanding the right analytical approach
* Conduct statistical analyses on our customer -, financial -, and company data to identify patterns of behaviour
* Design experiments to evaluate various hypotheses and design choices
* Utilize AI and advanced modeling to scale your impact
* Craft and present compelling stories that will impact our decision makers
* Help improve our existing methodologies


 This is you
   

  

 You are passionate about data and learning new things, and you want to contribute with your experience and ideas. In your work, you are organised, methodical and agile in a way that benefits the team’s working climate and ability to deliver solutions.
   

  

 To thrive in this role, we believe that most of these criteria describe you:
   

  

* Proactive, with a strong sense of ownership
* A strong communicator with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Experience of using SQL, Python, R and dbt
* Hands-on experience with A/B testing
* Degree in economics, data science, statistics, engineering, mathematics, or similar


 We think that you have 3+ years experience working as a Data Analyst at a product oriented organisation.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 We are committed to your continuous growth, offering a space where you can learn, contribute, and take ownership of your technical domain over time. At Nordnet, we offer:
   

  

* A hybrid work model balancing remote flexibility with collaboration in our Stockholm office.
* 5,000 SEK annual wellness contribution (friskvårdsbidrag).
* A culture that values continuous learning and technical ownership.


 Visit us on www.nordnetab.com,www.nordnet.se, www.nordnet.no, www.nordnet.dk and www.nordnet.fi.
   

  

 Application
   

  

 At Nordnet, we know that the best products are built by teams with a mix of different backgrounds and perspectives. If you are excited about the challenges we’re solving and see yourself contributing to our team culture, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 To ensure a fair and streamlined process for everyone, we only accept applications through our recruitment system. We interview continuously, so feel free to reach out as soon as possible!
   

  

 Please note: Nordnet conducts credit and background checks as well as a drug test on the final candidate as part of our standard process for a digital bank.
   

  

 We look forward to meeting you!

title: Frontend Lead - React, TypeScript & Applied AI
description:
Playground Dev
   

  

* Stockholm
* Hybrid


 Frontend Lead - React, TypeScript & Applied AI
   

  

 Playground Dev is the software engineering company in Playground Group. We're a tight-knit team in central Stockholm, and we're growing across backend, fullstack and AI engineering.
   

  

 Right now we're in a big build phase on our in-house platforms: group-wide initiatives that several companies in Playground Group rely on. It's complex territory, with many systems, many stakeholders and real data moving through it, and it matters. That's why we've built a large team around it, with leads in place for most areas. The frontend is where you come in.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

 You'll be the person who decides how the frontend gets built, and you'll still be building it. In practice:
   

  

* Own the frontend architecture: how it's structured, how it scales, and how it holds up long after launch.
* Set the frontend strategy and the standards around it, including component quality, performance, testing, and what "done" actually means.
* Take features from design to production yourself, treating craft, speed and usability as non-negotiable.
* Move down the stack when the problem calls for it, into the APIs, services and data flows behind the UI.
* Work side by side with the other leads, and an awesome team. You'll bring the frontend perspective into technical and product decisions so the platform grows without piling up debt.
* Lift the team around you through pairing, reviews and sharing what you know.


 Who we're looking for
   

  

 You're a frontend-leaning fullstack engineer who has designed frontend architecture that had to scale: more features, more teams, more users. You've made the big calls and lived with the consequences, and you can explain the trade-offs to engineers and non-engineers alike.
   

  

 We work a lot with TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js and Python in multi-cloud environments. You're deep on the frontend side and comfortable enough in the backend to own a feature all the way through.
   

  

 You've also genuinely changed how you work over the last couple of years. AI tools and agents are a natural part of how you build, and you have opinions on how they change the way teams work. If you've built AI-powered features into a product, even better.
   

  

 Leadership here starts with technical direction. If you've led people before, great. If not, it's something you can grow into.
   

  

**It's a Big Plus If You Have**
* Experience with design systems or large-scale frontend platforms
* Hands-on work with LLM-powered interfaces, streaming or agents


 Side projects, open source, weird experiments with agents? Tell us about it!
   

  

 Why on-site
   

  

 This role is on-site five days a week at our office on Gamla Brogatan in central Stockholm. The whole project team sits together, and we're in a fast build phase where the big decisions happen at a whiteboard, not in a thread. Architecture gets settled a lot faster when the backend lead is ten metres away. We think that's worth it, and we think you will too.
   

  

 How we work
   

  

 AI is part of our daily workflow, from how we deliver to how we learn and solve problems. We spend real time exploring new tools and learning from each other, and the bar is high.
   

  

 All our work is done in teams. The distance from idea to production is short, and you won't sit in a narrow box.
   

  

 Practical details
   

  

* On-site at our office in central Stockholm
* Fluency in Swedish is a strong plus, and English is required.
* Some assignments require extended background vetting.
* No visa sponsorship or relocation support. You need an existing, independent and permanent right to work in Sweden.
* The final stage of recruitment includes a background check by a third party.

 At Playground Group, we start, own, and grow companies — and the people who lead them. We’re a corporate group with a sharp focus on technology and leadership, built around specialized companies that together form a uniquely strong offering.
